Caption (below the panel): I could deal with the indignity, the abuse. Because, deep down, it wasn't the words that hurt the most, it was the daily tire iron beatings.
comics.voteyText:
A close-up of a man's face, looking flat or unimpressed.
Man: "SETTING ME ON FIRE? DICK MOVE."

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A man with flame-like brown hair, dressed in black and standing with one hand behind his back, approaches a reception desk where a woman with dark hair in a purple shirt sits. Framed art hangs on the walls and a potted plant stands nearby.

Man: HEY THERE. YOU WANNA SPOON?

(The man is holding a spoon behind his back.)

Caption (below panel): Technically, it wasn't sexual harassment.
comics.voteyText:
Close-up of the woman, smiling, holding up a fork.
Woman: NO. YOU WANNA FORK?

comics.comicText:
Single panel:

Two people sit across from each other at a green table in a dimly lit room, a hanging lamp overhead and seashell-like decorations on the walls. A Battleship board game is open on the table between them. The man on the left, with brown hair and a green shirt, holds a smoking pistol pointed across the table. The person on the right slumps back in their chair, apparently shot, with smoke rising from where they were hit.

Caption (below panel): That was the last time we ever played "Battleship."
comics.voteyText:
A close-up of the man's face, looking grim, holding the still-smoking pistol.
Man: "Now, don't be a rules Nazi about this."

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A weatherman in a gray suit and green tie stands with his mouth open, gesturing. A speech balloon comes from him:

Weatherman: "And here in Nevada, we'll be experiencing a mild heat wave tapering off into-"

A second, jagged yellow speech balloon (his reaction) reads:

Weatherman: "OH MY GOD! IT'S GONE! THE UNITED STATES IS GONE! YOU MANIACS! WHAT DID YOU DO?!"

Caption (below panel): Every time the bluescreen went out, Stan the Weatherman suffered an existential crisis.
comics.voteyText:
A close-up of a man's face looking confused/concerned. Speech balloon:
"IF THIS MAP IS THE USA... THEN WHERE AM I?"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

A young man with orange hair, sitting on an examination table, with red wounds/cuts visible on his arms and legs. He is grinning and gesturing.

Patient: SAY, MIND IF I AXE YOU A FEW QUESTIONS? (the word "AXE" is underlined)

Patient: HEHE!

Across from him sits a doctor (older man with glasses, wearing a head mirror) holding a clipboard, looking unamused.

Caption (below panel): Life in the trauma ward was always a hoot!
comics.voteyText:
A close-up of a smiling man's face.
Man: YOU'RE GONNA DIE LAUGHING!

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Man (green shirt, brown hair, screaming): YARGH! MY ASS IS ON FIRE!

Donkey (engulfed in flames): HEE-HAW!

Caption (below panel): But, even the flaming donkey could do nothing to soothe my pain.
comics.voteyText: Close-up of a smiling man's face: PRETTY FUNNY THOUGH!

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A man with dark curly hair and glasses, wearing a red shirt and blue pants, stands on a beach looking out toward the water.

Man (speech bubble): "I SEE LONDON, I SEE FRANCE..."

Man (thought bubble): "SOMEONE ELSE WITH SUPER-VISION!"

In the foreground, the back of a blond-haired person's head is visible.

Caption: For one brief shining moment, Clark Kent thought he'd finally found someone who understood him.
comics.voteyText: A close-up of an angry face (Clark Kent / Superman) firing red heat-vision beams from his eyes.

comics.comicText:
Caption (below panel): What if cholesterol made you skinny?

Panel 1:

Two doctors stand over a hospital bed where a patient lies. One doctor holds a clipboard.

Doctor with clipboard: "Damn. A heart attack at age 22."

Second doctor (operating a heart monitor): "Yeah, but what a hot bod!"
comics.voteyText:
A gaunt, thin-faced man speaks.
Man: "I'm having the good cholesterol."

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

Man with gray hair, seated at a kitchen table with a bowl of cereal, holding a spoon and looking up in alarm: "WAIT A MINUTE! YOU PUT WHAT IN MY CEREAL?!"

A young man with blond hair in a green shirt stands behind, snickering with his hand over his mouth.

Sound effect near the blond man: "Teehee!"

The cereal box on the table reads: "EVERYTHING-BUT-URINE-O'S"
comics.voteyText: A close-up of a tired-looking man (the blond character from the main comic, now drawn in a simple sketch style) speaking calmly: "THIS IS THE ONLY THING THAT GRANTS ME PEACE."

comics.comicText:
Main comic (single panel):

A knight in full plate armor with a red cape kneels on one knee in an open dirt field, aiming a long sword forward as if it were a firearm.

Knight: "BANG! BANG!"

Across the field, a hand emerges from behind a green bush holding a spiked flail (mace), and a tombstone is visible.

Voice from behind the bush: "MISSED ME!"

Knight: "I DID NOT!"

Caption (below panel): "Dueling was a lot different before the invention of the pistol."
comics.voteyText:
A roughly-drawn figure kneels on one knee, pointing forward, in the same dueling pose.
Figure: "IT'S NOT FAAAIR."

comics.comicText:
Panel (single panel):

A white-haired woman lunges forward holding a bloody knife raised overhead, blood splattering, gripping a frightened man with red flame-like hair by the head/shoulders.

Woman (shouting): "YOU'RE A GOOD BOY! YOU'RE A GOOD GOOD BOY!"

Caption below the panel:

"By 2025, shampoo commercials have taken a strange turn."

"Of course, you'll never know. You get stabbed to death by your own mother in 2022."
comics.voteyText:
A drawing of a shampoo bottle next to handwritten text.
Text: "Shampoos: 'All pretty much the same.'"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A man with dark hair sits/leans against a purple headboard, his arms raised. A red blanket or sheet rises in the foreground.

Speech bubble: "COME TO BED, SWEETIE."

Caption (below panel):

"Once I overcame my moral difficulties with adultery, I started addressing more difficult questions. Like, why was the cranberry juice talking again?"
comics.voteyText: A tall glass containing red liquid (cranberry juice) with a lighter layer above it, drawn on a blue background. Text on the glass reads: "DRINK ME".

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A man in a tuxedo with a bow tie holds a sandwich in one hand, his other hand turned palm-up in a baffled shrug. His eyes are squeezed shut in confusion.

Man: I DON'T GET IT...

Caption (below panel): James Bond eats a sandwich.
comics.voteyText:
Handwritten heading at the top: "Reading this 10 years later..."
A bearded man looks toward a screen/monitor.
Thought bubble (the man): Me neither

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

A group of people sit around a dinner table sharing a meal, with a roast turkey, cups, and plates spread out. A man with blond hair in a purple shirt throws his arms up enthusiastically and exclaims:

Blond man: "HOW FAT WAS SHE?" (the word "WAS" is underlined for emphasis)

Caption below the panel: "This might have been a funny lead-in to a joke if anyone had made reference to a fat woman in the conversation thus far."
comics.voteyText:
A close-up of a bearded man (the cartoonist) looking down, resting his chin on his hand.
Bearded man: "I SHOULD NEVER DRAW PERSPECTIVE AGAIN."

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A woman in a green top and blue skirt is hanging by her neck above the ground, presumably dead. A man in a yellow shirt (named Ed in the caption) stands in a doorway with his back to the viewer, his arm raised.

Man (Ed): OH MY GOD!

Man (Ed): ALL OUT OF TOILET PAPER!

Caption below panel: Of course, Ed was blind.

Further caption: That's not to say he was unaware of his murdered wife. He just found the bathroom situation a little more pressing.
comics.voteyText:
A close-up of the man's face, looking unconcerned.
Man: IT'S NOT LIKE SHE'S GONNA UNHANG HERSELF.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A blond man sits at a computer, mouth open in shock, staring at his monitor.

Man: WHAT THE!? OH NO!

Man: NO!

Caption below the panel: Steve had just received the rarely used emoticon for "Your mother was just crushed to death in a trash compactor and cursed your name with her dying breath."

Caption (smaller): For those wondering, it's ][>:=~+.
comics.voteyText: A hand-drawn :/ emoticon (a colon and a forward slash) on a blank square.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Doctor (in surgical gown and headlamp/cap, holding up a small object on the end of a scalpel toward the patient): IT'S A BOY!

Patient (lying on a yellow operating table, arms raised triumphantly, cheering): WOO-HOO!

Caption (below panel): The appendectomy was going really well.
comics.voteyText: The smiling patient: AND 50 BUCKS! AND A PUPPY!

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

The Tin Man (from The Wizard of Oz), clutching his chest in pain, mouth open in a grimace.

Tin Man: HRKK!

Caption (below panel): Seventeen minutes after receiving a "new" heart, the Tin Man entered cardiac arrest.
comics.voteyText:
A close-up of the Tin Man's angry, grimacing face.
Tin Man: DAMN CHEAPASS WIZARD!

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

Large jagged text across the top: "YAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHA"

A smiling, laughing bearded man with a glowing halo (depicted as Jesus) stands on the left. The rest of the panel is filled with snarling red-skinned demon-like creatures against a red background.

Caption beneath the panel: "The human body is ninety percent water."
comics.voteyText:
A close-up of a grinning man's face (in the style of the bearded haloed man) wearing a hat.
Man: "TIME TO START DRINKIN'"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A bald man in a Roman toga, grinning and reaching toward a man seen from behind, exclaims: "KUNG FU BRUTÉ?"

Caption (below panel): Julius Caesar III was a lot better than Julius Caesar II.
comics.voteyText: The bald Roman man, wearing a jetpack, blasts upward into the sky on twin jets of flame, flying away over a city skyline.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A blond man in a green shirt and purple pants sits at a restaurant dinner table across from a woman with brown hair in a magenta top, who is seen from behind. A small potted tree sits on the table between them, along with wine glasses and plates. The man gestures toward himself as he speaks.

Man: "IT'S NOT YOU, IT'S ME! I JUST CAN'T GET INTO FAT CHICKS WITH NO PERSONALITY."
comics.voteyText:
A simply-drawn smiling person on the left holds up their hand, on which sits a small frog-like creature. A speech bubble points toward the creature.
Frog-like creature: "SORRY TO HEAR IT."

comics.comicText:
Main comic:

Speaker (a person standing at a podium, addressing a room that resembles a funeral/memorial gathering): "Dad is survived by seven children and fourteen grandchildren. And, yes, many of us will forever be haunted by images of his nightmarish death. But, you know what?"

A shout from someone in the seated audience: "CHICKENBUTT!"
comics.voteyText: Speaker (a man, shown in close-up with a grim expression): "Yes, that is what killed him."

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Woman with red hair: HEY THERE. YOU LOOKIN' FOR A GOOD TIME?

Man in green shirt: UHH... SURE... I GUESS I COULD.

Woman with red hair: BECAUSE I COULD SHOW YOU A GOOD TIME.

Caption (below comic): Seaworld's marketing strategies have gotten startlingly aggressive over the past few years.
comics.voteyText: The red-haired woman, smiling slyly: YOU, ME, AND AN ARMY OF DOLPHINS

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A blonde woman with long hair (seen from behind) sits across a small round table from a man with brown hair and a moustache. The man is wearing a teal/light-blue t-shirt printed with the words: "SUSAN! LOSE SOME GODDAMN WEIGHT!" Two cups of coffee/tea sit on the table.

Man: "WHAT?! IT'S NOT EVEN ABOUT YOU!"

Caption (below panel): "It's about the other Susan I'm dating!"
comics.voteyText:
A close-up of a woman's face, looking confused or wary.
Woman: "DO I KNOW YOU?"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

Bald man (sitting in a chair, holding a clipboard/book, wearing a green shirt and glasses): "HAVE YOU CONSIDERED THAT YOUR EXTREME VULNERABILITY TO SUGGESTION MIGHT STEM FROM YOUR DESIRE TO SLEEP WITH ME TONIGHT?"

Blonde woman (reclining on a lounge chair in a red swimsuit, one hand on her forehead): "OH MY GOD! OF COURSE!"

Caption (below panel): "Stephie had just realized the cure for cancer."
comics.voteyText:
Handwritten note at the top: "Note to self: Never draw perspective again."
Below it, a roughly sketched drawing of a woman's head and shoulders with a thought bubble, drawn in a deliberately crude/unfinished style.

comics.comicText:
A domestic kitchen/living-room scene. A woman with long orange hair (in a blue dress over a green top) stands at left preparing food at a counter. A blond man in a dress shirt and tie sits at right holding a newspaper.

Man: "Hey honey.. how was your day?"

Woman: "It was good."

Man: "That's good..."

Woman: "How was your day?"

Man: "Yeah, it was good, good."

Caption (below the panel): "...Slut."
comics.voteyText:
Label at top: "Reading this 10 years later..."
An older man with curly/wavy gray hair and a beard reclines, looking annoyed.
Older man: "Who writes this trash?!"

comics.comicText:
Main comic (single chaotic panel):

A monstrous creature with tentacles and antlers attacks a group of people in a laboratory-like setting. Vivid red background.

Sound effect / shouting (man with orange hair being grabbed): "ERKK!"

Sound effect / shouting: "AHHGH!"

Monster sound effect: "KWEEKGH!!!"

A green tentacle erupts from the orange-haired man's mouth/face. A man in a purple shirt recoils in horror in the foreground.

A man in the lower-left, looking shocked: "WAIT, WHY DOES IT HAVE TENTACLES?"

Label on a piece of equipment (an oscilloscope-like monitor showing a jagged green waveform): "TEST SUBJ. NO. 124"

Caption beneath the panel: "March 18, 1975: Lost Jennings and Turleton today. I'm beginning to wonder if the creation of this \"Cadbury Bunny\" is worth the large and growing body count."
comics.voteyText: A man in a suit sits with his eyes closed, holding a small cup. Speech bubble: "SOOO WORTH IT."

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A blond man in a brown suit jacket, white shirt, and red tie smiles broadly. A small burst near his mouth reads: "Hehe".

Man (speech bubble): "CHANGE SIR?"

A hunched figure with long grey hair, seen from behind, holds out a blue cup toward the man.

Caption (below panel): It was times like these when Gene really appreciated being a shapeshifter.
comics.voteyText:
A simple line-drawn dinosaur (resembling a tyrannosaur) faces left with its mouth slightly open.
Dinosaur (speech bubble): "GET IT?!"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Doctor (a man with orange hair, glasses, and a head-mirror, reading from a chart): MR. ROBERTS, I'M AFRAID YOU HAVE... FLANCER. WAIT, THAT CAN'T BE RIGHT.

Mr. Roberts (a brown-haired man in a blue sweater, mouth open in alarm): HUH...
comics.voteyText: The doctor (drawn in a loose sketch style), looking at the chart again: AHH. IT SAYS CANDIDA.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A muscular superhero with a yellow "S" emblem on his chest, dressed in a blue suit with a red cape, stands holding a lit cigarette and exhaling smoke. He has a mustache and slicked-back dark hair.

Superhero: KIDS YOU SHOULDN'T SMOKE BECAUSE YOU DON'T HAVE SUPER LUNGS LIKE ME.

Superhero: MMM. THAT'S GOOD.

Caption (below panel): Still, it was a lot more convincing than Batman's "utility lung" explanation.
comics.voteyText:
A close-up of a relaxed, smiling man with a cigarette in his mouth, exhaling smoke, eyes contentedly closed.
Man: I LOOK GREAT AND FEEL GREAT. THANKS, TOBACCO!

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

A young man with brown hair sits at a kitchen table reading a piece of mail. An older woman with gray hair, in a purple dress, stands at the stove cooking and turns to speak to him.

Older woman (at the stove): "ANY INTERESTING MAIL THIS MORNING, SON?"

The letter the young man is reading has the word "DIE" written on it in red.

Caption (below the panel): "She could at least have the courtesy to change her handwriting."
comics.voteyText:
A handwritten note in cursive:
"Dear Mother —
No. Thank you.
Sincerely,
Rob"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

A doctor in green scrubs, wearing a head mirror and glasses, stands in an exam room grinning and holding a pump-action shotgun raised overhead. Sound effect near the gun: "TCHK TCHK!"

Doctor: SEE! INOCULATION CAN BE FUN!

A child in a green shirt, blue shorts, and a red baseball cap sits on an exam table with their back partly turned, not reacting with enthusiasm. On the wall behind are an anatomical poster of a human body and a poster labeled "THE LUNGS." Small containers/vials sit on the counter.

Caption (below panel): Dr. Stern's novelty syringes didn't always go over as well as he'd hoped.
comics.voteyText:
Close-up of the smiling bald, glasses-wearing doctor.
Doctor: HOW ABOUT THIS ONE THAT LOOKS LIKE DOG POO?

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A man in a red and yellow Roman-style tunic stands hunched in front of a toilet, looking down at it with a pained, frustrated expression. The toilet bowl is filled with upward-pointing spikes or sharp objects.

Man: "GYAH! IF ONLY THERE WERE AN EASIER WAY!"

Caption (below panel): Toilet technology has advanced a lot since Roman times.
comics.voteyText:
A simple line-drawing close-up of a man's face, looking pensive.
Man: "MAYBE FIRE INSTEAD."

comics.comicText:
Main comic:

A close-up of two people facing each other: a blonde woman on the left and a brown-haired man on the right. A series of speech bubbles rises between them.

Bubble 1: "YOU'RE THE CUTEST!"

Bubble 2: "NO YOU ARE!"

Bubble 3: "YOU ARE!"

Bubble 4: "NO YOU!"

Bubble 5: "NO YOU"

Bubble 6 (trailing off, small): "NO YOU"

Caption below the panel: "The following day we conducted a formal double-blind study."

Caption: "Turns out we were both wrong."
comics.voteyText: A simple line-drawn face with a flat, unimpressed expression. A speech bubble above reads: "YOU'RE ONLY 0.4 MICRO-KITTIES."

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

A woman with orange hair in a green shirt holds out a small wooden box toward a blond man in a dark blue jacket.

Woman: I GOT YOU SOMETHING!

Man: HMM...

Sound effect (from the box): scratch-a scratch-a

Caption (below panel): Every year, two weeks before our anniversary, Polly would sever my right hand. I love her, but the unoriginality is *really* starting to irk me.
comics.voteyText:
Handwritten header: Reading this 10 years later...
A bearded man with a furrowed brow looks unimpressed.
Man: THAT'S NOT HOW HANDS WORK.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A man with brown hair, seated across a small round table from a blonde-haired woman whose back is to the viewer, leans forward uncertainly.

Man: "SUSAN, RIGHT?"

Caption (below comic): The silver anniversary got off to a rocky start.
comics.voteyText:
Close-up of the blonde woman's face, looking unimpressed.
Woman: "IT'S BOB."

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A man with the top of his skull missing and his brain partially exposed (called Norm) stands at left in a red shirt; a blonde woman in a purple shirt stands at right. They are outdoors among trees.

Norm: THIS IS ABOUT MY PARTIALLY EXPOSED BRAIN, ISN'T IT!? ISN'T IT!?

Blonde woman: NORM, YOU KNOW VERY WELL IT IS NOT. THE FACT OF THE MATTER IS...

Caption (below panel): Norm was right about why I left him. Fortunately, as expected he died of blood loss well before I finished my bogus explanation.
comics.voteyText:
A close-up of a man's face with the top of his skull missing, exposing his brain, with blood running down the side of his face.
Man: I AM OFFENDED

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

An alien in a red bodysuit holds up a bronze sword that is shattering against the iron sword of a human soldier wearing camouflage. Sparks fly at the point of impact.

Alien: BLAST! THEIR IRON IS MUCH STRONGER THAN OUR BRONZE!

Caption (below panel): The alien invaders were easily dispatched.
comics.voteyText:
Close-up on the alien's face, looking down at itself in alarm.
Alien: OH GOD I'M WEARING MY PAJAMAS!

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A man with red hair lounges on a yellow couch in a living room. A woman with curly brown hair sits in the foreground, holding a fan of Steven Seagal VHS tapes (titles visible: "Marked for Death," "Out for Justice," "Hard to Kill"). The man speaks.

Man: HONEY, I'M SORRY. I JUST DON'T SHARE YOUR PASSION FOR STEVEN SEAGAL MOVIES...

Caption (below panel): The poison moved slowly, but would soon reach her heart.
comics.voteyText:
A close-up of a bearded man's face looking up, with a speech bubble.
Bearded man: NO ONE WILL JUDGE ME

comics.comicText:
Main comic (single panel):

A crowd of children stands in a schoolyard against a brick wall. One child in the back, with brown hair, throws both hands up triumphantly and shouts.

Child (arms raised): "THAT'S RIGHT! I HAVE DOUBLE STIGMATA!"

In the foreground, a wide-eyed blond child looks horrified, one hand raised to his mouth.
comics.voteyText: A close-up line drawing of an open hand held up palm-out, with a wide, shocked face — two staring eyes and an open mouth — drawn into the palm and fingers.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A single close-up of a face split down the middle. One half (lit, with blonde/yellow hair) is light; the other half (with dark hair) is in shadow.

Caption (below panel): The weird thing about having two personalities is that it's not weird at all... jerk.
comics.voteyText:
A simpler line-drawn face looks confused.
Face (in speech bubble): I DON'T GET IT.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A man with a paper crown and an eyepatch, wearing a yellow shirt and blue pants, gleefully shoves another man (in a red shirt and tan pants) who is stumbling forward.

Crowned man: "OLÉ, MUTANT!"

Stumbling man: "Whoa!"

Caption (below panel): In the land of the blind, the one-eyed man is an ass.
comics.voteyText:
Close-up of the crowned, scowling man (the king) from the main comic.
King: "NO LENS REPAIR THERAPY FOR ANYONE"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

A muscular salesman in a red tank top with a large "C" on the chest stands behind a counter, holding up a green gym bag and gesturing toward a sign-up sheet. He pitches enthusiastically:

Salesman: "AND IF YOU SIGN UP RIGHT NOW... BOOYA! FREE GYM BAG!"

A man with orange/flame-like hair, seen from behind in a yellow shirt, listens skeptically with a hand to his face.

Caption (below panel): "This is the crematorium for me!"
comics.voteyText: A loose sketch of the back of a white t-shirt with the words "FEEL THE BURN" written across it in orange.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

A man (referred to in the caption as Steve) stands in a dark room, holding an axe and looking nervous. On his left, a red devil whispers in his ear; on his right, a white angel with a halo hovers near his other ear.

Devil: KILL YOUR WIFE!!!

Angel: Kill your wife... nicely?

Caption (below panel): Steve was new at this.
comics.voteyText:
Close-up of the smiling angel's face.
Angel: MARRIAGE IS ALL ABOUT COMPROMISE

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A Batman-like figure in a blue and gray costume stands over a fallen Joker-like figure (green hair, white face, wide grinning mouth). Batman is bleeding slightly and holds a smoking pistol.

Batman: "WOW. THAT WAS EASY. WHAT DID YOU CALL THESE?"

Caption (below panel): “Guns,” cooed Mary Marvel, as she took another slow drag off her hand-rolled cigarette.
comics.voteyText:
A close-up of the lower half of the Batman-like figure's cowled face, looking up.
Batman: "I'M GONNA KILL SO MANY MUGGERS!"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Mother (woman with blonde hair, red shirt): "Honey, your father and I want you to know that we don't blame you at all for what's happened."

Caption below panel: "I mean, how were you supposed to know you were personally ruining our marriage?"
comics.voteyText: Mother (in a simple line-drawing style): "Other than all the times we told you."

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

A man with brown hair, wearing a green shirt and blue pants, walks down a city sidewalk with his arm around a blonde woman in a purple dress. He is talking enthusiastically.

Man: "AND THAT'S WHY MOST OF MY APPENDAGES ARE MADE OF DEADLY GREAT WHITE SHARKS!"

The woman (Stephie), looking distressed: "WHY DO I ALWAYS DO THIS?"

There is a banana peel on the sidewalk near them.

Caption (below panel): Stephie had just noticed the wedding ring.
comics.voteyText:
A close-up of a great white shark's open, toothy mouth.
Shark: "IT'S PURELY A PHYSICAL THING!"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A blond man stands with his back to the viewer, writing on a green chalkboard.

Chalkboard: 2 + 2 = [4] (the 4 is boxed)

Man (speech bubble): I'M A GENIUS!

Caption below the comic:

The truth is, 2 + 2 = 5. It's just that every time someone tries to solve the problem, they make the same mistake.

Watch:

2 + 2 = 4. Dammit!
comics.voteyText:
A hand-written "proof" on a square of paper:
2 + 2 = 4
∞ + 2 + 2 = 4 + ∞
∞ + 2 + 2 = 4 + (∞ + 1)
∞ − ∞ + 2 + 2 = 4 + 1
2 + 2 = 5

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

Setting: a courtroom. A bald judge with a white beard, wearing a black robe and red tie, sits at the bench gesturing toward a blond man (the defendant) who points back at him.

Judge: DIIIID... YOU KILL HER?!

Blond man: FOR THE LAST TIME NO!

Caption (below panel): The defense was going poorly,
comics.voteyText:
A simple line-drawing of the same blond man looking suspicious.
Man: REVERSE PSYCHOLOGY, EH?
Nearby, the word "NO" is circled.

comics.comicText:
Main comic:

A single wide panel on a beach. In the sky above the ocean, a glowing figure resembling Jesus Christ descends in a radiant burst of yellow light, arms outstretched. On the sand below, a man with brown hair points excitedly at the figure while a blonde woman beside him raises a camera to photograph it.

Man: LOOK! IT'S THE SECOND COMING!

Woman: OOH!

Sound effects near the camera: *snap!* *snap!* *snap!*

Below the panel, three Polaroid-style photographs are scattered, each showing snapshots of the descending Christ figure against the radiant light. The photos are timestamped "04-10-05 11:59".
comics.voteyText:
A close-up of the bearded Christ figure's face, looking annoyed/exasperated.
Christ figure: FUCKIN' PAPARAZZI.

comics.comicText:
Main comic (single panel):

A man with brown hair in a green shirt and blue pants stands in a kitchen next to a green refrigerator. A blonde woman in a red tank top and tan shorts stands to the right.

Man: SO... HAVE YOU GOTTEN TO THE LAUNDRY YET?

Woman: NOPE!

Text on a to-do note stuck to the refrigerator:

TO DO TODAY:

1) Get Groceries

2) Stop Cheating on Bob

3) Laundry!
comics.voteyText:
Close-up of the smiling blonde woman's face.
Woman: I HIRED A LAUNDRY GUY.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Three people sit around a green gaming table playing a tabletop role-playing game. A young blond man in a "Star Wars Jedi" t-shirt raises a finger excitedly. Behind him hangs a red banner reading "DON'T PANIC." To his left is a man with glasses; to his right, an older bald man with glasses (the dad) holds a paper.

Blond young man: "I ATTACK THE GOBLIN KING!"

Bald older man (Dad, as the game master): "THE GOBLIN KING IS SLAIN BY A FAT 28-YEAR OLD VIRGIN."

Caption below panel: I guess dad didn't really see the appeal of our "Dungeons and Dragons" games.
comics.voteyText:
Close-up of the blond young man's face, distressed.
Young man: "DAD! THAT'S OOC!" (out of character)

comics.comicText:
Panel 1

A doctor or official wearing a head mirror and glasses, holding a clipboard, addresses a blond man in a red shirt.

Doctor: "Sir, your wife... is deceased."

Blond man: "Oh, heh. You're just reading it wrong. 'Deceased' is her name."

Caption (below panel): "Yes, that is also true."
comics.voteyText:
Caption (top): Me, reading this 10 years later
A hand-drawn bearded face exclaims: "WHAT A TWIST!"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A man with brown hair in a green shirt kneels on the ground, hands clasped, looking up at a woman with long orange hair in a pink tank top.

Man: WILL YOU... MARRY ME?

Woman: OF COURSE! OF COURSE I WILL!

Caption (below panel): "Just checking."
comics.voteyText:
A simple line-drawing close-up of a face (the woman) with a speech bubble.
Woman: YOU'RE CLINGY.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

A young man with light brown hair, wearing a yellow shirt, a blue bow tie, and blue suspenders, gestures with an open hand toward an older gray-haired man.

Young man: "I'm sorry, but the name has simply got to change!"

The older man, in a brown suit jacket and tie, shouts back angrily while clutching a red board game box.

Older man: "Damn your politics! It's just a game! The name means nothing!"

The red game box he holds reads: "NAHTZEE!" (a parody of "Yahtzee"), with small dice shown on it.

Caption (below panel): "Of course, Milton Bradley would be far more upset when he learned what new moniker lay in store for his favorite old-time classic, Worship-the-Fuhrer-opoly."
comics.voteyText:
A close-up of the older gray-haired man's face, glaring intensely.
Older man: "You are NOT changing 'Fuckers' to 'Checkers'"

comics.comicText:
Single panel: A family sits around a dinner table set with placemats, plates, drinks, and a vase of red flowers. A young woman with red hair, standing and gesturing emphatically with both arms raised, addresses an older couple seated across from her. Beside the young woman sits a large yellow robot with a single red eye.

Young woman with red hair: "WELL I DON'T CARE WHAT YOU THINK! KILLKULON AND I ARE GETTING MARRIED!!!"

Older man (gray-haired, in a light blue shirt): "OVER MY DEAD BODY!"

Caption below the panel: Killkulon was Mary's first cousin.
comics.voteyText:
A simple black-and-white panel showing the silhouette/outline of a person with long hair (a woman) seen from the side, speaking.
Woman: "BE MORE TOLERANT, OR DIE."

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A detective in a brown coat and fedora sits at a table in a dimly lit room. On the table is a handwritten note that reads: "YOU GUYS DID IT." In front of him stands a dark, featureless silhouette of a figure backlit against a window. A potted dead/bare twig sits in the corner.

Narration (caption below panel): "Be strong," muttered the detective, "don't fall for his head games."
comics.voteyText:
Close-up of the detective's face.
Detective (thought/speech): "DIABOLICAL"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

Man with brown hair in a red shirt (standing at a supermarket seafood/lobster counter): "HEY MAN! YOU CAN'T EAT THESE LOBSTERS! WHAT DID THEY EVER DO TO YOU?!"

Man with blond flame-like hair, wearing a green shirt with a peace symbol (arms spread, pointing): "THOSE LOBSTERS KILLED MY FAMILY..."

Caption (below panel): This was, of course, a lie. Most of my immediate family came out of the lobster attack relatively unscathed.
comics.voteyText:
First lobster: "UGH. HOW DO YOU EAT THOSE?"
Second lobster: "BUTTER. LOTS OF BUTTER."

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

Adult man (in green shirt, addressed as Uncle Jack, looking at his wet hand): "JIMMY... I HOPE THIS IS WATER..."

Boy (with curly orange/red hair, in a yellow shirt, smiling): "SORRY UNCLE JACK! IT'S SNOT" (with "SNOT" emphasized/underlined)

Caption (below the panel): Uncle Jack had no immune system.
comics.voteyText:
A close-up of a man's worried/annoyed face.
Handwritten text (his thought or speech): "HOW DID YOU GET IN MY BUBBLE?"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

A smiling man with brown hair stands in a kitchen, holding up a chain necklace toward a red-haired woman whose back is to the viewer.

Man: "HAPPY ANNIVERSARY!!"

The necklace's pendant reads: "MINE FOREVER"

Caption below the panel:

"Steve walked past Rhonda, and placed the necklace over the blender."

"Now the bitch knew where she stood."
comics.voteyText:
A loose, sketchy close-up of a woman's face looking confused/concerned.
Woman: "DO I KNOW YOU?"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Announcer (a man in a suit holding a microphone): "Isn't that AMAZING folks. They've been at it non-stop for nearly two months now!"

Two contestants sit across a table from each other, facing off. A sign on the front of the table reads: "STARING CONTEST WORLD CHAMPIONSHIP — DAY 59"

Caption (below the panel): Needless to say, both participants had long since died.
comics.voteyText: Text on a gravestone: "HE DIED AS HE LIVED: POINTLESSLY"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A room is engulfed in flames. On the wall is a wall-mounted emergency box with a glass front. A sign above the box reads: "IN CASE OF EMERGENCY BREAK GLASS". Inside the box is a folded card/note that reads: "CALL 911!". A man with brown hair wearing a green shirt stands in front of the box, looking at it, surrounded by fire.
comics.voteyText: The note from inside the emergency box is shown opened up. Handwritten text reads: "Tell them: 'Hey, there's a fire.' Then, replace glass."

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A man with short brown hair, seen from behind, opens a chest or container and looks inside. Inside sits a wicker basket holding a baby swaddled in a blue blanket, with a pacifier/rattle floating above.

Man (thought/speech): FREE BASKET!

Man (thought/speech): WAIT... WHAT THE HELL IS THAT THING?

A price tag hangs at the bottom of the image:

Tag: BASKET $9.95
comics.voteyText:
Close-up of the man's face, now drawn in a different (sketchier) style, looking annoyed/skeptical.
Man: That better include tax.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A graveyard funeral scene. A bald priest in black clerical garb stands at the edge of an open grave, arms thrown wide, head tilted back.

Priest: "AND NOW, RISE FROM YOUR GRAVE!"

Beside him stands a blond man in a black suit and tie, looking awkward. Several mourners in black are gathered in the foreground, seen from behind, one wearing a yellow veil. An open grave with a casket bearing a gold cross sits at lower right, gravestones in the background.

Caption (below panel): The only thing more uncomfortable than the ensuing ten-minute silence was the soft sound of bone tapping against wood.
comics.voteyText:
Close-up of the bald priest, smiling and pleased with himself.
Priest: "WOW! I'M LIKE A WIZARD!"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A superhero in a blue suit with a red cape and an "S" emblem on his chest rides a vintage penny-farthing bicycle (large front wheel, small rear wheel) down a city street, one fist raised.

Superhero: STOP CRIMINALS!

The bicycle's horn: HONK! HONK!

In the foreground, three bystanders look on: an older woman in purple, a man in a blue shirt wearing a black ski mask, and a blond man wearing a red bandana over his lower face.

Caption (below panel): I just can't take Superman as seriously since he lost his ability to fly.
comics.voteyText:
Close-up of the same superhero's face, looking annoyed/disgruntled.
Superhero: LUTHER'S DOWNTOWN? MAN I DO NOT WANT TO TAKE THE BUS

comics.comicText:
Setting: A courtroom. A woman with red hair in a pink top stands at a witness stand or behind a wooden barrier, gesturing angrily with raised fists. A blond-haired man in a suit (a lawyer) stands with his back to the viewer, one hand extended.

Red-haired woman (at the stand): "I did NOT kill and eat my husband!"

Lawyer: "That's fine, ma'am, but we were talking about the plaintiff's husband."

Red-haired woman: "No comment!"
comics.voteyText:
The red-haired woman (drawn in a loose sketch style), looking nervous, adds:
"I will, however, make the following yummy-noises."

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

A bearded man with long red/orange hair sits on a tiny desert island under a palm tree, surrounded by ocean. A wooden crate floats in the water at the lower left, stamped with text.

Crate text: "FRUIT: 1 IN 6 IS POISON"

Caption (below panel): After several agonizing days of soulsearching, Ralph finally opened the empty box.
comics.voteyText:
A crude line-drawn close-up of a man's face in profile, looking thoughtful.
Man (speech bubble): "MAYBE I CAN LICK THE BOTTOM"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

A young man with orange/red hair, wearing a yellow shirt, stands in a room pointing back over his shoulder with his thumb. A second person peeks out from behind a doorframe in the background.

Man (large speech bubble at top): "8... 9... 10... READY OR NOT, HERE I COME!"

Person peeking from doorway (small bubble): "WAIT..."

Man (lower bubble): "WAS I SUPPOSED TO TAG THEM OUT, OR STAB THEM TO DEATH?"

Caption below panel: "A very strange turn was about to befall our game of Hide and Stab."
comics.voteyText:
Close-up of a worried/grimacing face.
Face: "IF YOU'RE JUST GONNA TAG, WHAT'S THE POINT?"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A bald monk in red robes sits cross-legged in meditation on a large rock in a mountain landscape, beneath a tree.

Meditating monk (thought/speech bubble): DIVINE TRANSCENDENCE!

Two other bald monks in red robes stand to the side, one whispering to the other.

Whispering monks (jagged shout bubble): SNICKER SNICKER!

Caption (below panel): Tetsuo had been sitting on a syringe of morphine for just over seven hours now.
comics.voteyText:
A man's face in profile speaks toward the upper right.
Man: NOW HIT HIM WITH THE METH.

comics.comicText:
Main comic (single panel):

A frog-like king (named in the caption as Baron Frogulus) — a green humanoid frog wearing a gold crown, red cape, and red pants — stands beside a lake gesturing at a blonde princess seen from behind. He shouts in a speech bubble:

Frog king: "DAMMIT PRINCESS! YOU ONLY HALF-KISSED ME! YOU HAVE TO USE BOTH LIPS OR IT DOESN'T WORK!"

A small green frog sits on a rock at the water's edge near the princess.

Frog (small frog on rock): "Ribbit!"

Caption (below the panel): "Baron Frogulus would pop up from time to time and critique the princess' kissing technique."
comics.voteyText:
A crowned man's face in profile, looking deadpan.
Off-panel / first voice: "GET A HOBBY!"
Crowned man: "THIS IS MY HOBBY."

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

A balding man kneels in front of a TV, one arm thrust triumphantly in the air, pointing at the screen with his other hand. A blonde child sits beside him holding a game controller. A red-haired girl/woman in the foreground watches with a flat, unamused expression.

Man (shouting, speech bubble): "OH YEAH! WHO'S YOUR DADDY!?"

TV screen text: "PLAYER 1 WINS!"

Caption (below the panel): At first, I thought dad was just trying to be cool by using a modern colloquialism. But, as time wore on, he began to use the phrase even when he lost, sometimes adding "is it me... please?"
comics.voteyText: A stark black-and-white close-up of a man's face, looking pleadingly to the side, mouth slightly open. Hand-lettered text beside him reads: "LIE TO ME"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Batman (leaping in, arm outstretched): DROP IT CREEPAZOID!

Sound effect: THWACK!

A frightened man with curly brown hair (holding a small Batman action figure/toy): ZOIKS!

Caption (below panel): When a toy company infringes on your copyrights without paying out royalties, there's only one place you can find justice - the streets.
comics.voteyText: Batman (cowl visible in lower right, white silhouette against black): I AM THE NIGHT. PLEASE RESPECT THE NIGHT'S INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A man with orange/brown hair, in a blue suit, enters a bedroom carrying a briefcase and gesturing. In the bed are a blonde woman and a bare-chested man, both sitting up and looking caught.

Man in suit: "HONEY, I'M HO- OH GEEZ. NOW, SEE, THIS IS EXACTLY THE KIND OF THING OUR MARRIAGE COUNSELOR WAS TALKING ABOUT."
comics.voteyText:
Close-up on the woman's face, looking sheepish/sidelong.
Woman: "SHE MEANS NOTHING TO ME"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

An older balding man with glasses wearing a yellow shirt has his arm around a young red-haired boy in a blue shirt. The man is laughing.

Older man: SOMEDAY SON, YOU COULD BE VICE-PRESIDENT!

Older man: OR MAYBE PRESIDENT!

Older man: YOU! THE PRESIDENT? AHAHAHAHAHA!

Caption (below panel): Billy had been born in Canada.
comics.voteyText:
A close-up of the older man's face, looking sly/smug with a knowing smirk.
Older man: IT'S CALLED "TRUST," BILLY.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Professor Sanders (an older man with grey hair, wearing a yellow shirt, pointing angrily): "ALRIGHT MORONS, WE ARE JUST GOING TO SIT HERE UNTIL I FIND OUT WHO FILED A STUDENT COMPLAINT AGAINST ME!"

Professor Sanders: "WAS IT YOU, FATTY?!"

Professor Sanders: "OR WAS IT THE UGLY GIRL?!"

Caption below the comic:

Due to a clerical error, professor Sanders received his first ever student complaint one week before he was up for tenure.
comics.voteyText:
A close-up of professor Sanders looking embarrassed/apologetic.
Professor Sanders: "I AM SO SORRY. I THOUGHT FATTY WAS YOUR NAME."

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

An old white-bearded figure (depicted as God/Saint Peter) stands behind a podium up in the clouds, reaching down to hand a small tool to a blond young man below.

Bearded figure: "WELCOME TO HEAVEN, TODD. HERE'S YOUR CORNEA SCRAPER!"

Caption (below panel, the young man's thought/narration): "I'm glad I never sinned. I hear the cornea scrapers in Hell aren't nearly as effective."
comics.voteyText:
A close-up of a person holding a tool up to their own eye, scraping at their cornea.
Text (speech/label): "CLEAN LIVIN'"

comics.comicText:
Main comic (single panel):

A delivery room scene. A doctor wearing a head mirror and glasses holds up a just-born newborn baby. To his right stands a masked man in surgical scrubs pointing one finger up in the air. Behind them, a blond man in a green polo shirt looks on, and a red-haired person reclines on the delivery table.

Doctor (holding the baby): "IT'S A BOY!"

Masked man in scrubs (pointing upward): "DIBS!"

Blond man in green shirt (thought bubble): "DAMN!"
comics.voteyText:
A close-up of a man's face with a downcast, dejected expression.
Man: "Three times in a row!"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (main comic):

A balding man sits on the grass in a cemetery, leaning against a headstone, holding a beer bottle aloft toward it. The headstone reads: "FRED / 1939 - 2002".

Man: "WELL FRED, WE SURE HAD A LOT OF GREAT TIMES, DIDN'T WE?"

Caption below the comic:

"Fred and I love finding gravestones with our names on them and reminiscing about as if one of us were dead."

"Well, that is we did, until Fred passed away back in 2002."
comics.voteyText:
A simply drawn bearded face looking down, with a speech bubble.
Speech bubble: "CAPTION LENGTH IS THE SOUL OF WIT."

comics.comicText:
Main comic (single panel):

A wounded armored man (described in the caption as Ed), wearing a helmet with two swords stuck into the ground behind/around him and an arrow apparently through his head, crawls across a lawn toward a residential mailbox labeled "MAIL". He is bleeding and reaching out one arm.

Wounded man (shouting): "THE... MAIL... MUST... GET... THROUGH!"

In the background, two onlookers (a brown-haired person and a blond-haired person seen from behind) watch.

Caption (below panel): "Secretly, Ed wondered if there were an easier way to deliver mail-order weaponry."
comics.voteyText:
A roughly drawn man with a mustache stands beside a speech bubble.
Mustached man: "Please wait while I prepare your bullets."

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

A blonde woman in a pink top stands in a green kitchen with her back to the viewer, facing a man with reddish-brown hair in a yellow shirt and blue shorts who walks in holding a cell phone.

Woman: HOW'D IT GO?

Man: WELL, I DIDN'T HEAR ANYTHING NEGATIVE!

Caption (below panel): I guess my humor wasn't taking the edge off my syphillis test results.
comics.voteyText:
A close-up of the blonde woman, now smiling slightly.
Woman: Oh, wait, heh, I get it.

comics.comicText:
Sign above the ride entrance: TUNNEL OF LOVE

A woman riding in a swan boat with a man, entering a giant heart-shaped tunnel.

Woman: OH FRED! THIS IS SO ROMANTIC!

Caption below the panel: "Wait, this isn't the Tunnel of Hate. She's getting mixed signals!"
comics.voteyText:
A handwritten note pinned to a board reads:
Options:
- Tunnel of Love
- Tunnel of Hate
- Tunnel of boredom, verging on contempt

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A news reporter in a blue suit, red tie, and white shirt holds a microphone and gestures toward something off to the side. He has a grave, solemn expression.

Reporter: "AND THEIR YOUNG LIVES WERE TRAGICALLY CUT SHORT AS THE BLAZING INFERNO CONSUMED..."

In the background, near the reporter's gesturing hand, there is a yellow sign and a green bus/vehicle.

Caption below the panel: "Not. Wearing. Pants."
comics.voteyText:
A black-and-white sketch of the same reporter, now shown from a wider angle. He is wearing a shirt and tie on top but is visibly not wearing any pants below the waist, standing with his bare legs exposed. He gestures cheerfully.
Reporter: "AND NOW SPORTS!"

comics.comicText:
Single panel. A woman with blonde hair (left) and a man with brown hair (right) face each other in profile. A series of speech bubbles arranged vertically between them shows them talking over each other, alternating as the conversation overlaps.

Woman: HONEY, I WANTED TO SAY-

Man: OH, HEH...

Woman: I HAVE TO TELL YOU-

Man: WE KEEP SAYING THE SAME-

(beat: "...")

Woman: I... ALRIGHT.

Man: OKAY, I-

Woman: YOU FIRST!

Man: NO, YOU FIRST!

(beat: "...")

Woman: MY WATER BROKE.

Man: I THINK WE SHOULD SEE OTHER PEOPLE.
comics.voteyText: Man (face in close-up): LIKE FOR INSTANCE OUR BABY!

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Woman (older, red hair, purple suit, holding a notepad, seated in a chair): So, tell me - what are your feelings toward your mother?

Young man (red hair, green shirt, blue pants, lying on a couch with arms crossed): I don't think that's really a fair question...

Caption (below panel): Never get psychoanalyzed by a parent.
comics.voteyText: Close-up of the woman writing in her notepad. Her note reads: "Intimidated by presence of genius."

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A conquistador-style explorer in a red cape and metal helmet plants a flagpole on a sandy beach, a sailing ship anchored behind him.

Explorer: I CLAIM THIS LAND FOR PORTUG-

Explorer: WHAT THE?!

Explorer: DAMMIT! WHO SWITCHED THE FLAG?!

(The flag on his pole is the British Union Jack.)

Caption: The British Empire grew rapidly.
comics.voteyText:
A close-up of the explorer's bearded, dismayed face.
Text (handwritten): This suuuuucks!

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Lecturer (a man with curly brown hair, white shirt, red tie): "AS SOCRATES ONCE SAID, 'MWRAU RAGHGRA! MARARR-R-RAGH!'"

Lecturer (continuing, in a separate quote bubble): "'MWAHHH!'"

The lecturer stands at the front of a classroom, arms raised dramatically, in front of a blackboard scribbled with philosophical symbols and partial text ("PL...", a phi symbol, a cluster of circles, "WH... IS A... BUTTE..."). Three students (purple, green, and yellow shirts) sit watching from behind; one holds a paper labeled with scribbled text.

Caption (below the panel): What if Socrates had been a bear?
comics.voteyText: A close-up of a bear's face, looking thoughtful with a paw raised to its chin, with a small thought/speech bubble reading: "RAR?"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Man in foreground (seen from behind, name established as Lloyd by caption): "My head hurts a little."

Man with flame-like orange hair, grinning, holding up a jar: "HOW ABOUT SOME TYLENOL!?"

Label on the jar he is holding out: "RAT POISON"

Caption (below panel): It's tough having Lloyd as a roommate. On the plus side, now I know why my wife is dead.
comics.voteyText: The orange-haired man (now drawn with a flat, deadpan expression): "I'm not mad. Just disappointed."

comics.comicText:
Main comic (single panel):

A man with orange hair, in a green sweater and blue pants, grins and raises one finger triumphantly.

Man: HA!

His booted foot connects with a brown dog mid-kick, launching it into the air.

Sound effect: KICK!

Dog: BARK!

A blonde woman in a pink top and gray skirt stands in the background watching, looking unimpressed.

Caption (below panel): I'm beginning to wonder if Fred had an ulterior motive in buying me a puppy for Christmas.
comics.voteyText:
Close-up of the blonde woman's face, looking flat and resigned.
Woman (thought/speech): Should've said dog punting is a dealbreaker before we got married.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Fred (thought/dreamy): NATURE IS SO AMAZING... LOOK AT THAT CLOUD. IT'S SHAPED JUST LIKE A CRASHING PLANE.

Fred: WAIT A MINUTE.!

Fred: OH NO!

Caption: Fred had forgotten his wife's birthday.
comics.voteyText: A man (drawn loosely in sketch style): WHAT A TWIST!

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A man sitting at a restaurant table speaks to a woman across from him (seen from behind, with yellow hair). On the table in front of the man is a small bird.

Man: It's so nice to finally meet you.

Bird: Run! She's too fat! Run before she eats you!

Man: Shutup Rodney!

Bird (Rodney): You shutup!

Man: No YOU shutup!

Caption (below panel): Shirley glanced about nervously, beginning to sweat all over. "Geez, this is awkward," she muttered to herself, "Why won't he just let Rodney talk?"
comics.voteyText:
A close-up of the woman (Shirley) looking annoyed/unimpressed, with the small bird (Rodney) beside her.
Bird (Rodney): Grow up

comics.comicText:
Banner hanging above the room: SENIORS BINGO NIGHT

The bingo caller (a balding man standing at the front, holding a microphone): B-7!

The crowd of elderly players, all erupting at once: BINGO! BINGO! BINGO! BINGO! BINGO! BINGO! BINGO! BINGO! BINGO! BINGO! BINGO! BINGO! BINGO! BINGO! BINGO! BINGO! BINGO! BINGO! BING...

The caller (thinking, sweating): OH GOD... THEY SOLD US A DEFECTIVE KIT... BE COOL. STAY CALM... HOW MANY TOASTERS DO WE HAVE?

Caption: Even the most senile of players would remember the ensuing bloodbath for well over 20 minutes.
comics.voteyText: An elderly woman, gritting her teeth furiously, shouts: I WILL GUM YOU WITHIN AN INCH OF YOUR LIFE!

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A man with orange hair (seen from behind) speaks to a woman with yellow hair standing across a fence in a park.

Man: "Excuse me, I just saw you walk by, and I... I just... do you believe in love at first sight?"

Caption (below panel): In my excitement, I hadn't noticed the seeing eye dog.
comics.voteyText:
A close-up of the man's face. He gives a thumbs up.
Man: "Sorry, I don't speak sign language."

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel — a courtroom scene):

The defendant, a blond man in a suit standing at the witness stand with one finger raised: "I DIDN'T KILL MY WIFE! YOU HAVE TO BELIEVE ME! SCOUTS HONOR!"

From the jury box (filled with jurors): "GASP!"

The jurors, quieter: "murmur murmur..."

A bald judge sits at the bench on the left; another figure is seen from behind in the foreground.

Caption beneath the panel:

A hush fell over the jury. Foreman Susie squinted in the defendant's direction, rolling her loyalty badge over and over in her right hand.

"Alright," she whispered to herself, "I'll hear his story. But, if he's lying, he'll fry for this."
comics.voteyText: A round badge/button shown in close-up, drawn like a smiling cartoon face. Curved text along the bottom of the badge reads: "BLOODLUST!"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel, red background):

A cloaked, skull-faced figure of Death looms over a frightened man, holding a scythe.

Man: DEATH!

Death: STEVE! I HAVE COME FOR YOU!

Man: OH NO!

Death: WAIT... IS TODAY THE 24th OR 25th?

Death: 24th

Death: OH... NEVERMIND.
comics.voteyText: Death (now a black silhouette of the hooded figure leaving): Don't go anywhere, okay?

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Man (with red-orange hair, green shirt): BOBBY I THINK YOU'RE OLD ENOUGH NOW TO KNOW - SANTA ISN'T REAL

Muffled voice (from a bound figure in the background): MMF! MMF!

Child (Bobby, off-panel left): BUT HE JUST-

Man (interrupting, in a jagged starburst speech bubble): YOU SAW NOTHING!

[In the background, a figure dressed as Santa Claus is tied to a chair, gagged, struggling.]

Caption (below the comic): No, Santa isn't real. He hasn't been real since December 24th, 1986.
comics.voteyText:
[Two figures in tall pointed hats / hoods.]
Left figure: Santa says to avenge his death. [the words "his death" are underlined]
Right figure: Fuck him

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A man in a yellow shirt wearing a fedora with a "PRESS" card tucked in the band sits at a table, finger raised triumphantly. Across from him a woman with orange hair holds up a newspaper he has handed her.

Man: THIS JUST IN!

The newspaper headline reads: BLIND DATE HAS UNREASONABLY HIGH STANDARDS BASED ON OWN APPEARANCE

A small boxed item on the paper reads: YANKEES EYE FENNMAN (next to a tiny photo)
comics.voteyText:
Caption at top: LATER
The same man, now alone, head down and looking dejected, holds a sheet of paper. His PRESS hat sits discarded in the upper corner of the panel.
The paper he holds reads (handwritten): Man with at-home Printing Press still alone and sad

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Teacher (a woman with orange hair, holding a stack of papers): CLASS, I WANT YOU TO KNOW THAT I DIDN'T USE THE LETTER-BASED SYSTEM TO GRADE YOUR PAPERS. I THINK IT'S A SILLY, UNREALISTIC METHOD. I MEAN, YOU CAN'T JUST BOIL AN INDIVIDUAL DOWN TO AN A- OR A B+, CAN YOU?

Teacher: ANYWAY, HERE ARE YOUR PAPERS. BILLY ANDERSON?

Billy (a student): HERE!

Panel 2:

(Close-up of a graded paper. Header reads "BILLY" and "Essay." Scrawled across it in large red handwriting:) STUPID! STUPID! STUPID!
comics.voteyText: (A graded paper with red handwriting:) also, your hair sucks

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Man (kneeling, proposing): SUSAN, WILL YOU MARRY ME?

Susan: OH JOHNNY! YES! YES!

Caption (below panel): Three-thousand dollars later, it's still the best prank I ever pulled on my twin brother.
comics.voteyText: A grinning man (the twin brother): LOOK AT THAT SUCKER WITH HIS HAPPY MARRIAGE.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A blond man in a red shirt holds up an open pack of cigarettes and addresses it.

Blond man (to the cigarette pack): I DON'T NEED YOU ANYMORE...

Behind him, a crowd of people cheers and shouts encouragement.

Crowd member: ALRIGHT!

Crowd member: WE KNEW YOU COULD DO IT!

Crowd member: YEH!

Crowd member: WE'RE SO PROUD OF YOU, SON!

Caption (below panel): Steve would later claim he was speaking exclusively to the third cigarette from the left.
comics.voteyText:
Close-up of a man's face with a single cigarette in his mouth. A thought/speech bubble points to that one cigarette.
Text (pointing to the cigarette): Smoking (that particular cigarette) is not cool!

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A smiling woman with long brown hair, wearing a green shirt, holds up a lit lighter or torch toward a bald man in a gray tank top.

Woman: "HI HONEY! WHAT DO YOU THINK OF MY -"

Sound effect (flames): "SHWUSH!!"

Caption (below panel): Apparently, Ed wasn't very impressed with my new haircut.
comics.voteyText:
Close-up of the bald man (Ed) with a flat, serious expression.
Ed: "This is the only way to be sure."

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Child (Susie, in bed): DADDY! THERE'S A MONSTER IN MY CLOSET!

Father (standing in a doorway down the hall): A MONSTER?!

Caption (bottom of panel): Fortunately, Susie's doors lock from the outside.
comics.voteyText:
A frightened figure huddled under a white blanket, only its worried face peeking out.
Figure: They won't get me in this blanket!

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A blond man in a red shirt and a brown-haired woman in an orange shirt stand together with their backs to the viewer, the woman pointing up at a stork flying in from the right. The stork carries a baby in a bundle held by its beak.

Woman: "THE STORK! OUR SON IS HERE!"

Caption (below panel): "We were both glad when the stork finally gave back our baby."
comics.voteyText:
A crude black-and-white drawing of a bird (a stork) with an annoyed expression.
Stork: "This thing is useless!"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A doctor (a man wearing scrubs, sunglasses, and a head mirror) hands something to a blonde woman in a hospital bed who is holding a swaddled bundle.

Doctor: HERE YOU ARE, MRS. SANDERSON.

Mrs. Sanderson: OH THANKYOU DOCTOR, I... WAIT, DIDN'T I GIVE BIRTH TO A HUMAN BABY?

(The bundle she is holding clearly does not contain a human baby — small flame-like shapes poke out of it.)

Doctor's inner thought (caption at bottom): UH OH. SHE CAN'T KNOW THAT YOU LOST THE BABY! OH GOD, SHE'S LOOKING AT YOU! QUICK! SAY SOMETHING CLEVER!

Doctor (small text below): "Uhhh... No?"
comics.voteyText:
Close-up on Mrs. Sanderson's face, glaring angrily through her glasses.
Mrs. Sanderson: And how dare you question my medical expertise!?

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Patient (a bald man, anxious): DOC! I'M HAVIN' THESE REALLY BAD =ERK= CHEST PAINS!

Doctor (a man with a head mirror and round glasses, holding a clipboard): WOW. CHEST PAINS. THAT'S REAL ORIGINAL.

Clipboard (held by the doctor, scoring the patient):

CREATIVITY [2]

WEEKS TO LIVE [1]

STYLE [6.5]
comics.voteyText:
The doctor (round glasses, mustache) looks unimpressed.
Doctor: Being a doctor sucks. It's nothing like on TV!

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

The Grinch (in a Santa suit, thinking/singing): "They're singing! They're singing! They're actually singing! Their carolers still caroling! Their sleigh bells still ringing!"

"They're dancing a dance! They're singin a song! Could it be I've misjudged Christmas' love all along?"

Caption (below panel): The Grinch was, however, still refusing to give back either Thanksgiving or Easter.
comics.voteyText:
Close-up of the Grinch's face in the Santa hat.
The Grinch: "I only feel empathy after failure!"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A doctor in blue scrubs and glasses, with a head mirror on his forehead, gestures with open hands toward a patient. The patient, a man with orange/red hair, lies in the foreground looking up at him.

Doctor: HEY, LET'S NOT DWELL ON THE NEGATIVES HERE, OKAY? SEVERAL PARTS OF YOUR SURGERY WERE DONE CORRECTLY.
comics.voteyText:
A grinning man's face (drawn in loose black-and-white line art).
Caption (handwritten): I've got to hand that to you!

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A man (Ted) sits at a desk, holding a pen over a sheet of paper that reads "DEAR JOHN". He rests his chin on one hand, looking troubled. To his left, a small red devil with a pitchfork floats in the air shouting. To his right, a small yellow car (a Civic) floats in the air.

Devil: KILL THE CHILDREN!

Car: DRIVE A CIVIC!

Caption (below panel): The advent of psychic advertising was not without its drawbacks.

Caption (below panel): Fortunately, Ted soon figured out a way to combine the two viewpoints.
comics.voteyText:
A close-up of a grinning face with a speech bubble above it.
Voice: Multitasking!

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

Two men sit across a table from each other. On the left, a balding older man in a suit with a red tie. On the right, a man in a green military uniform with a peaked cap and a mustache, his arms crossed.

Man on left: "DAMN."

Man in military uniform: "DAMN. HEADS."

On the table between them sit two coffee cups on saucers and a metal coffee pot.

Caption (below panel): "Thus began the Cold War."
comics.voteyText:
A hand-drawn arrow points up toward the military uniform from the main comic, with the caption:
"How all Russians dress, all the time."

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

A bloodied Batman-like superhero in a gray-and-blue costume with a yellow bat emblem stands against an orange background, riddled with bullet wounds, laughing as he is shot.

Batman-like hero: "YOU'RE SERIOUSLY USING KRYPTONITE BULLETS?! THAT'S SUPERMAN'S WEAKNESS YOU IDIOT! AHAHAHA! =GHACK="

A hand at lower right holds a gun pointed at him; a second figure (a person with light hair, seen from behind/side) reacts.

The second figure: "HA!"

Caption below the panel: "So, yeah, the funeral will be on Friday."
comics.voteyText:
A simple line-drawing close-up of a bat-eared head (the same Batman-like hero, drawn crudely) looking down at itself.
Hero: "Whoa. What's all this red stuff?"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (main):

A football game in progress on a green field with a yellow goalpost and blue sky behind. A player in a blue jersey and silver/gray helmet (jersey number partly hidden) holds a football aloft in one hand, shouting in triumph. With his other hand he points a handgun, which fires with a yellow muzzle-flash burst, at an opposing player in a tan/olive jersey, who is flung backward off his feet. Other players (one in a blue jersey marked "1", others in tan) struggle in the background.

Triumphant player: "OH YEAH!"

Caption (below panel): "It wasn't the play we'd rehearsed, but before you knew it, I was wide open in the end zone."
comics.voteyText:
A close-up of a referee in a black-and-white vertical-striped shirt and cap, looking grim. He speaks.
Referee: "Technically, there are no rules regarding firearms"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

A singing animatronic figure sits at a small computer desk inside a dark ride attraction, raising one hand. Behind it stands a larger animatronic man in a suit and tie, also with one hand raised.

Seated animatronic (singing, with music notes): "THIS REALLY ISN'T WHERE I WANTED TO BE AT AGE 40!"

Standing animatronic man (singing, with music notes): "GET BACK TO WORK YOU IDIOT!"

In the foreground, a man and a woman ride past in a boat, watching the scene.

Caption below the comic: "In 2011, in a bid to appeal more to adult audiences, Disneyland replaces "It's a Small World" with "It's a Cold And Unforgiving Hell.""
comics.voteyText:
Header: "Reading this in 2015:"
A bearded man rests his face on his hand, looking glum.
Man: "But I was so sure of that prediction."

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A blonde woman sits in a chair at the bedside of a child tucked into bed in a dark bedroom.

Woman: "Sweetie, please try to sleep. There's no man in your closet. See, there's the corpse of the guy who WAS there. But now he's dead, so you can relax."
comics.voteyText:
Close-up of the same woman smiling.
Woman: "Here, I'll put in an air freshener!"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A man with brown hair in a green shirt sits at a dinner table across from a woman with long orange hair in a pink shirt. He gestures with an open hand as he speaks.

Man: LISTEN, IT'S NOT ANYTHING ANYONE DID. I THINK WE'VE BOTH JUST CHANGED A LOT, YOU KNOW? FOR EXAMPLE, I NOW HATE YOU.
comics.voteyText:
A loose sketch of the same man's face, smiling slightly.
Man: Because you're unlovable!

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A man in a tuxedo and bow tie (Todd) stands at the altar, reading from a sheet of paper he holds in his hands. He faces a bride in a yellow dress (seen only partially at the right edge).

Todd: "I WAS HOPING YOU COULD, LIKE, LOSE SOME WEIGHT..."

Caption (below panel): Todd's wedding vows were less than inspired.
comics.voteyText:
A simpler line-drawn man with wavy hair is speaking.
Man: "I vow to let constant judgment corrode our rehtionship." [text reads "rehtionship" as drawn]

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

A man in a blue suit and red scarf sits at a yellow dining table. His head has been violently severed at the neck, with blood spraying upward in droplets and pooling across the table. A severed human head with closed eyes rests on a red platter on the table in front of him. The man's hand holds a spoon dipping into a bowl. The room has framed pictures on the wall and a potted plant on a side cabinet.

Caption (below panel): Todd was really bad with spoons.
comics.voteyText: A close-up line drawing of the severed head lying on the platter, eyes closed. A thought bubble above it reads: "This sucks."

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A blonde adult sits at a breakfast table reading a newspaper, pointing a revolver across the table at a young boy who is eating.

Adult (speech bubble): "MOUTH CLOSED."

Sound effect (near the revolver): "*click*"

Caption (below the comic): "I know my parenting seems a little unorthodox, but I'm sorry, the 9 milimeter just wasn't getting the job done."
comics.voteyText:
A close-up sketch of the blonde adult's face.
Adult (speech bubble): "This would hurt me more than it'd hurt you."

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A young boy with orange hair in a red shirt sits at a small table across from a man (seen from behind), with what appears to be a chess set between them.

Boy: CHECKMATE MR. KASPAROV!

Man: AMAZING!

Caption (below panel): None of the other children could match Billy's ability to say "Checkmate."
comics.voteyText:
Close-up of the man's face, looking moved/teary-eyed.
Man: So beautiful...

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A mother sits on the edge of a child's bed, one arm around a small pigtailed girl who sits on the bed looking apprehensive.

Mother: "Sweetie, I know it's not the nightlight you wanted, but Daddy spent all weekend making it, so you'll just have to LEARN to like it, okay?"

(Below the panel: the homemade "nightlight" sits on the floor — a dark gray box with skeletal mechanical arms, a glowing skull face, and lettering across its front.)

Nightlight text: "YOU WILL DIE SOON"
comics.voteyText:
Close-up of a man (the father) speaking proudly, with a doodle/sketch visible beside him.
Father: "I'm an animator! Like Walt Disney!"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Bald man (angry): I can't believe after 14 years of marriage I catch you cheating on me!

Woman (pleading): Would you RELAX? I TOLD you - I was hoping you were dead!
comics.voteyText: Woman (continuing): I mean, you look preeeetty corpsy.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A woman with orange hair, wearing a pink shirt, speaks to a man (seen from behind, his bare back to the viewer). She holds something against him.

Woman: "I'M SORRY, BUT I CAN'T BE WITH SOMEONE WHO DOESN'T BELIEVE IN THIS!"

The object she is pressing on/showing reads: "I SMELL" (yellow lettering)

Caption (below panel):

"What if it wasn't a cross that Jesus was put on?"
comics.voteyText:
A man's face (in profile, sketchy black-and-white style) looks up toward an object on a post/stand at right.
Man: "Aw c'mon!"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A green-skinned villain (referred to in dialogue as Doctor Apocalypse) looms large, laughing.

Man with brown hair in a blue costume: "YOU'LL NEVER STOP ME, DOCTOR APOCALYPSE!"

Doctor Apocalypse: "OH WE'LL JUST SEE ABOUT THAT TURBO-JERK! AHA! HA! HAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAH HAHAHA!!!"

Caption (below panel): "Turboman killed a whole lot of toddlers before Doctor Apocalypse was able to stop him."
comics.voteyText:
A sad-faced man with a speech bubble.
Man: "I laugh so I don't cry"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A man with brown hair grabs a screaming woman with reddish-brown hair from behind, gripping her tightly. Both have their arms flung out wide.

Woman: "OW! OW! OKAY, OKAY! I'll DO IT!"

Man: "H-R-R-R-GH! H-R-R-R-GH!"

Caption (below the panel): "And that, son, is how I convinced your mother to marry me."
comics.voteyText:
A close-up of a man's face looking weary or resigned.
Man: "Call me old-fashioned, but I use guttural noises to express dominance."

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Extreme close-up. A large person looms over a smaller person, pressing what appears to be a book (likely a Bible or religious pamphlet) up against the smaller person's face. The smaller person's eyes are wide.

Looming person (shouting): YEH?! WELL HOW ABOUT NOW?! HUH?!

Caption (below panel): The Jehovah's Witnesses have gotten a lot more converts this year.
comics.voteyText:
Close-up of the smaller person's face, looking miserable.
The smaller person (thinking/saying): I regret inviting you in for tea.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A man with wide, glowing yellow eyes and a strained grin clutches a meat cleaver to his chest with both hands. Behind him, through a doorway, a woman and a small child are visible in another room.

Man (thought/speech): BUT I DON'T WANNA KILL MY FAMILY... NO!... NO I SHOULDN'T. I-I'LL JUST WATCH A LITTLE TV. YEAH. THAT'S IT. NICE RELAXING TV...

Panel 2:

A television set with rabbit-ear antennas displays a checkmark (the Nike swoosh) and text.

TV: [swoosh checkmark] JUST DO IT.
comics.voteyText:
A close-up of the man's face, now distraught. A speech bubble points off toward a dripping, blood-soaked object (a shoe/cleaver).
Man: I'm suing Nike.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

Setting: A courtroom. A lawyer in a blue suit with reddish-brown hair stands facing a judge seated at the bench. In the foreground, the backs of two people's heads are visible (a blonde person on the left, a person on the right), like members of a jury or gallery.

Lawyer: AND MY CLIENT WILL CONTEND THAT HE IN FACT SAID "I DUE" - D-U-E.

Someone (off to the right, speech bubble): GASP!

Caption (below panel): And that's why I don't pay child support!
comics.voteyText:
A loosely drawn, sketchy smiling face (the groom from the wedding-vow joke) looks up and to the side.
Handwritten text: You totally got me!

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Off-panel voice (probation board): "And what would you do if released?"

Seated man in orange (handcuffed prisoner): "Eat your children!"

Caption (below panel): The probation board found Toddler-Eatin' Ted's honesty very refreshing.
comics.voteyText: A bald, smiling man wearing round glasses says: "You're a real character!"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

An older balding man sits up out of an open casket at a funeral, arms raised.

Man in casket: "HEY WAIT! I'M NOT DEAD!"

In the foreground, a younger person with long hair and a mustache stands looking annoyed, fists clenched.

Caption (below panel): Once again, dad was ruining the funeral.
comics.voteyText:
A close-up of the older man's face, smirking knowingly.
Man: "I have been planning this for years!"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A woman with brown hair clenches her teeth and raises her fists, glaring intensely at two children (boys) seen from behind in the foreground.

Woman (speech bubble, a furious growl): "Grrr--- ---rrr---"

Caption (below the panel): "We couldn't afford braces growing up, so after school mom would take us aside and just glower at our teeth for hours on end."
comics.voteyText:
A close-up of a person's face with a deeply displeased, scowling expression and prominently crooked teeth.
Handwritten text: "Shame is nature's orthodontia"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Man (brown-haired, in a yellow shirt and blue tie, pointing at his date): "You know, once I got over the occasional obnoxious outbursts, you're actually a pretty good date."

As he points, a red starburst erupts from his pointing hand with the word: "FAT!"
comics.voteyText:
Caption (handwritten at top): "Reading this in 2015"
A bearded man rests his head on his hand, looking weary, with a speech bubble: "The jokes get better, right?"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A man and a woman lie in bed together under a blue blanket, both apparently nude, holding hands and smiling.

Man (speech bubble): I MUST'VE MARRIED THE MOST WONDERFUL WOMAN IN THE WORLD!

Woman (small text near her): AWWW...

Caption (below panel): Sheila loves hearing me compliment my wife.
comics.voteyText: Handwritten note: Later, this turned out to be an actual fetish. (thanks internet!)

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Daughter: BOBBY AT SCHOOL SAID I WAS UGLY DADDY!

Father: SWEETIE, DON'T LET THAT BOTHER YOU. LOTS OF PEOPLE THINK YOU'RE UGLY.

Caption (below panel): I started to protest, but his list was rather extensive.
comics.voteyText: A smiling person says: I'll just have to kill the pretty ones.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A magician in a tuxedo with a red bow tie and red cummerbund stands on a stage before a red curtain. One hand is raised triumphantly while the other reaches into a black top hat sitting on a purple-draped table, pulling out a small brown teddy bear instead of a rabbit.

Magician: WHAT THE?!

Caption (below panel): This was definitely not the ace of spades.
comics.voteyText:
A person with curly hair, drawn in a loose sketch style, looks on.
Person: That's preeeetty much what rabbits look like.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Elderly man (the grandfather): IN MY DAY, WE GOT BIRTHDAY PUNCHES WITH BRASS KNUCKLES!

Woman (the mother): OH DAD, YOU DID NOT.

Caption (below the panel): Mom smiled down at me softly as she gingerly tightened another layer of linen around her fist.
comics.voteyText: Close-up of a stern-faced older man: KIDS THESE DAYS ARE WAY TOO EMPATHETIC.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A person with flame-like orange hair, seen from behind/over the shoulder, sits at a desk filling out a form.

Person (thought bubble): HMMM...

The form on the desk reads:

Form question: ARE YOU A DOCTOR?

Checkbox option: YES.

Checkbox option: NO.

Checkbox option: THE DUODENUM!!

Caption (below panel): Getting into med school has gotten a lot harder these days.
comics.voteyText:
A man with curly hair speaks.
Man: There really should be an essay section.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A woman with brown hair (seated at a table) speaks emphatically toward a translucent, glowing ghost of an old bald man hovering above the table. A boy with orange hair sits with his back to the viewer.

Woman (to the ghost): WAIT... WHOSE DEATH AM I AVENGING NOW?

Ghost (the old man): YOURS! FOR THE LAST TIME YOURS! WHO ELSE WOULD IT BE?!

Boy (turned toward the ghost): WHO ARE YOU?!

Caption (below panel): We all kinda wished grandpa had been brutally murdered before he went senile.
comics.voteyText:
Close-up of the brown-haired woman scowling, looking up and to the side.
Woman: Shape up or I am calling the exorcist!

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

Man in orange shirt: BUT HOW COULD YOU BE PREGNANT IF I'VE BEEN GONE FOR A YEAR?

Blonde woman in pink shirt: BUT YOU'VE BEEN HOME FOR SIX MONTHS NOW!

Man in orange shirt: NO I HAVEN'T! I... WAIT A MINUTE!

Man in orange shirt (to a second, near-identical man crouching/leaning at lower right): FRAAANK!

Second man (Frank): HYUH HYUH!

Caption below the panel: My twin brother's a funny guy. Fun-ny. Shame about his accident.
comics.voteyText: Close-up of a stern-faced man. Speech bubble: There can be only one.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A lawyer in a blue suit stands in a courtroom, gesturing emphatically and shouting, addressing a jury or courtroom seen from behind.

Lawyer: "OKAY, LET'S SAY MY CLIENT KILLED HIS WIFE. WHAT ABOUT THE PEOPLE HE DIDN'T KILL?! THAT'S SIX BILLION PEOPLE! DON'T THEY MATTER?"

Lawyer: "DON'T THEY MATTER?!"

Caption (below panel): In an alternate universe, Jeffrey Dahmer has a thank you parade every year.
comics.voteyText:
A close-up of a man's face (the lawyer) with a furrowed, indignant expression, speaking.
Man: "People are starving in Bangladesh, but all you care about is one rich guy in the US."

comics.comicText:
Title banner: SMBC PRESENTS

WHAT'S THE DIFFERENCE?

(ANSWER ON BOTTOM)

Two nearly identical panels are shown side by side, presented as a spot-the-difference puzzle.

[Left panel and Right panel — both show the same scene:]

A laughing man with brown hair, mouth wide open, holds a large blue jug labeled "ACID!" (the letters A-C-I-D in red and dark coloring). Yellow liquid pours from the bottom of the jug onto the ground. A sign with an arrow points at the pouring liquid, reading "DUCKLINGS". Background is filled with repeated "HAHAHAHA" laughter text.

Bottom (printed upside-down):

A: Now you're a bad person!
comics.voteyText: Handwritten text on a plain note: "No ducklings were unharmed in the creation of this comic."

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A huge red devil with horns, fangs, and a pointed tail looms over a small blonde man who sits at a table eating from a bowl with a spoon.

Man: My banana split doesn't have enough whipped topping...

Devil (large jagged text): THAT'S BECAUSE YOU'RE IN HELL!

Caption below the panel:

Since most devils are actually angels fallen from Heaven, they don't really have a good sense of how to torture.

So, basically what I'm saying is - you know that busload of nuns you forced into the Grand Canyon? Don't lose too much sleep over it.
comics.voteyText: A hand-drawn line graph. The vertical axis is labeled "quality of comic" and the horizontal axis is labeled "length of caption." A red curve rises steeply upward to the right, indicating quality increases as caption length increases.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

A naked woman lying in bed, head thrown back, one arm raised behind her head, laughing in pleasure as a dark-haired man's head is between/near her chest.

Woman: "OH STEVE!"

Man: "HEY!"

Caption (below panel): "How the hell does she know my name!"
comics.voteyText:
Close-up of the man's face, looking unimpressed/sidelong.
Man (thought/speech in bubble): "SO CLINGY."

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A blond superhero in a blue costume with a domed mask confronts a green-and-red costumed figure with a small mustache against a colorful cityscape backdrop. The hero brandishes what appears to be a small object (resembling a thermometer or stick) toward the other figure.

Hero (blue costume): "YOU'RE UNDER ARREST PTERRORDACTYL!"

Green/red figure: "OH WE'LL SEE ABOUT THAT AQUAJERK!"

Caption (below panel): "I don't think I like your tone very much," muttered AquaJerk.
comics.voteyText:
A close-up of the blond hero's smiling face.
AquaJerk: "I have the power to be passive-aggressive with the creatures of the sea!"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Two surgeons in blue scrubs, surgical masks, and head mirrors stand over a patient lying on an operating table. The lead surgeon is operating on the patient's head with a tool, while a bag of blood hangs on an IV stand beside them.

Surgeon (operating): NOW WE MAKE A MINOR INCISION IN THE CORPUS CALLOSUM. YOU MAY NOTICE SOME BLEEDING, WHICH IS TO BE EXPECTED.

Caption (below panel): The kidney transplant was going poorly.
comics.voteyText:
A simple sketch of a person's face (the surgeon) with a worried/uncertain expression, raising a hand to his chin.
Surgeon (thinking/speaking): Kidneys diffuse, right?

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A man with graying hair, wearing a yellow shirt, gestures toward a young boy with red hair in a green shirt. They stand in a room with a framed picture on the wall.

Man: KNOCK KNOCK.

Boy: WHO'S THERE!?

Man: NOT MOMMY EVER AGAIN.

Caption below the comic: Still, it was better than my initial idea for "Why did the chicken cross the road?" Your mother's a corpse.
comics.voteyText:
A roughly sketched close-up of the man's face with a speech bubble.
Man: Why did she fail to cross the road?

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Man (Todd, entering with a grocery bag, arm raised, two scantily dressed women behind him): "HONEY! I'M BACK! AND I BROUGHT SOME FILTHY WHORES!"

In the foreground, the back of a person's head (the partner he's addressing) is visible.

Caption: "Apparently, Todd had made some creative changes to the grocery list."
comics.voteyText:
A handwritten grocery list on a square scrap of paper:
- Regular whores
- Pie
- FILTHY WHORES (written larger and bolder)

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A bald, bearded man in an orange jumpsuit, one wrist shackled with a chained cuff, is using a handsaw to saw through his own arm at the wrist/forearm. He is screaming.

Man: PAIN ISN'T REAL! THE FLESH IS WEAK! THE FLESH IS WEAK!

Caption (below panel): Nothing was gonna keep me from that PTA meeting.
comics.voteyText:
The same bald man, now calm and tidy, sits in a sparse room speaking up.
