Man: I have some concerns about after school programs.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1

A man (named Ted, per the caption) sits beside a blonde woman. The woman speaks:

Woman: "And so now I'm just really sensitive about my appearance. I take everything personally, you know?"

Ted: "Hey, that's okay. I hear a lot of fat chicks feel that way..."

Caption (below the panel):

"Not that that applies to you, of course," Ted noted quickly, "but I don't have much advice for unattractive girls with... just... really awful hair. I mean wow. Maybe conditioner? Something."
comics.voteyText:
A close-up of the blonde woman looking down, displeased, with a speech bubble:
Woman: "Your hair is so fake, it looks like a webcartoonist drew it."

comics.comicText:
Main comic:

A single panel, close-up profile of a rough-looking, scarred man with stubble, against an orange background. A large knife or blade is visible in front of his face.

Man: "You know, the weird thing was that, as I strangled him, I could feel his soul bleeding out through my fingers, down into the dirt. That's how I know there's a hell, and that some day I'll bleed down into it too."

Caption (below panel): "We're currently considering other babysitting options."
comics.voteyText:
Top bar reads: "Reading this in 2015"
A balding, slightly older man looks contemplative.
Man: "Must've been a bad week in my personal life?"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

A press conference scene. At a podium stands a bald, baby-faced figure (the "President Toddler") with arms raised, grinning.

Reporter (standing in the crowd, holding papers, back to viewer): "President Toddler! What do you say to allegations that your administration sold plutonium to rogue nations, then tortured and killed American citizens to hide the truth?"

President Toddler (at podium): "UH! OH!"

The foreground shows the backs of several seated audience members and a hand raised in the air.
comics.voteyText:
A close-up of the same baby-faced President Toddler, looking sheepish/apologetic.
President Toddler: "SOWWWYYY" (baby-talk for "sorry").

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

An older man (the dad) sits at a table covered with papers and an open book, holding a pencil and working through calculations. A young boy sits beside him, smiling.

Dad: "AND SO THE SUM SHOULD BE NO GREATER THAN $114.27"

Caption (below panel): Dad gave a fairly pragmatic version of "the talk."

A close-up of a sneering, wide-eyed person (drawn in a loose sketchy style) with a speech bubble.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Guard (a man in a black suit with glasses, seen from behind): SIR, I CAN'T JUST LET YOU INTO THE PRESIDENT'S PRESS CONFERENCE.

Man with reddish-orange hair in a green jacket: OH?! WELL MAYBE THIS WILL CHANGE YOUR MIND!

The man holds up a sheet of paper. The paper reads: I HAVE A MYSPACE ACCOUNT
comics.voteyText: A loosely sketched man: Myspace jokes will never get old!

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Man (the dad): AND THAT'S WHERE BABIES COME FROM.

Young girl: EWWW...

Caption (below panel): Even at a young age, I was disgusted by that thing on dad's forehead.
comics.voteyText: The dad (close-up, looking unsettled): It's a birthmark!

comics.comicText:
Title banner: SMBC PRESENTS: EPISODES IN ETYMOLOGY (word origins)

Panel 1:

A blonde person (excited, pointing): "Look at this sandwich! It's as big as a submarine!"

A man in a fedora and red vest (thoughtful, hand to chin): "Sandwich? Submarine?! That's it!"

Caption below the panel: December 3, 1928: The first recorded use of the word "fat-ass."
comics.voteyText: A close-up of a man's startled face shouting: "FIRE THE TORPEDOES!"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Father (a man with brown hair, in a green collared shirt): "Of course democracy is best for a COUNTRY. But, for the family unit, we have something like communism. We all share our income for the common good."

Daughter (a girl with red hair): "Okay... that makes MORE sense."

Father: "Now, go to your room and do your homework."

Panel 2:

(No dialogue. The father is now depicted as a stern Soviet-style leader in a green military uniform, in front of a red banner bearing the hammer and sickle. In the background, the red-haired daughter sits at a desk doing her homework.)

Text overlaid on the panel: "DAD"
comics.voteyText:
(No dialogue. A stylized black-and-white portrait of a sad, weary woman's face against a red background.)
Text overlaid on the panel: "MOM"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

A child with a freshly shaved bald head (a tattoo reading "I [heart] BOYS" on the back of the skull, wearing a pink tank top) confronts a woman in glasses, a yellow shirt, and blue overalls/skirt — apparently the mother.

Child: MOM! YOU SHAVED MY HEAD! HOW COULD YOU!

Mother: HEY, HOW WAS I SUPPOSED TO KNOW THAT PROM IS TOMORROW!

Child: PROM IS TOMORROW?!

Mother: SHUTUP!

Caption (below panel): I like to think I'm a patient mother, but honestly, do we have to have the same discussion every single year?
comics.voteyText:
Close-up of an annoyed, scowling face.
Text (speech, above the face): Your generation have no respect.

comics.comicText:
Single panel:

Blonde woman (gesturing with both hands, peace-sign necklace): ENJOYING YOUR MEAT? MURDERER!

Man (seated, holding a forkful of red meat): OH GEEZ...

Caption below panel: Can't we have just one dinner date where she doesn't mention the time I shot her mom?
comics.voteyText:
A roughly sketched man's face, speaking:
Man: Guns don't kill people. Blood loss kills people.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A blonde woman (Laurie) sits on a couch facing a man with reddish-brown hair (Ted) in a green shirt, who sits hunched with his hands clasped between his knees.

Laurie: "TED, YOU AREN'T EVEN ATTRACTIVE!"

Caption (below panel): Laurie explains why she's still a virgin.
comics.voteyText:
A loosely sketched close-up of the blonde woman's face in profile.
Laurie: "Only Brad Pitt has that power."

comics.comicText:
Single panel.

A red demon-like creature with yellow eyes and fangs raises a fist triumphantly.

Demon: I AM MOLOCH! LORD OF PESTILENCE!

A woman with brown hair, seen from behind, faces him.

Woman: Moloch, what did you just splash on me?

Moloch: Water I sneezed on TWO DAYS AGO! HAHAHA HAHAHA!

(The woman holds up a cup; a small "..." speech bubble shows her unimpressed reaction.)

Woman: Can we go out Friday?

Moloch: I told you, we're broken up.

Woman: I'm sorry.
comics.voteyText:
Moloch, now drawn in a simple sketch style looking sad and downcast.
Woman (off-panel): Can we still sacrifice firstborns together?

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A man with light hair (wearing a tan/brown shirt) and a man with reddish hair (wearing a yellow shirt) face each other.

Red-haired man: "YOUR MAMA'S SO FAT, SHE ROLLED OVER FOUR QUARTERS AND MADE A DOLLAR!"

The tan-shirted man holds up a small photograph and points at it.

Tan-shirted man: "YOUR MAMA'S SO FAT, HERE'S A PICTURE OF HER TIED UP IN MY BASEMENT!"

Caption (below the panel): Todd wins the insult war.
comics.voteyText:
Close-up of a grinning man's face beside hand-lettered text.
Text: "Fooled you! She's actually tied up in my attic!"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

A man with brown hair and a blonde woman lie in bed together, sheets pulled up, smoke rising from post-coital cigarettes.

Woman (thought bubble): MY GOD THAT WAS TERRIBLE. QUICK, THINK OF A WAY TO BREAK UP WITH HIM!

Man (speaking, smiling): I HAVE HERPES!

Woman (speaking, looking dismayed): WOW, YOU TOO?!
comics.voteyText:
A close-up of a woman's face looking unimpressed.
Off-panel voice (speech bubble from above): MY FAVORITE STAR WARS IS EPISODE 1
Woman (speech bubble, deadpan): WE HAVE SO MUCH IN COMMON!

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Woman (holding a baby): STEVEN, THIS IS OUR LOVECHILD.

Steven (man with brown hair): RENO 2003, OR TIJUANA '02?

Woman: ACTUALLY, ATLANTIC CITY, 2004

Panel 2:

Steven (calling out): HONEY! ANOTHER BASTARD OFFSPRING OF ONE OF MY DRUNKEN AFFAIRS!

Off-panel voice (his partner): I HATE YOU!

Panel 3:

Woman (holding the baby, handing over a clipboard): SIGN HERE PLEASE.

Steven signs the document.
comics.voteyText:
First speech bubble: we should divorce
Second speech bubble: What would the church say?
(A man's scowling face looks on, annoyed.)

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

A blonde woman in a green shirt sits at a table talking animatedly to a man whose back is to the viewer. A black widow spider hangs from a thread of web in the upper-right corner.

Woman: "PEOPLE WHO THINK WE'RE SMARTER THAN ANIMALS ARE DUMB. LOOK AT DOLPHINS! THEY'RE SMART ENOUGH TO NOT POLLUTE EARTH! AND DON'T GET ME STARTED ON HOW SMART THE [text trails off, illegible]"

Man (back to viewer): "UH HUH, UH HUH. REALLY? WOW..."

Caption (below panel): It was a good ten minutes before that black widow finally struck.
comics.voteyText: Handwritten text: "This is exactly how black widows work."

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Elderly bald man (grandpa, wearing glasses and a yellow shirt): SWEETIE, HOW DO I PUT ON MY PANTS AGAIN...?

Woman (brown hair, pink shirt): BY PUTTING YOUR LEGS IN THE HOLES, DAD.

Elderly man: THANK YOU. I WAS WAY OFF...

Caption below panel: We later discovered that grampa had just shot the dog.
comics.voteyText: A roughly sketched man's face with a stern expression, speaking: That's how we did it in the old days!

comics.comicText:
Single panel:

A woman with brown hair, holding a wrench, stands facing a large boxy robot with red eyes, a yellow grille, and an antenna.

Woman: OH HI, ARE YOU ELECTRO-MAT 5-BILLION?

Robot: YES I RESPONDED TO YOUR ONLINE DATING INQUIRY!

Woman: TELL ME ABOUT YOURSELF.

Robot: I AM PROGRAMMED TO FEEL ONLY TRUE PERFECT LOVE OR PURE UNBRIDLED HATRED!

Woman: WOW. THAT WAS SO LOVELY, THE WAY YOU JUST SAID THAT...

Woman: WELL THANKS, I -

Robot: SHUT YOUR FACE YOU UGLY WHORE!!!
comics.voteyText: Handwritten caption on a blank panel: "Later, Electro-Mat became Twitter."

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Young blonde girl: DADDY! MY ARM'S ASLEEP!

Father (man in green sweater): UH OH! TIME FOR CPR!

(A woman stands in a doorway in the background. A clown painting hangs on the wall.)

Panel 2:

Father: CLEAR!

(The father grips the girl, who looks shocked, as if administering defibrillation. The woman in the background looks alarmed.)
comics.voteyText: Woman: Where did the clown painting go?

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A man in sunglasses, a suit, and a red tie stands at a doorway, holding up a handwritten paper note toward a military police officer (helmet labeled "MP", seen from behind with a rifle slung over his back).

Man in sunglasses: "LET ME IN SON. I'M CIA"

The handwritten note he holds reads: "I STEAL NUCLEAR SECRETS"

Caption (below panel): Forgery is not my forté.
comics.voteyText:
Close-up sketch of the MP officer's face under his helmet, frowning, with a speech bubble.
MP officer: "The font is all wrong"

comics.comicText:
Single panel. A kitchen scene. A blonde woman in a pink apron stands at the sink, holding a purple plate and a bowl. A young girl with curly reddish-brown hair sits at a yellow table in the foreground. A man's head is partly visible in the lower-left corner.

Woman: Aren't you going to eat your oatmeal?

Girl: Ever since my dog Larry died choking on my hamster Stuart I don't care about anything.

Woman: Wow, nothing? Really?

Caption (below the panel): "We're getting a divorce. Ooh! And grandma died!"
comics.voteyText:
A rough black-and-white sketch of a man's head in profile, looking glum.
Voice (speech bubble): Also, your hair sucks

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

A blond man in formal wear (white shirt, bow tie, red sash/cummerbund) leans toward a blond woman in a red dress, holding her hands. A fancy ballroom-style setting with a checkered floor.

Man: "AND NOW MY DEAR, WE SHALL MAKE ZEH LOVE."

Woman: "BUT LORD HOTTINGTON! YOU ARE AN ITALIAN, FRENCH, AN BRITISH COUNT! I'M JUST A SIMPLE MIDDLE SCHOOL TEACHER FROM THE MIDWEST ON A QUEST TO FIND THE MEANING OF ROMANCE!"

Caption (below panel): Lord Hottington had Ms. Timmons removed from the premises immediately.
comics.voteyText:
Close-up of a man's face (the same Lord Hottington), looking down with a disapproving expression.
Man: "Shame on you."

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A woman with reddish-brown hair, standing beside a smiling man, gestures toward a dark, shadowed figure. The dark figure has the letters "AS" on a label on its chest. The smiling man has the letter "S" on a label on his shirt.

Woman: "HEY ANTI-STEVE, I WANT YOU TO MEET MY NEW BOYFRIEND - STEVE."

Caption (below panel): "Part of me wondered if she was just doing this to irritate me."
comics.voteyText:
A woman with a worried expression looks off to the side.
Woman: "DON'T FIGHT! YOU'LL TURN INTO GAMMA RAYS!"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A woman with brown hair stands behind a man with reddish-brown hair who is putting on a coat, heading out the door of their apartment.

Woman: Where ya goin'?

Man: Out with the guys.

Woman: Which guys?

Man: The GUYS, okay?

Caption (below panel): Geez, the way she's talking you'd think I cheated on her twice.
comics.voteyText:
Close-up of the same man's face, looking tense.
Woman (off-panel speech bubble): It's allllways about trust with you!

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A blonde woman with a hand on her chest speaks to a person whose head is visible in the foreground.

Blonde woman: "HONEY... I'M PREGNANT... AND UH... IT'S YOURS..."

Caption (below panel): There are many unique challenges in a lesbian relationship.
comics.voteyText:
A worried-looking woman with a thought/speech caption above her.
Text: "I think it's a Jesus."

comics.comicText:
Main comic:

A brown-haired man in a dark suit and a blonde woman stand facing each other, mid-conversation. The man is grinning broadly.

Man: "AIN'T NUTHIN LIKE CHEATIN' BABY!"

Man: "YEAH!"

Man: "..."

Man: "I'M SORRY, THAT WAS, LIKE, THE RUNNING GAG AT THE STAG PARTY LAST NIGHT. ANYWAY, WHERE WAS I..."

Man: "OH YEAH!"

Caption below the panel: "I do."
comics.voteyText:
A simple line-drawing of a person's head in profile, looking weary or distressed.
Handwritten top text: "Reading this 10 years later..."
Speech (the person): "The fuck is a Stag Party?"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

News anchor (reading from a sheet of paper): "LADIES AND GENTLEMEN, WE INTERRUPT YOUR REGULARLY SCHEDULED PROGRAM FOR A LIVE BROADCAST OF F**K F**K F**K F**K F**K F**K F**K."

Caption (below panel): We have since fired our teleprompter guy.
comics.voteyText: A man (close-up, scowling): "Mother fasterisker!"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

In a backyard, a young boy with orange hair (seen from behind) faces a woman with brown hair who wears a pink tank top. Behind them, a pile of dolls burns in a bonfire with tall red and yellow flames and a column of dark smoke rising over a wooden fence.

Boy: MOM! MY BARBIES! THEY WERE POSSESSED BY THE DEVIL!

Woman (looking frightened, hand raised): THEY WERE NOT!

Caption below panel: Like most arguments, this one ended with one of my dolls vomiting brimstone.
comics.voteyText:
Close-up of a Barbie-style doll's head with a jewel/gem on its forehead, mouth open wide.
Doll: Hail Satan! Hehehe!

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Sound effects (a giant green dinosaur monster roaring): "RARR!" "RRGH!"

Man (orange-haired man, shouting up at the monster): "HEY! THOSE ARE MY KIDS YOU'RE EATING! HELL-OOOOO!"

A brown-haired man standing beside him, smiling: "HEH. CAN'T FIGHT CITY HALL, EH PAL?"

Caption (below the panel): Part of me regrets voting Murdersaurus for mayor.
comics.voteyText: The orange-haired man, now drawn in close-up with a thoughtful/conflicted expression, speech bubble: "He DID eat my kids, but the trains finally run on time..."

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

A boy sits at a dining table. A woman (his mother, seen from behind in the foreground) sits across from him and has just swung a long object across the table. There is a yellow burst with the sound effect "CRACK!" near the boy's face, and a soda can flies off to the right.

Caption (below the comic):

Mom didn't like it when I slurped my soda.

Fortunately, this time she missed and hit the can.
comics.voteyText: Close-up of a stern-faced woman pointing. A speech-balloon-style hand-lettered note reads: "Comb your hair". Below, a hand/arm gestures.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Superhero (a smiling man with brown hair, wearing a white costume with a large "I" on the chest and a blue cape, striking a confident pose): "SORRY CROOK! INVINCIBLE MAN IS HERE TO -"

Sound effect: "BANG!" (a gunshot fired at him)

In the foreground, a crowd of people, including a man in a green leprechaun-style hat and a blonde woman in a red-and-white striped shirt, looks on.

Caption (below the panel): We were informed at the funeral that Invincible man had no real powers.
comics.voteyText: A woman with shoulder-length hair, drawn in a loose sketch style: "Amazing how long it took to call his bluff"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel, courtroom scene):

Judge (an older bald man with a white beard, in black robes, behind a bench): WHY ARE YOU HOLDING A KNIFE?

Defendant (a smiling man with reddish-brown hair, holding up a bloody knife and giving a thumbs-up): MY LAWYER THOUGHT IT'D BE GOOD FOR THE JURY TO SEE ME NOT STABBING TODDLERS.

Judge: AND WHAT'S THAT RED STUFF ON YOUR KNIFE?

Defendant: FRESH ADULT BLOOD.

Caption (below panel): Ten minutes later, we voted to acquit.
comics.voteyText: A man's face, smiling, with a speech bubble: Everyone is an adult inside.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Man (holding a knife, hand raised defensively): IT'S NOT WHAT IT LOOKS LIKE OFFICER! IT'S KETCHUP!

Caption (below panel): That's right - they broke my ketchup bottle, so I shot them!
comics.voteyText: Man (close-up, deadpan): So, I stabbed them.

comics.comicText:
Single panel, green background. A man kneels with his hands clasped in prayer, looking upward.

Man (praying): GOD, WHY DO BAD THINGS HAPPEN TO GOOD PEOPLE?

God (yellow speech bubble from above): BECAUSE IT'S FUNNY!

God (second yellow bubble): SO, WHEN MY MY SON FELL OFF THAT BRIDGE-

God (laughter bubble): HAHAHAHAHA HAHAHAHAHAH HAHAHAHAHA HAHAHAHA
comics.voteyText:
A cookie with a small speech bubble.
Cookie: CLASSIC!

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A man sits at a table holding a bowl. A woman with long blonde hair stands beside him with her hands on her hips, looking at him. On the table is an orange book labeled "STAMP COLLECTING."

Man: WOAH, WOAH, WOAH. LOOK, HONEY, I TOLD YOU I CAN'T BE CHEATING ON YOU. MY NEW HOBBY TAKES ALL OF MY TIME!

Caption (below panel): I'm really enjoying my new hobby - lying to Susan.
comics.voteyText:
A close-up line drawing of the same woman's face. A speech bubble points toward her.
Woman: Is your next statement a lie?

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Doctor (a man with brown hair wearing a head mirror and a doctor's coat): "I HAVE A CONFESSION TO MAKE! ALL THE DRUGS, THE RADIATION, THE SURGERY, IT WAS ALL SO I COULD SPEND MORE TIME WITH YOU!"

Patient (a flame-haired person, seen from behind): "OH TED!"

Caption (below panel): Goodbye malpractice suit!
comics.voteyText:
Caption at top: "Reading this 10 years later..."
A man resting his head on his hand looks up with a stunned expression: "Holy shit!"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Man (to a child): SO YOU SEE, SWEETIE, ALL WE REALLY NEED... IS EACH OTHER.

Caption (below panel): Dad explains why I'm not getting my insulin shots.
comics.voteyText: Man: Let's let togetherness be your anti-drug.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

A blond man in a green shirt is being interviewed by a police officer who is taking notes. The blond man holds up a shoe with blood on it. In the background, a body lies on the floor with another man kneeling over it and a third bystander standing nearby; it appears to be a diner or restaurant setting with stools.

Blond man: "None of us really knew the particulars of the Heimlich maneuver, so we just started beating him with a shoe."

Caption (below panel): This was, in fact, only half true.
comics.voteyText:
Close-up of the smiling blond man.
Blond man: "It's not murder if he was gonna die anyway!"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A man in a green superhero costume with a yellow cap and a black domino mask strides forward, dragging a tied-up hostage by the arm. He points ahead.

Green-costumed hero: "LAY DOWN YOUR FIREARM CROOK! HUNGRYMAN IS HERE!"

In the foreground, a pair of legs in a pink-and-purple costume stands facing him.

Caption (below panel): Sadly, Hungryman died of starvation long before he could save any of the hostages.
comics.voteyText:
A loose sketch of the masked hero's face, looking gaunt.
Hero: "My superpower is frugality."

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A man with brown hair and a green shirt holds a large serrated knife to the throat of another man (lying down, with dark hair). The knife-wielding man looks wide-eyed and uneasy, and holds a small book in his other hand.

Man with the knife: KNIFE GOES IN. BLOOD COMES OUT.

Caption (below panel): Mr. Sanders was fairly adamant that we return our library books on time.
comics.voteyText:
A loosely sketched face with a wide-eyed, slightly worried expression speaks.
Face: Death would be a great adventure. Like, Hardy Boys great.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (a newspaper crossword page):

TODAY'S CROSSWORD

BY: CROSSWORDIN' SAM

TITLE: THE ANSWER IS YOU

ACROSS

1) THE PROBLEM WITH OUR RELATIONSHIP

DOWN

4) THERE IS NO FOURTEEN DOWN BECAUSE YOU'RE A STUPID BITCH.

(A small partial crossword grid is shown beneath the title.)

Caption (below the panel): "Wow! I've never completed a crossword puzzle before! I should have cheated on Sam years ago!"
comics.voteyText:
A newspaper word-game box.
Heading: Today's Word Scramble!
The scrambled answer shown: Fuck Yuo

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Woman (screaming, blood streaming down her face): AAAAHH! WHAT THE HELL IS THIS?!

Man (pointing cheerfully): GOOD MORNING! THAT'S WHAT YOUR LUNGS MIGHT LOOK LIKE IF YOU DON'T STOP SMOKING TODAY!

Caption (below panel): Laurie probably thinks I'm weird, but practice is everything, and I need to be ready in case she ever actually does start smoking.

Now, where was I. Oh yeah. "LAURIE! THE KIDS ARE DEAD! THEY'RE ALL DEAD!"
comics.voteyText:
A crudely sketched man speaks to a terrified, screaming woman.
Man: That's great!

comics.comicText:
Main comic:

A man with brown hair in a blue sweater sits at a table across from a blonde woman in a pink tank top.

Man: HEY! SORRY FOR THE DELAY, BUT I PROMISE I'LL GET YOU SOMETHING GOOD TONIGHT.

Woman: OH, DON'T WORRY, I-

Man: WHAT? OH, SORRY, I WAS TALKING TO MY GENITALS.
comics.voteyText:
A close-up of the same man, now looking angry and stern.
Man: Don't you talk back to me!

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A dying soldier, lying down and gripping the hand of another soldier, gasps out his last words.

Dying soldier: "Todd, buddy, things are gettin' dark, I want >GHACK< I want you to tell my wife... I would have loved her... forever..."

Todd (off-panel, kneeling beside him): "Would that be Japan wife or Sweden wife?"

Dying soldier (weakly): "Piiiiick... ooooooone..."
comics.voteyText:
Close-up of the dying soldier's face as he continues to speak.
Dying soldier: "Tell them... I... liked them..."

comics.comicText:
Panel 1: A traveler in a yellow hooded robe walks up a winding path toward a temple set among purple and snow-capped mountains.

Panel 2: An armored guard holding a polearm confronts the traveler.

Guard: HALT!

Panel 3: A red-faced, horned warrior in ornate armor holding a large curved blade addresses the traveler.

Warrior: ALL WHO ENTER MUST PROVE THEY HAVE RENOUNCED ALL LOVE, DESIRE, AND PLEASURES OF THE FLESH. IT MAY TAKE YEARS, BUT-

Panel 4: The yellow-robed traveler holds up a book. Its cover reads: DUNGEONS & DRAGONS PLAYER'S HANDBOOK.

Panel 5: The red-faced warrior, now seen close up, responds flatly.

Warrior: YOU MAY PASS.
comics.voteyText:
An old man with a beard, glasses, and a grimacing expression speaks.
Old man: That's a stereotype!

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (top):

Father: NO! NO DAUGHTER OF MINE IS GETTING A TATTOO! PEOPLE WILL THINK YOU'RE A TRAMP!

Daughter: BUT DAAAAD!

Father: OKAY! OKAY! ON ONE CONDITION!

Panel 2 (bottom):

(No dialogue. A close-up of the daughter's upper arm showing a tattoo of a red heart with a banner reading "STD'S" across it.)
comics.voteyText: Father: It's short for Super-Talented Dad!

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A monstrous, fanged skull-like mask fills most of the panel, with another smaller fanged red-mouthed creature beside it.

Sound effect: GWAAGH!

Sound effect: KWEEEGH!

Caption (below panel):

Dad always made the best Halloween masks.

It's too bad he got killed by those aliens from Hell.
comics.voteyText:
A cartoonish fanged skull/monster face.
Speech bubble: "Sorry, but your dad was too spooky."

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A man (named Todd in the caption) with dark skin and short hair, wearing a green polo shirt, raises his fist in anger and shouts.

Man: GET OUT!

Man: HEY! YOU KNOW WHAT? IT'S CALLED "SEPARATE BUT EQUAL," AND IT'S CRAP! YOU HEAR ME!? IT'S CRAP!

Caption below the panel:

Todd looked away longingly, wistfully. "Someday, things are gonna change. But," he sighed, "for now I guess I'll have to stick to my own kind."

With a heavy heart, he entered the men's restroom.
comics.voteyText:
Handwritten text at the top: Comics need more words.
Below it, a simple line drawing of a person with curly/messy hair, eyes closed, head resting against a pillow or surface as if lying down.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A robed figure with long brown hair and a red sash (depicted as Jesus) stands with arms raised before a small crowd.

Figure: GOOD PEOPLE! I HAVE BEEN RESURRECTED THAT YOU MAY WITNESS THE MIGHT OF THE LORD, AND BE ABSOLVED OF YOUR SINS!

Panel 2:

Caption (orange banner): MOMENTS PRIOR...

The same figure sits among clouds in the heavens, looking sheepish, holding a phone/listening.

Voice (from above): HEY SON, YOU GET THAT PIZZA I ORDERED?

Figure: OH GEEZ...
comics.voteyText:
A rough hand-drawn sketch of a person's face looking worried.
Person: Shit Rome doesn't have tomatoes yet.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Three people stand on a snowy mountain. A bald older man in a red coat and blue scarf speaks to two companions.

Older man: "I don't have much time, and the food supply's runnin' low. This may sound gross, but it's your only hope. If I die... I want you to eat... Fred's body."

Caption (below panel): That should give you the energy to build my mausoleum.
comics.voteyText:
The same bald older man, drawn in loose sketch style, looks down at a folded map.
Older man: "I drew a diagram over the only map"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

Three men in pimp-style hats are arguing, with a calmer fourth man (in a green/yellow hat) and another man (Fred, holding a goblet, wearing a purple hat) in the foreground.

Man in green/yellow hat: "HEY! YOU OWE MY WHORES $400!"

Man in purple hat (Fred): "YEAH?! WELL HE OWES MY WHORES $800!"

Man in red hat: "OH YEAH?! WELL HE OWES ME $2,000 FOR KILLING MY WHORES!"

Fred (thought/speech, holding goblet): "OKAY, CALM DOWN. RELAX, THINK - WHAT WOULD JESUS DO?"

Caption beneath the panel: "For a split second, Fred attempted to wash the feet of a leper before ultimately being beaten to death."
comics.voteyText:
A man lies face-down on a surface, smiling.
Man: "I'm gonna rise in three days!"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Woman in a red dress (seen from behind, blonde hair): "So... do we need to go home and get you out of those clothes?"

Julian (a man in a blue tuxedo jacket and bow tie, holding a champagne glass): "Oh my dear, I think you know the answer to that question..."

Caption beneath the panel: With his teeth gleaming a pearly white, and an eyebrow rakishly crooked, Julian once again wet himself.
comics.voteyText: Close-up of the same man, smiling: "I'm wincontinent."

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

Setting: A fast-food kitchen. Two workers in paper caps and red shirts stand at a grill cooking burger patties. A large green can on the counter is labeled "MILITARY GRADE ASS FAT." In the foreground, a customer with orange/red hair faces the counter.

Customer (speech balloon): "HEY, YOU GUYS PUT PICKLES ON MY BURGER, AND I HAD ASKED FOR GYAH!"

Caption (below panel): Even to this day, I eat fast food only occasionally.
comics.voteyText:
A man's face in profile, looking content/resigned.
Man: "If it's good enough for our veterans, it's good enough for me!"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Woman (blonde, seen from behind, in a red top): OH HI. ARE YOU STEVE?

Man with red hair (holding a blood-stained banner/sign on a pole over his head): STEVE IS DEAD! BY NATURAL LAW, I -RODNEY- AM NOW YOUR BLIND DATE!

Caption (below panel): The blind dating scene sure has changed a lot since all the world's governments collapsed at once.
comics.voteyText:
A blonde woman (drawn in loose sketch style, with a faint blood smear) speaks toward the red-haired man.
Woman: So... coffee?

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

Officiant: AND IF ANY ONE CAN GIVE A REASON THESE TWO SHOULD NOT BE JOINED, LET HIM SPEAK NOW, OR -

A man in the pews (interrupting): HE'S A JERK!

The bride (turning to her groom): YOU NEVER TOLD ME THAT!

Caption below panel: Ugh. Why do I keep inviting dad to my weddings?
comics.voteyText: The groom (a man drawn in profile): We prefer "Inconsiderate-Americans."

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

A man in a green polo shirt stands at a bar with his arm around a blonde woman. He gestures with a thumb back toward another woman (in pink) standing further away near the bar.

Man: "OH HER? I MEAN, WE CAME TOGETHER, BUT WE'RE NOT, LIKE, DATING."

Caption (below panel): Technically, I wasn't lying about my wife.
comics.voteyText:
Handwritten title: "The shape of this bar:"
A line graph showing a curve that starts flat/low at the left (near a small bar-shaped block marked with a tiny circle) and slopes steeply upward to the right. Two stick figures are climbing up the steep slope, one ahead of the other.

comics.comicText:
The entire comic is set against a pitch-black background, with only speech balloons visible.

First speaker: "Can't we put the lights on?"

Second speaker: "I'm sorry... it's my first time, and I'd really be a lot more comfortable... not seeing... EVERYTHING."

First speaker: "Okay, okay..."

Caption (below the panel): "Who am I to argue? He's the surgeon."
comics.voteyText: Against the same black background, a single speech balloon reads: "Eww! It's all moist!"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A boy with orange hair holds up a card showing a red heart that reads "TO THE BEST MOM EVER!"

Woman: OH SON!

Caption (below panel):

Boy: "Could you get this to dad's new wife?"
comics.voteyText:
A man with wavy hair smiles dreamily.
Man: Her brownies are sooo good.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

A gray-haired man (addressed as Clark) confesses to a woman with dark hair (addressed as Lois), who is seen from behind.

Clark: LOIS, I WANT YOU TO KNOW THAT... I WAS SUPERMAN. SO, YOU MAY HAVE THOUGHT YOU WERE CHEATING ON ME, BUT, IN MY EYES, YOU WERE ALWAYS FAITHFUL.

Lois: OH CLARK! SOMEHOW I ALWAYS KNEW...

Clark: I LOVE YOU.

Lois: I LOVE YOU TOO.

[Clark: "..." (silent beat)]

Lois: YOU WERE THE GREEN LANTERN, TOO, RIGHT?

Clark: HUH?

Lois: NOTHING!
comics.voteyText:
The woman (Lois), drawn loosely, asks with a slightly guilty/sheepish expression:
Lois: You're positive you weren't Black Canary, too?

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

Father (reading a newspaper, glasses, brown hair, back partly to viewer): "Sweetie, I'm sorry. I can't take you to the zoo today - I have work."

Young girl (blonde pigtails, red shirt with a heart): "But daddy, look what I got you!"

Father: "Oh hey, it's a-"

Caption (below panel): It was at this point that I noticed the gun.
comics.voteyText: A black silhouette of a small figure with pigtails running across a city street, arm raised holding a pistol, heading toward a building labeled "ZOO."

comics.comicText:
Panel (split by a jagged yellow lightning-bolt divider showing both ends of a phone call):

Left side — a man with light-brown hair in a green polo shirt speaks into a cordless phone:

Man: "HEY SUZANNE... IT'S... UH... NOT YOUR HUSBAND."

Right side — a woman with red hair in a pink top speaks into a phone, smiling, while in the background through a doorway a small figure of a man in a green shirt is also on the phone:

Woman (Suzanne): "NOT MY HUSBAND? THAT SOUNDS HOT."

Caption below the comic:

"I miss my first wife - the smart one who cheated on me"
comics.voteyText:
A close-up line drawing of a person's face speaking, hand near their chin:
"Could you talk in a lower octave? You sound like my husband."

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Man in bed (Mr. Jeffers): D-DOCTOR SLOAN?

Doctor Sloan (man in suit and hat, holding a shotgun): I SAID TWO WEEKS TO LIVE, MR. JEFFERS. THAT WAS THREE MONDAYS AGO. DID YOU SEE THE MD ON MY WALL?! DID YOU THINK THAT WAS FOR SHOW?! HUH?!

Sound effect (shotgun being pumped): TCHK TCHK!
comics.voteyText: Doctor Sloan (close-up of his face under the hat, smiling): Oh, convenient! A heart attack!

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Man (speaking, back to viewer): I'm gonna recommend a lift, plus 30 ccs saline for the left breast, and at LEAST 45 ccs for the right breast.

Blonde woman: Okay...

Caption (below panel): I'm thinking it's time I started patronizing a different Foot Locker.
comics.voteyText:
Close-up of a man's face with a sly, sleepy expression.
Man: We really go the extra mile

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Man (shirtless, brown hair, arms crossed, in a garden landscape with a waterfall): SURE THING, GOD! I'D LOVE TO HAVE A WIFE TO- HEYYYYY, WAIT A MINUTE-

Panel 2:

The man reclines, touching his chin thoughtfully, a large moon/sun in the background.

Man: WHICH RIB?
comics.voteyText:
A woman's face, looking annoyed.
Woman: STAY AWAY FROM MY LADY-RIB!

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A man (the "Dad" of the caption) is driving a car, twisted around to face a passenger. He is wide-eyed and shouting, jabbing a finger toward the passenger. Behind him through the windshield is a road sign reading "GRAND CANYON."

Dad (shouting): THIS IS WHAT HAPPENS!!!

A blonde person in a pink shirt sits in the passenger seat, looking on with wide, alarmed eyes.

Caption (below panel): Dad hated it when we cheated at Car Bingo.
comics.voteyText:
A loose sketch of a car driving off the edge of a cliff, sailing into the air over a chasm.
Text (speech, from the airborne car): Worth it!

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A grinning man with glasses, slicked-back hair, and a doctor's reflector headband holds up a large red heart-shaped Valentine. Written across the heart in handwritten letters: "HYSTERECTOMY!!" A blonde person seen from behind looks at it.

Caption (below the panel): What made this moment more awkward was that Valentine's Day wasn't for another seven months.
comics.voteyText:
Header text: "Reading this 10 years later..."
Two simply-drawn figures sit looking out. One is a bearded, furrowed-brow man looking irritated/unimpressed; the other rests on a surface beside him. (No dialogue.)

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A mother (woman with blonde hair, pink top) and father (man in a brown shirt) stand together holding out a small wrapped gift box toward their child, who is seen from behind.

Mother: "Sweetie, we know you wanted a pony, but money's been pretty tight this year, so we went with a gift a little more in our price range."

Below the panel: an open cardboard box labeled "NOTHING!"
comics.voteyText:
Close-up of the mother's face, looking strained/awkward.
Mother: "Gonna need that box back."

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A blond person with long hair, wearing a green t-shirt, shouts at another person (seen from behind) while holding up a lumpy gray bag labeled "SACK OF KITTENS" in one hand.

Blond person: YOU WANNA KNOW WHY I'M A VEGAN?! BECAUSE ANIMALS FEEL PAIN, OKAY?! DON'T BELIEVE ME?! HUH?!! WELL I'LL SHOW YOU!!

Caption (below panel):

Ultimately, I felt compelled to agree to his argument.

Frankly, I would've agreed with just about anything to get him to stop beating me with that sack of kittens.
comics.voteyText:
A man looks worried/annoyed, with a thought or speech bubble above him.
Man: I need a new roommate, bad.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

A uniformed parking/lot attendant stands beside a red car, holding a clipboard or ticket. Smoke rises from beneath the car's rear tires.

Driver (man leaning out of the red car, angry): WHAT THE HELL ARE YOU DOING!?

Attendant (calm): READ THE SIGN, SIR.

Sound effect from under the car: pffffff....

Sign on a post below the panel: DO NOT BACK UP: SEVERE TIRE DAMAGE!
comics.voteyText: A hand-drawn doodle of a smiling face. A speech bubble reads: "Welcome to Texas, sir."

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

An older bespectacled man (the professor) to a young blond man writing equations on a chalkboard.

Professor: MY GOD! YOU'VE PROVEN RIEMANN'S HYPOTHESIS! YOU'RE NOT EVEN A TRAINED MATHEMATICIAN, ARE YOU?!

Chalkboard (partial equations): P, S≠1, (s) = -2, -4, -6 ..., infinity symbols, square-root and summation notation.

Young man (the janitor): JUST THE JANITOR, SIR

Professor: NO FAMILY OR FRIENDS IN THE FIELD?!

Janitor: I DON'T HAVE ANY FRIENDS OR FAMILY...

Professor: REALLY?!

Caption: Like most mathematics award acceptance speeches, Dr. Anderson's focused mainly on why we should stop looking for the janitor's body.
comics.voteyText:
Close-up of the bespectacled professor's face, with a handwritten note beside him.
Note: It's funny how I have my best ideas every time a janitor dies.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A blonde woman stands behind a seated man, smashing a lamp down onto his head.

Sound effect (on the lamp impact): LAMP!

Woman (shouting): THIS IS BECAUSE OF THE CHEATING!

Caption (below panel): Suzette had a fairly unique way of apologizing.
comics.voteyText: Handwritten note: "Lamp" is the King of sound effects.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Blonde young woman: "Daddy... I'm pregnant."

Bald older man (her father), gripping a wooden baseball bat: "Where is the filthy bastard who did this to you?"

Caption (below panel): You'd think after five years dad would have accepted my marriage to Todd.
comics.voteyText: Close-up of the blonde woman's face, looking sad/distressed, speaking: "He is not a bastard!"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A vampire in a tuxedo and red-lined cape gestures while giving a speech, an American flag behind him.

Vampire (Senator von Fangula): "AND THERE WILL BE A TEN PER CENT DECREASE IN THE TAX ON THE BLOOD OF INNOCENT MAIDENS!"

Caption (below panel): Many of us felt Senator von Fangula was just pandering to his constituency.
comics.voteyText:
Close-up of the vampire's face (sketchy line-art style), fangs showing.
Vampire: "I subscribe to the Transylvanian school of economics"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1: Interior of a car. A man sits in the passenger seat; a woman sits in the driver's seat holding the wheel, looking back over her shoulder.

Woman (driver): "Ooh, honey. You hit him pretty hard."

Man (passenger): "Oh my god."

Man (passenger): "It's okay. I'll leave a note."

Woman (driver): "O-kay..."

Panel 2: Close on the man, now outside, crouching and writing on a small card or paper. The card reads (scrawled): "INSURANCE INFORMATION" and some illegible writing.

Panel 3: The man stands, holding the folded note, looking pleased with himself. A musical note floats in a speech bubble above him, indicating he is humming/whistling cheerfully.

Panel 4: A person's leg (the man, walking away) is visible at upper left. On the ground lies an injured elderly man in a green outfit, sprawled on his back with a small pool of blood beneath him. The folded note has been tucked into his hand / placed on his chest.
comics.voteyText: A handwritten note on a torn sheet of paper. It reads: "In your face!"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

A bride in a white dress and veil and a groom in a tuxedo sit close together, just married.

Bride: OH DARLING! THIS WAS THE BEST DAY OF MY LIFE!

Groom: ME TOO! LET'S GET MARRIED HERE AGAIN ON OUR FIRST ANNIVERSARY!

Bride: OH WHAT A ROMANTIC IDEA!

Caption (below panel): Imagine my embarrassment when Steve showed up a year later without his own new spouse.
comics.voteyText:
A man with a stern, frowning face glares to the side.
Man: You have poor communication skills

comics.comicText:
Title banner: SMBC PRESENTS:

PARENTING - THE RIGHT WAY

EPISODE 1 - AVOIDIN' THOSE TEARS

Two columns labeled "WRONG WAY" (red header) and "RIGHT WAY" (green header).

WRONG WAY panel:

Father (to his kids): KIDS, I SHOT MOM

The two children look shocked and distressed.

RIGHT WAY panel:

Father (to his kids): KIDS, I SHOT MOM... AND ICE CREAM CAME OUT!

Children: YAYYYYY!

The kids cheer happily, one holding a pink ice cream cone.
comics.voteyText: The father, drawn in a loose sketchy style, says: She has serious cholesterol issues

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Blonde woman (wearing a crown): PRINCE CHARMING!

Man with blond hair: ACTUALLY, I'M TECHNICALLY ONLY A HALF-PRINCE. IT'S REALLY QUITE A FUNNY STORY. YOU SEE...

Caption (below panel): Slowly but surely, Sleeping Beauty began to realize she couldn't feel her legs.
comics.voteyText:
An old woman with a wrinkled face speaks.
Old woman: This is why all the old ladies become witches.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A sinister hooded figure in a dark red robe sits at a table, its green skeletal hands clasped, a green fanged face grinning from within the shadowed hood. A ring is on one finger.

Hooded figure: "Good GOOD! The time draws ever closer!"

Caption (below panel): Soon the fish sticks would be done.
comics.voteyText:
A close-up of the same green, sharp-toothed grinning face.
Figure: "Really takes me back to my boyhood."

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A bald man in a tuxedo stands at a podium beside a wooden casket. He gestures toward the casket as he speaks.

Man: "Susan and I had a wonderful thirty years together. But, I know she wouldn't want us to dwell on death, but to focus on life. On... the future."

Man: "Isn't that right, Shelly?"

Caption (below panel): It was at this point that the wedding music began.
comics.voteyText:
Close-up sketch of a smiling man's face.
Man: "Such beautiful savings"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

A green-skinned, pointy-eared devilish figure in a dark cape stands triumphantly atop a candy-themed castle decorated with hearts and candy canes, arms raised against a backdrop of mountains and a rainbow.

Green devilish figure: "NOW THAT I AM KING OF HAPPY LAND, FUN SHALL BE OUTLAWED!"

Below him, a crowd of cute creatures and a pink-haired person react in distress. A long banner across the bottom reads: "NOOOOOOOOOOOOO!"

Caption (below comic): In Happy Land, "fun" is slang for absinthe.
comics.voteyText:
A rough hand-drawn sketch of the same green devilish figure's head, smirking, with a speech bubble.
Green devilish figure: "You may still snort joy"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A grinning man holds a young boy from behind, gripping the boy's head while a running chainsaw hovers right beside the boy's face. The boy looks terrified.

Man (shouting): "BILLY- YOU- BETTER- NOT- HAVE- ANY- MORE- NIGHTMARES- EVER!"

Chainsaw sound effect: "WHRRRRRR!"

A digital clock on the nightstand reads "3:00 AM".

Caption (below panel): "It turns out that this technique doesn't really work."

Caption: "Good thing I never used it on my own kids."
comics.voteyText:
A loose sketch of a smiling man with a speech bubble.
Man: "I'm a great stepdad."

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A man with red clothing and brown hair, seen from behind, stands before a robed, gray-haired figure (St. Peter / a gatekeeper) at a podium up in the clouds.

Man (red clothing): WOW, REALLY? HEAVEN? AFTER ALL THOSE TEENS I SLASHED?

Podium figure: WHAT? OH RIGHT, YOU GUYS ARE STILL USING THAT MISTRANSLATED TEN COMMANDMENTS. HERE.

Bottom (handwritten on a scroll/paper handed over):

5 HONOR THY FATHER AND MOTHER... BY SLASHIN' MORE TEENS!
comics.voteyText:
A handwritten note with an arrow pointing up to the comic above.
Fact:
"Heaven" is the anus of giant albino elephant.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A bearded man with long dark hair, wearing a red doublet with buttons and a cape over a maroon background, holds out a small coin pouch and looks down at it with displeasure.

Man: TWO COINS? WHAT THE HELL AM I SUPPOSED TO DO WITH THIS?!

Off-panel voice (smaller speech bubble): HUZZAH!

Caption (below panel): Now and then, just for fun, Robin Hood likes to switch things up a little.
comics.voteyText:
A loose sketch of a person's head and shoulders in profile, lying down or reclining.
Voice (speech bubble): I really like the way his buttons came out

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

A man (the "dad" referenced in the caption) in a purple shirt, seen from behind, bursts in shaking his fist.

Dad: "OH MY GOD! WHAT ARE YOU IDIOTS DOING?!"

A banner/sign on the wall reads: "RUSSIAN ROULETTE CLUB (No one under 4th grade allowed!)"

Three boys/young men stand around a small yellow table. On the table are a plate, drinking glasses, scattered bullets/cartridges, and a green item. One boy (with reddish hair, green shirt) holds a glass and looks toward the dad. The wall also bears some small scribbled writing near the boys.

Caption (below panel): "Shaking his head, his look of embarrassment barely disguised, dad flipped the safety to the off position."
comics.voteyText:
A sketchy line-drawn close-up of a smiling man's face.
Man: "It's not Canadian Roulette"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A man wearing glasses and a green shirt sits on a bed, one hand thoughtfully touching his chin, smiling. He addresses another man (seen from behind in the foreground).

Man with glasses: "Well... it goes against my parental ethics, but okay, it's a deal. You can see that PG-13 movie."

Caption (below panel): With a triumphant smirk, Billy agreed to share his meth with me.
comics.voteyText:
A loose sketch of the bespectacled man's smiling face.
Man with glasses (speech bubble): "That's called compromise!"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

An elderly couple stands at the railing of a boat at night, under a starry sky with a crescent moon. The man wears a navy captain's uniform and hat and tips his cap; the woman wears a pink top and holds a glass of wine.

Woman (Gwen): JOSEPH, DO YOU THINK YOU'LL EVER SETTLE DOWN?

Man (Joseph): OH GWEN. YOU KNOW I ONLY HAVE ONE TRUE MISTRESS — MY STABLE OF SLUTS.

Caption below panel: Specifically, Joseph was referring to stable 4.
comics.voteyText:
A close-up sketch of the captain's grumpy face wearing his cap.
Joseph: Used to be into The Sea, but she got clingy.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A hooded, red-robed figure with green clawed hands appears on a television/monitor screen, framed within a dark room.

Figure (from the screen): "HAHAHAHAHAH! WELCOME TO YOUR WORST NIGHTMARE! OVER THE COURSE OF THE NEXT 13 HOURS THE WALLS WILL SLOWLY CLOSE IN UNTIL YOU ARE CRUSHED TO- HEY! STOP IT! THAT DOOR'S SUPPOSED TO BE LOCKED! HEY! COME ON! STOP IT! PLEASE?!"

A red-haired young man watches calmly from the lower right, unbothered.
comics.voteyText:
A wide, dark, monstrous mouth/maw with jagged teeth.
Monster: "Guess its another night browsing 4chan."

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A mountainside under a blue sky. Carved or scrawled in large rough letters across the rock face: "PRESIDENTS ARE GREAT!" Evergreen trees and a rocky slope sit below.

Caption (below panel): Personally, I like the new Mount Rushmore a lot better.
comics.voteyText: A grinning man's face. Speech bubble: "Just imagine the savings!"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A father and his young son sit together outside at night in a snowy forest, the father's arm around the boy, who wears a purple and white pom-pom hat.

Father: "Son, women are like fine wine."

Caption (below panel): This advice would have been less worrisome if dad hadn't spent the last 17 hours smashing Pinot Grigio with a sledgehammer yelling "This is what you get! This is what you get!"
comics.voteyText:
A close-up of the son's face.
Son: "Dad, you need a cheaper form of depression."

comics.comicText:
Single panel.

A blue-and-grey costumed superhero resembling Batman grins and holds up a small bat-shaped object between his fingers while reaching toward a blonde woman in a pink top.

Woman (off to the right): WAIT! DO YOU HAVE A-

Hero: NO NEED!

Caption below the panel: The bat-diaphragm is 0% effective at preventing bat-pregnancy.
comics.voteyText: Handwritten note: Still less weird then the Bat-lube (tm)

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A blonde woman and a brown-haired man (the parents) stand together, facing a blonde boy seen from behind in the foreground.

Woman (or parents): "Son, we have something to tell you... you were... adopted."

Caption (below panel): Apparently, I would be meeting my new parents that afternoon.
comics.voteyText:
Close-up on a nervous, sweating face.
Speech bubble: "We'd take you there ourselves, but it's kinda scary."

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Patient (a man with red-orange hair, in a blue shirt): SO DOC, WHAT IS IT?

Panel 2:

Doctor (a man wearing a head mirror and lab coat, grinning): OH I'M JUST ITCHIN' TO TELL YOU!

Panel 3:

(The doctor grins broadly, leaning toward the patient. No dialogue.)

Panel 4:

(The doctor continues grinning, holding the dramatic pause. No dialogue.)

Panel 5:

(The doctor still grinning, drawing out the silence. No dialogue.)

Panel 6:

(The doctor's grin begins to relax/fade. No dialogue.)

Panel 7:

Patient: SO...

Panel 8:

Doctor (now deadpan): YOU HAVE HERPES.
comics.voteyText: A close-up of the doctor's face, drawn in loose sketch style with a flat, unamused expression. Speech bubble: OF THE SENSE OF HUMOR

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

A man with light brown hair in a green shirt stands at left, facing the viewer with a calm, blank expression. He has stabbed a knife into the back of the head of a second man (seen from behind, with light brown hair and a dark blue shirt). The blade has emerged from the second man's face/eye area, shown as a red bloody wound.

Caption (below the panel): "I narrowly managed to win the staring contest."
comics.voteyText:
Close-up line drawing of a person's face in profile. A device resembling a clamp or speculum is held against their open, propped-wide eye, forcing the eyelids apart.
The person says: "Ha! Now I'm incapable of blinking!"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A bearded man (implied to be Shakespeare), shown in profile from behind, writes with a quill pen on a scroll of parchment. The text on the scroll reads:

"OH YES IT'S LADIES NIGHT AND THE FEELIN'S RIGHT"

Caption (below panel): For centuries many of Shakespeare's finest works were unappreciated.
comics.voteyText:
A hand-drawn sticky note / scrap of paper with the text:
"Repeat x400"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A giant ape looms over a man in a tuxedo and bow tie. The ape speaks in a speech balloon.

Ape: Gwarghh. Rarrrhgh. Muahghh.

The tuxedoed man, looking nervous, responds in a small speech balloon.

Man: Help. Help.

Caption (below panel): My favorite King Kong adaptation is the one from the 40s, starring Humphrey Bogart.
comics.voteyText:
A loose, sketchy line drawing of a man's face, dapper and slightly worried-looking.
Text above his head: Vroom vroom. Bang. Rargh. Argh.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A blond man in a purple shirt stands in a garage beside a damaged red car. He holds a small handwritten note that reads: "SUCK-ER!"

Caption (below panel): I try to always leave a note when I ding someone's car.
comics.voteyText: A close-up of the handwritten note, which reads: "I can be reached at your mom's house."

comics.comicText:
Main comic (single panel):

A man with messy hair stands in the foreground in front of a red fire engine. Two firefighters in helmets and tan turnout coats flank him, each gripping a fire hose. Instead of spraying water, the hoses are launching a barrage of sharp objects — knives, scissors, and other blades — which are striking the man in the head and chest.

Firefighter (left): "HOW COULD YOU LET YOUR HOUSE CATCH FIRE?!"

Firefighter (right): "YEAH IDIOT! GEEZ!"

Caption (below panel): "After the fire engine ran out of water, we were forced to improvise."
comics.voteyText:
A firefighter (shown from the nose down, wearing a helmet) speaks.
Firefighter: "We can save your dog from fire, but not from shame."

comics.comicText:
Panel 1: A doctor in a white coat stands beside an elderly woman, holding a clipboard. He has a phone receiver tucked against his shoulder.

Doctor: "I'm sorry ma'am - your husband didn't survive the operation."

Sound effect: RING-RING-RING

Panel 2: The doctor, now holding the phone receiver to his ear, grinning.

Doctor: "What?! REALLY?! Yeah, I just told her he was dead!"

Panel 3: The doctor on the phone, smiling.

Doctor: "Okay, okay - let me get off the phone"

Panel 4: Close-up of the elderly woman, looking stunned and grim, wearing glasses and a purple top with a pink collar and a beaded necklace.

Panel 5: The doctor throws his arms up triumphantly, jacket flaring out.

Doctor: "STEELERS WON!"
comics.voteyText:
A scratchy, simply-drawn close-up of the doctor's face, eyes narrowed.
Doctor: "Can't you empathize with how little I care about your suffering?"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A man dressed as a Puritan witch-hunter (black wide-brimmed hat, white collar) speaks confidently to a green-skinned witch in a tall black pointed hat.

Witch-hunter: "Sorry, Bride of Satan! As you can see I've created a circle of salt, past which your wicked powers cannot penetr-"

The witch raises a gun and pulls the trigger.

Sound effect: "CLICK"
comics.voteyText: Handwritten note: "This comic is a call for more scientifically rigorous ant-Witch magic studies!"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A cheerful young man in a white straw boater hat and red bow tie holds open a red coupon book toward a blonde woman.

Man: "THIS COUPON BOOK IS WORTH OVER FIFTEEN-HUNDRED DOLLARS IN SAVINGS!"

Caption (below panel): Rule of Hooking, No. 1: Always demand payment up front.
comics.voteyText:
A close-up of an older woman's skeptical face.
Woman: "I told you I only accept index mutual funds!"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

Son (seated at the dinner table, back to viewer): BUT MOM!

Mother (standing, holding a plate): I'M SORRY SON, BUT RULES ARE RULES. NOW, FINISH YOUR PLATE.

Caption (below panel): Just prior to the end of dinner, a lightbulb had fallen from the chandelier onto my plate
comics.voteyText: The son (now shown close-up, alone): Wow, glass tastes exactly like blood.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A man with brown hair, wearing a green shirt, holds a gun and shouts angrily.

Man: TAKE IT BACK! YOU TAKE IT BACK RIGHT NOW, YOU SON OF A BITCH!

A woman with orange hair stands behind him, raising a hand in alarm.

Caption (below panel): "The lady said no pickles!"
comics.voteyText:
Close-up of an angry man's face, scowling.
Man: And how about some service with a smile?!

comics.comicText:
Single panel:

A man swings a wooden baseball bat at a cat that has just been launched out of a cannon-like device shaped like a small house with a barrel on top. The cat flies through the air with a motion-trail behind it.

Cat: "MEW?"

In the field below, a small distant figure stands near a marker reading "100" (a hundred-yard distance marker).

Caption (below panel): It was nice to finally get a little time away from the parish.
comics.voteyText:
Handwritten text on a sketched square sign:
"If the Bible doesn't say no, the answer is yes." (with "yes" underlined for emphasis)

comics.comicText:
Single panel:

Two children (a boy in blue on the left, a girl in pink on the right) argue while a father in a green shirt looks on.

Child 1 (boy): DADDY LIKES ME BEST.

Child 2 (girl): NO, DADDY LIKES ME BEST!

Child 1: NO ME!

Child 2: ME!

Child 1: ME!

Father: KIDS!

Father: WHAT A RIDICULOUS THING TO ARGUE ABOUT! HERE, I'LL FLIP A COIN.

Caption (below panel): Turns out I like George Washington better than either of them.
comics.voteyText:
Handwritten text inside a hand-drawn box:
Washington > Eagle > Children

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Batman stands in front of a window shaped like the Bat-Signal, reading a card or piece of paper he is holding.

Thought/word balloon (reading the card): "AM I GOING TO ROB THE CONTEMPORARY ART MUSEUM AT MIDNIGHT TONIGHT?"

Caption (below the panel): Sometimes I feel like The Riddler just isn't trying anymore.
comics.voteyText:
A hand-drawn green sign with a large faded question mark behind the text.
Text: "Is the following google maps link correct"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

[A man with orange/red hair in a yellow shirt stands in a wooded area, holding a large purple device that resembles an oversized phone or PDA. The device's screen displays:]

Device screen: TEXT MESSAGE:

Device screen: :/ sry!

Caption (below panel): Divorce is never easy.
comics.voteyText:
[An older man with a beard and worried expression speaks.]
Older man: I swear, this is what phones used to look like.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

An elderly woman with brown hair, seen in profile, holds and reads a brochure. The brochure lists:

Brochure: -TENNIS!

Brochure: -WAITING TO DIE!

Brochure: -MACRAME!

Behind her, a dark figure sits hunched in a chair near a window.

Caption (below panel): The nursing home had an excellent brochure.
comics.voteyText:
More text rendered in the same hand-lettered brochure style:
Text: And DRUGS DRUGS DRUGS DRUGS!
Below the text are a few loose, scattered pills/capsules drawn in outline.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1: A fist knocks on a door.

Sound: "KNOCK KNOCK!"

Panel 2: A blonde woman in a green apron opens the door.

Woman: "YES?"

Panel 3: A man with light brown hair (the woman partly visible at left).

Man: "WOW... HOW DO I PUT THIS NICELY..."

Panel 4: The man grins, pointing both index fingers upward.

Man: "WHAT'S THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN YOUR HUSBAND AND A CORPSE?"

Panel 5: The woman looks distraught.

Woman: "OH MY GOD... JON..."

Panel 6: The man, against a bright yellow background, hands her a paper while smiling.

Man: "THE CORPSE ISN'T DIVORCING YOU!"

Paper (upside down): "YOU GOT SERVED?"
comics.voteyText:
A simple line-drawn smiling face with a speech bubble.
Face: "Please give me five stars at divorcer.com"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A woman with long red hair, wearing a pink top, leans across a restaurant table holding a knife. A blond man in a green shirt sits across from her at a yellow-clothed table with a bottle and wine glass.

Red-haired woman (speech bubble): I CARVED YOUR NAME INTO MY FACE BECAUSE WE'RE IN LOVE.

Caption (below panel): I could already tell she was going to be one of those girls who expects you to pay for everything.
comics.voteyText:
Close-up of the blond man's face, looking uneasy.
Man (thought bubble): I hope she's not clingy.

comics.comicText:
A close-up of two people facing each other, smiling.

Man with brown hair (speech bubble): MONEY!

Man with blond hair (speech bubble): SEX!

Caption below the panel: We decided to keep our marriage vows succinct.
comics.voteyText:
Handwritten note: Perfect wedding vows:
I promise sex, love, financial stability, and an entire pie.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A man stands in the center, head tilted back, mouth wide open in a maniacal laugh, firing a machine gun from his hip. Above him, in huge jagged letters, is his laughter.

Man (laughing): HAHAHAHAHA

Gun sound effect: RAT-TAT-TAT-TAT

Two other men, foreground left and right, are caught in the gunfire, blood spraying from their bodies as they shout in pain.

Caption (below panel): Finally the tunnel out of jail could be built in peace.
comics.voteyText:
A smiling man (the gunman, now calm) faces the viewer.
Man: Now that everyone is dead, I can finally focus on what matters.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Substitute teacher (a blonde woman in a purple shirt, standing at the front of a classroom): KIDS, MR. TURLINGTON HAD TO ATTEND HIS WIFE'S FUNERAL TODAY. HOWEVER, HE LEFT YOU A HOMEWORK PROBLEM.

Chalkboard (handwritten):

Kids:

If a train leaves from 5 miles away, and you start walking toward it at 3 miles per hour, is life a meaningless series of pathetic tragedies?
comics.voteyText: Handwritten note: Please show your pointless work.

comics.comicText:
Setting: Hell, with red and purple flames in the background. A balding priest in a black clerical collar stands on the left, looking confused. A devil with long black hair and white horns holds an open book on the right.

Priest: WHAT THE?! HOW DID I END UP HERE?

Devil: LET'S SEE... AH, BACK IN 1987, SOME KID SAID "DAMN YOU" UNDER HIS BREATH. YEAH, IT ONLY TAKES ONE.

Caption (below panel): Life Tip: No one has ever gone to heaven.
comics.voteyText:
A close-up of the same balding priest's face, looking glum, still wearing his clerical collar.
Priest: Well, now I regret caning all those kids.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A blonde woman in a pink shirt stands in a bathroom, her face contorted in rage, screaming.

Woman (large jagged shout): DROWN! DROWN IN YOUR LIES!!!

Below her, partly hidden behind a counter, another figure is being held down (apparently into a sink), thrashing, with hands and feet flailing.

Drowning figure (strained gurgling): UNKGH! URGH! GURGH!

Caption (below panel): Susan was so excited that I'd booked a cruise for our anniversary, she could hardly believe it.
comics.voteyText:
A simply-drawn smiling woman.
Woman: I'll have to get a new bathing suit.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A blonde woman with glasses stands in a kitchen, swinging a leather belt by its end. A younger woman with brown pigtails, in a pink shirt, holds a cordless phone to her ear.

Woman on phone: "HEY JON, I JUST WANTED TO CALL TO SAY-OW!"

Sound effect (as the belt strikes her): "SMACK!"

Caption (below panel): The chastity belt was working out great.
comics.voteyText:
A close-up of the brown-haired woman's face, eyes shut in pain/resolve, a thought or speech balloon above her.
Text: "Now to build a cane of frugality."

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A young man with orange hair, sitting in a chair, holds out a bouquet of pink flowers wrapped in green paper to a blonde woman seen from behind.

Man: "HEY! HAPPY MOTHER'S DAY! YEAH, SO, THEY WERE ALL OUT OF ROSES. SO I GOT YOU SOME BITCHWEED INSTEAD."

Caption below the comic:

Man: "I mean carnations! Carnations! Wooh, Freudian slip, am I right?"
comics.voteyText:
Three hand-drawn sketches of flowers in glasses/vases, each labeled:
- Left: a glass of frizzy bushy flowers, labeled "Bitchweed"
- Right: a glass of spiky tulip-like flowers, labeled "Doucheplant"
- Bottom center: a glass with a single small drooping flower, labeled "Assholedinia"

comics.comicText:
Single panel, set in a dimly lit space.

Gang member (a man with a green bandana and goatee, handing over a handgun): "Alright, here's your gun. If you want in our gang, you gotta kill some-"

New recruit (a blond man in a white tank top, fumbling with the gun): :click: :click: :click:

New recruit: "Safety's on, huh?"

New recruit: "Yeah. Yeah. The safety's on."

New recruit: :click:

New recruit: "Yeah. Definitely on."

New recruit: :click:
comics.voteyText: Handwritten caption: "Zach's notion of gang members was formed entirely by 1980s action movies."

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

Setting: A classroom. A teacher with glasses and a green shirt sits at a desk facing two children (seen from behind), a chalkboard with "2x2" and some worksheet notes visible behind him.

Teacher: KIDS, DO YOU EVEN LIKE ME?

Child (one of the kids): NO.

Teacher: NOT EVEN A LITTLE?

Child: NOPE!

Teacher: HECK, YOU'LL PROBABLY JUST DO THE OPPOSITE OF WHATEVER I TEACH, WON'T YOU?

Caption below the comic: "Well excuse me!" barked Mr. Anders between bites of his snack cake. "I guess I'm the only one at this PTA meeting who doesn't want our kids smoking pot."
comics.voteyText:
A loosely-drawn close-up of the bald, glasses-wearing teacher's face with a speech bubble.
Teacher: Now to teach you to avoid porno.

comics.comicText:
Main comic:

A kitchen scene. A young boy in a red-and-black striped shirt sits at a blue table looking glum, holding a fork over a plate of plain pancakes. A carton of milk sits beside him. Looming behind him is a grinning man with glasses and grey-streaked hair, wearing a brown jacket, holding up a syringe-like injector.

Man: "GEE WHIZ! THESE PANCAKES ARE JUST PLAIN BORING!"

Man: "I PRESCRIBE 30 CCs OF RICH 100% PURE MAPLE SYRUP!"

Caption below the panel: "This surveillance footage was taken on 5/16/06 at 9:26 am."

Caption: "If you have any knowledge as to the whereabouts of the killer known only as 'Dr. Syrup,' please contact the authorities immediately."
comics.voteyText:
A hand-drawn wanted-poster sketch of an angry, scowling square face inside a box.
Label: "Dr Syrup"
Text: "Wanted for using metric system."

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (main comic):

A figure high up on tall stilts (only their legs and the bottom of a long pole are visible at the top of the frame) towers over a crowd of people.

Stilt-walker (in a large speech bubble): "HAHAHAHAHAHAHAHA! FLEE BEFORE ME! I AM YOUR GOD!"

Below, a crowd of people reacts. One man in the foreground covers his face with his hands, distressed. A man with orange/blond hair points and shouts with his mouth open. A woman in a purple top looks alarmed. Other figures run in the background.

Caption (below the panel): "Those stilts really went to Jesus' head."
comics.voteyText:
Close-up of a man's face looking upward, contemplative.
Speech bubble (from off-panel above): "You are ANTS! ANTS!"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

A blonde woman with an intense, slightly unhinged grin stands behind a red-haired boy in a green shirt, looming over him. She is cradling several dachshunds (weiner dogs) in her arms. The boy grips a large wooden spoon or paddle and stirs the contents of a wooden bucket/barrel, looking strained and unhappy.

Woman (shouting): BECAUSE THOSE WEINER DOGS AREN'T GOING TO BREAD THEMSELVES! NOW, KEEP STIRRING!

One of the dachshunds: BARK!

Caption (below panel): Mom is having a little trouble adjusting to single life.
comics.voteyText:
A hand-drawn close-up of a serene, contented face with closed eyes (apparently the boy).
Speech bubble: It may seem odd now, but you're building character

comics.comicText:
Single panel:

Son (with orange flame-like hair, red shirt): "DAD! I GOT TWO GIRLS PREGNANT!"

Dad (purple shirt, seated in front of a TV/monitor, not turning fully around): "WOHOHO! I BET THEY ARE PIH-ISSED!"

Caption beneath the panel: Dad then went back to his video games.
comics.voteyText: A man (sketched in loose black-and-white line art) with a vaguely troubled expression: "It's a shame you don't get points for parenting."

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

An old gray-haired man (seen from behind, in a dark suit) points across a table at a brown-haired man in a green shirt who stands protectively beside a red-haired woman in a pink top.

Old man: "NOW, HAND OVER THE GIRL!"

Green-shirt man: "THAT WAS NEVER PART OF THE DEAL!"

Old man: "I AM MAKING IT PART OF THE DEAL."

A Monopoly board sits on the table between them.

Caption (below panel): In retrospect, the Monopoly game had gotten a bit out of hand.
comics.voteyText:
A mock movie poster reading:
MONOPOLY
"YOU WILL NOT PASS GO"
IN THEATRES THIS FALL

comics.comicText:
Single panel:

A woman with red hair, in a green shirt and dark skirt, stands with one hand on her hip in front of a full-length mirror in a bedroom. A man with brown hair and glasses sits in the foreground, his back partly to the viewer.

Woman: "DO THESE PANTS MAKE ME LOOK FAT?"

Man: "NO, YOUR HUGE ASS DOES."

Caption (below panel): "Oh... oh, I'm sorry. You were asking your husband that question, weren't you..."
comics.voteyText:
A different man with glasses (the speaker of the rude line) leans forward, looking awkward.
Man: "AND THANK YOU FOR PATRONIZING OUR STORE."

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

An aide (off-panel / standing with back to viewer): "MR. PRESIDENT, I'M SORRY TO INTERRUPT, BUT THE ALIENS HAVE STRUCK AGAIN. OREGON IS... GONE."

The President: "WELL I GUESS I WON'T COUNT ON THEIR VOTES! AHAHAHAHA! BAM!"

The aide: "SIR, 4 MILLION PEOPLE ARE DEAD"

The President: "UH, YEAH, THAT WAS THE JOKE"

Caption (below panel): At this point, I decided to cut the live feed.
comics.voteyText: A grinning man: "I guess they're Oregone"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

A superhero is speaking on a television screen in a dark room.

Superhero (on TV): "SURE I SAVE THE WORLD FROM TIME TO TIME, BUT THE REAL SUPERHEROES ARE THE WORKING MEN - THE PEOPLE WHO SHOW UP EVERY DAY TO PUT FOOD ON THE TABLE TO FEED THEIR FAMILIES."

Unseen viewer (off-screen, watching the TV): "THAT'S... THAT'S SO BEAUTIFUL..."

Caption (below panel): Lex Luthor had a much easier time killing all the "real" superheroes.
comics.voteyText:
A bald man (implied to be Lex Luthor) grins as his bloody hand drips with blood.
Bald man: "They're so squishy!"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A group of people are gathered in a living room. A woman with orange hair, standing with one arm raised, calls out an answer during a charade game.

Orange-haired woman: "MY BROTHER'S WIFE WHOM I SECRETLY IMPREGNATED!"

Caption (below the comic): I'm not allowed in the family charade games any more.
comics.voteyText:
Close-up of a person's face looking dismayed/sheepish, with a speech bubble.
Person: "I was being a duck."

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

A reporter (seen from behind, seated, holding a notepad that reads "WHAT DOES IT MEAN TO BE A SPACE EEL?") asks:

Reporter: "President Zorblax - what do you say to allegations that you are a gigantic space eel bent on world domination?"

President Zorblax is a gigantic green eel-like alien creature wearing a red necktie. It has lunged forward and clamped its jaws around the head/face of a man in a blue suit who was standing beside it. Another man in a suit is being flung backward, with a flame-like red shape behind him.

The creature emits a loud sound effect:

Zorblax: "KWEEEEGH!!!!"

Caption below the panel:

* Translation: No comment.
comics.voteyText:
Handwritten text on a blank panel:
** The media is biased

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A silhouetted figure stands in a doorway/airlock, another figure rushing past.

First figure: "NO SPACE ACE! DON'T! IT'S SUICIDE!"

Panel 2:

A lone figure stands on the surface beneath a vast purple space vista, a sleek spacecraft in the foreground, stars in the black sky.

Space Ace (offscreen/from the scene): "DON'T YOU THINK I KNOW THAT?!"

Panel 3:

Caption box: "LATER..."

Inside a dim spacecraft interior with a porthole showing space outside, a figure with purple hair, an orange helmet/visor, and a brown coat hangs by the neck from a rope attached to the ceiling — having hanged himself.
comics.voteyText: Handwritten note: "Fun fact: Panel 2 is the only well-drawn panel in SMBC history."

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

An old man, bald with sunglasses and a pipe, sits in a chair facing a young woman with red hair (seen from behind) who sits on a green couch.

Old man: PERSONALLY, I'M OPPOSED TO IT.

Caption (below panel): One of the more awkward parts of being raised by my Grandpa was the menstruation talk.
comics.voteyText:
A close-up sketch of the old man's face, eyes closed, looking weary.
Old man: Back in the old days, we didn't do that sort of thing.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Man with orange hair: CONGRATULATIONS!

Panel 2:

Woman: I'M NOT PREGNANT!

Panel 3:

Man (panicking, sweating): OH GOD! OH GOD! QUICK, SAVE IT!

Panel 4:

Man (grinning, leaning toward the woman): ON BEING SO FAT!
comics.voteyText: Caption above a man's face: Smooth...

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A young man with brown hair drives a car, gripping the steering wheel. Through the windshield he sees an old man in a wheelchair on the road ahead.

Driver (thinking): GIVING ME THE EVIL EYE, EH? WELL, YOU'RE BRAVER THAN I THOUGHT, OLD MAN.

Caption (below panel): I was subsequently informed that Mr. Henderson had one glass eye, and was probably not even aware of the game "Chicken."
comics.voteyText:
Close-up of the young man's face.
Driver: It's still technically a tie.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

A boy standing at a podium on a stage, with a microphone, addressing a contestant. Speaker (boy at podium): "TACITURN: S-N-I-P-E-R. TACITURN."

The contestant, a man in a green shirt, stands center stage with his finger to his lips, looking thoughtful/confused. Two other children (a boy and a girl) wait in line at the left.

Caption (below the panel): Billy wins the spelling bee.
comics.voteyText: Handwritten text: "I swear this comic was less horrifying in 2006."

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

Inside a boxing ring, a brown-skinned boxer in green shorts throws a punch that lands on the jaw of a referee in a white shirt and black pants, sending an impact starburst flying. A pale boxer in purple shorts is caught up in the brawl beside them. There is no dialogue inside the ring.

Caption below the panel:

It's a shame the league couldn't come to an agreement with the referee's union.

Though, personally, I like new rules boxing a lot better.
comics.voteyText:
A close-up of the battered referee, his face bruised and one eye swollen, with a tooth missing and a small "hh" sound near his mouth. He says in a speech bubble:
Referee: "I'd fight back, but it's against the rules."

comics.comicText:
Panel 1: Inside a tattoo parlor. A muscular man sits in a chair getting work done. The wall behind him has flash art and a partial sign reading "OTTA T" (tattoo). His tank top reads "I LOVE" with a heart.

Panel 2: A bald, bearded, muscular man with an eyepatch reacts in shock.

Man: WHAT THE?!

(His knuckles are tattooed: "I LOVE" on one hand, "HATS" on the other.)

Panel 3: The same man, now angry, fists clenched, in a tank top and red pants.

Man: GRRRRR!

Panel 4: The tough man holds up a frilly, fancy red hat decorated with pink roses and ribbons, placing it on his head, looking content.

Man: YOU GOT LUCKY.
comics.voteyText:
A close-up line-art drawing of the tough man wearing the elaborate flower-and-ribbon hat with sunglasses, looking serene.
Caption: This is what true confidence looks like.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

A man with blond hair, standing and giving two thumbs-up, speaks to a girl with orange/red hair (seen from behind) and a blond robot boyfriend seated to the right.

Man: "Sweetie, I know you couldn't get a date for the prom, so I designed you a robot boyfriend who is programmed to love you no matter what."

The robot boyfriend (blond, in a green shirt, with a freckled/spotted face) turns and speaks, holding up a hand:

Robot boyfriend: "Hello Amy. Would you do me the honor of - EWWW! Is there a FACE somewhere under all that ACNE?!"

Caption (below panel): "I was later made aware that Amy had just gotten off the phone with her new prom date."
comics.voteyText:
A close-up of a man's face with a flat, unimpressed expression.
Text: "ANSWER PLEASE"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A blond man stands confidently with hands on hips, wearing a blue T-shirt emblazoned with a large yellow "H" and orange shorts. He addresses several shadowy silhouetted figures seated in the foreground, in what appears to be a dim hall or headquarters.

Man with "H" shirt: "SEE! I'M A QUADRIPALEGIC, BUT I CAN STILL MOVE AROUND LIKE AN ABLE-BODIED PERSON!"

Caption (below panel): Many of the superfriends were dubious of Handi-Man's claim to super powers.
comics.voteyText:
Close-up of a man's face looking slightly downcast and unimpressed.
Man: "I am offended by your reticent agreement"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A woman stands in a bedroom doorway, having just walked in on a man and a blonde woman in bed together.

Woman in doorway: OH MY GOD!

Man in bed: BABY, IT'S NOT WHAT IT LOOKS LIKE! IN FACT... IN FACT YOU'RE CHEATING ON ME.
comics.voteyText:
Close-up of the man's face, looking earnest.
Man: C'mon. Would I tell a lie that dumb?

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A magician (a man with orange hair, wearing a purple top hat with an orange band and a purple suit) holds up a playing card toward another man (a man in a yellow shirt with brown hair).

Magician: IS... THIS YOUR CARD?

Man in yellow shirt: WOW! RIGHT AGAIN!

Caption (below comic): One thing that really improved my magic skills was carrying the revolver in my off hand.
comics.voteyText:
A crude hand-drawn sketch. A figure wearing a top hat (the magician) faces a second figure who is slumped/lying down.
Magician (speech bubble): This is how David Blaine does it.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1

A priest (bald man in a black clerical collar) leans toward a younger bald man seen from behind, who wears an orange/yellow garment.

Priest: MY SON, WE ONLY HAVE A FEW MINUTES BEFORE IT'S... YOUR TIME. HAVE YOU SAID YOUR BUTTFER TODAY?

Younger man: WHAT'S A BUTTFER?

Priest: FOR POOPIN'! HAHAHAHAHA! YES! NOBODY EVER FALLS FOR THAT!
comics.voteyText:
The priest, drawn in loose sketch lines, speaks again.
Priest: Now let us pray that God grants you a dickfer.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A large green monster (guarding gold labeled "FORT KNOX") looms over a small red-haired girl in a pink shirt.

Green monster: GUARDING ALL THAT GOLD YOURSELF, LITTLE GIRL? WHAT IS YOUR POWER?

Girl: I CAN MAKE PUPPIES APPEAR ANYWHERE!

Green monster: BAHAHAHAH!

Panel 2:

Close-up of the green monster's torso. A small sound effect appears near its body.

Sound effect: scratch scratch

Panel 3:

The green monster writhes in pain, covered in puppies that have appeared on and inside its body, biting and clawing.

Green monster: ARRGGH!

Panel 4:

The red-haired girl stands alone, arms raised triumphantly, smiling.
comics.voteyText: Thought bubble above the smiling red-haired girl: I am God.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

An older bearded man in an orange shirt stands on a city street holding up a handwritten cardboard sign.

Sign: WILL WORK FOR SIGN THAT JUST SAYS "WILL WORK FOR FOOD."

Caption (below panel): "That's it," thought Homeless Ted, "climb that ladder..."
comics.voteyText:
A close-up of the same bearded man's face, with a speech bubble.
Man: Still beats my old job cartooning

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

Ninja (a masked figure dressed in black, holding a blood-stained knife): FOR YOUR TRANSGRESSIONS AGAINST NATURE, MR. BRINKLEY, YOU HAVE PAID THE ULTIMATE PRICE! NOW MASTER CHANG'S SOUL MAY REST IN PEACE!

Victim (a frightened man with pale skin in a green shirt): BUT I NEVER KILLED ANYONE! AND MY NAME IS SMITH!

Ninja: OH... WELL... YOU EVER DO ANYTHING BAD?

Victim: UH... I ONCE STOLE A BOX OF HONEY BUNS FROM THE DRUGSTORE?

Ninja: ...AND FOR THAT, YOU PERISH.
comics.voteyText: Ninja (now drawn in a simple sketch style): Technically, murder is always revenge.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A man sits at the bedside of a young girl who is tucked into bed holding a small doll. The man speaks to her.
