comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

A protest scene in front of a red brick building. Two people stand in the foreground: a smiling blonde person in a brown shirt, and a man with flame-like red hair and a bushy red beard who is raising one fist and holding up a yellow protest sign with his other hand.

Sign held by the red-haired man: "WE WANT CHANGE!"

Smaller signs in the crowd behind them read: "WE WANT [CHANGE]", "[TI]ME FOR [CHANGE]", "CHANGE NOW".

A large crowd of purple-shaded figures fills the background.

Caption (below panel): "Thanks to careful wording of our signs, we managed to convince a number of homeless people to join our protest."
comics.voteyText: A close-up line drawing of a single teardrop with a simple smiling face (two dots for eyes and a curved smile). Hand-lettered text above and beside it reads: "Makin' a difference".

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

A small figure with a green cap floating/emerging from a golden lamp with a purple swirl of genie smoke, gesturing toward a large robed man with long brown hair, a beard, and an orange crown/headdress, wearing orange robes.

Lamp figure (Jesus Jr.): I said I want 10,000 whores!

Robed man: Wouldn't you rather have a lifetime of fulfilling devotion to the one true God?

Lamp figure (Jesus Jr.): Than WHORES? No!

Caption (below panel): Being half genie, Jesus Jr. was never able to command the same respect as his dad.
comics.voteyText:
A simply-drawn smiling face with a speech bubble.
Face: Good news! All the whores are born again!

comics.comicText:
A man with brown hair, wearing a red shirt, stands outside a house at night calling up toward a window. A blonde woman leans out of the lit upper window.

Woman (from window): GET THE F*** OFF MY LAWN!

Man: BUT WHAT ABOUT THE LOVE WE HAD? WHAT ABOUT THE BEAUTIFUL POEMS YOU WROTE ME?

Woman (from window): ROSES ARE RED / VIOLETS ARE BLUE / GET THE F*** OFF MY LAWN!
comics.voteyText:
A woman's face in profile, smiling smugly and looking pleased with herself.
Woman: Perfect meter!

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A Puritan-era woods scene. A woman in a white bonnet and long white-and-black Puritan dress stands at right atop a pile of straw/kindling, hand on hip. A man in a wide-brimmed black Puritan hat sits at lower left, facing her.

Woman: BUT I'M NOT A WITCH!

Man (in black hat): BURN FOR YOUR LIES!

Caption (below panel): At this point, Reverend Winthrop made the mistake of shooting flames from his hands.
comics.voteyText:
A hand-drawn close-up of the man's face under his wide-brimmed Puritan hat, looking up.
Man: It's a miracle!

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Two green aliens sit inside the cockpit of a spacecraft, viewed through a windshield with stars and a moon outside.

Left alien: "WHY HAVE HUMANS NOT YET MASTERED WARP PROPULSION?!"

Right alien: "THEY STILL RELY ON A RIDICULOUS FORM OF MATHEMATICS CALLED 'ADDITION.'"

Caption (below panel): Sadly, it isn't until 2087 that scientists realize 2 + 2 is actually very slightly less than 4.
comics.voteyText:
A round face or circular dial speaks in a speech bubble.
Voice: "Stupid rounding errors."

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A man with long hair, a beard, and a glowing yellow halo (depicted as a Jesus-like figure) sits at a restaurant booth across from two other men, gesturing as he pitches an idea. A yellow notepad sits on the table in front of him, with small text on it reading "scribble scribble scribble."

Haloed man: "So, basically the idea is that there's this one true God who forgives you if you devote yourself to him."

Panel 2:

Close-up of the man's hands holding the yellow notepad and a pencil. The notepad is titled "IDEAS" with "JC 29AD" written in the corner. Crossed out near the top is "ANGRY SEA MONSTER" next to a doodle of a fanged sea creature. To the right, with a star/asterisk, is written "ONE TRUE GOD" with an arrow pointing to it.

Notepad text: IDEAS / JC 29AD

Notepad text (crossed out): ANGRY SEA MONSTER

Notepad text: * ONE TRUE GOD
comics.voteyText:
Close-up of the haloed man's smiling face looking upward.
Haloed man: "Thank me copyright hasn't been invented yet."

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Child: MOMMY... I HAVE A QUESTION... WHY DID I WAKE UP NEXT TO A DEAD RACOON THIS MORNING?

Woman: I HAVE A QUESTION FOR YOU! YOU CALL THIS A MACARONI PAINTING?!

Caption (below panel): "I could barely even read the 'I love you'"
comics.voteyText:
A close-up of the woman's angry face.
Woman: You're fired!

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A woman in a doctor's white coat and pink shirt, with a head mirror, stands beside a large spinning wheel mounted on a green post. She gestures toward the wheel with one hand.

Doctor: STEP RIGHT UP AND SPIN THE WHEEL OF DIAGNOSIS!

The wheel's pointer (arrow) has landed on a wedge labeled "PERMANENT ERECTILE DYSFUNCTION." A red-haired man in a teal/green shirt stands in the foreground facing the doctor and the wheel, his arm raised.

Caption (below panel): "Ouch, bad spin! Shame you can't sue fate for malpractice."
comics.voteyText:
A roughly drawn close-up of the red-haired man's face looking dismayed/dejected.
Man: Probability is so cruel

comics.comicText:
Title banner: SMBC PRESENTS: PARENTING TIPS! EPISODE ONE: ENCOURAGEMENT

Panel 1:

A man holds a child while gazing up at a starry night sky.

Man: "Someday son, someone is going to set up the first colony on Mars. And son, that colony is going to need a janitor."

Caption below the panel: "You could live long enough to read about him."
comics.voteyText:
A close-up sketch of the man's head in profile.
Man: "If you were a better reader."

comics.comicText:
Title banner: SMBC PRESENTS: MARRIAGE TIPS! EPISODE ONE: "STAYING POSITIVE"

Panel 1 (labeled "WRONG WAY"): A woman with reddish-brown hair stands with her arms crossed, facing a man (seen from behind). She frowns.

Woman: "I hope you die."

Panel 2 (labeled "RIGHT WAY"): The same woman now smiles brightly and gives two thumbs up, facing the man.

Woman: "I hope you die!"
comics.voteyText:
A sketchy hand-drawn smiling face speaks cheerfully.
Face: "I'll be there for you!"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (header banner): RELATIONSHIP QUIZ!

Panel 1 (body, a quiz on a pink note):

WHY DID SHE BREAK UP WITH YOU?

A) 3 AM PRANK PHONECALLS.

B) FREQUENT USE OF THE TERM "MISS TUBBYCHUNKS."

C) MAKING OUT WITH OTHER WOMEN.

D) ARSENIC IN COFFEE.

E) ASKED HER TO STOP DOING A THROUGH D.
comics.voteyText: A woman with a displeased expression, speech bubble: "You're smothering my creativity!"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A man with red hair lies on green grass, head turned to the side, eyes closed, with blood spattered on his face and trickling from his mouth. He appears to be dying or dead.

Caption (below panel): As final thoughts go "unicorns are real" is one of the better ones.
comics.voteyText:
A hand-drawn unicorn's head in profile, with a speech bubble.
Unicorn: Real as it gets muthafucka

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A woman with orange hair and a man dressed as Batman (blue cowl, gray suit, yellow bat emblem) sit close together in a dark room.

Woman: WOW, IT'S INVISIBLE!?

Batman: UH... UH... YEAH... BABY... PRETTY COOL, HUH?

Caption (below panel):

Ladies beware:

There is no such thing as a Bat-condom.
comics.voteyText:
Handwritten text on a plain bordered panel:
Also, no Bat-paternity.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A man in a blue shirt and tie leans across a desk, shouting and pressing a hot branding iron against the chest of another man.

Man in blue shirt: "THIS is what I think of your budget proposal!"

Sound effects from the iron searing the other man's flesh: "sizzle sizzle sizzle"

The branded man screams in pain.

Below the panel, a close-up of a bare torso/belly shows the resulting brand seared into the skin, reading: "GOOD IDEA NEEDS WORK"
comics.voteyText: A close-up of a bare belly with a smaller branded mark seared into it, reading: "GREAT COFFEE TODD"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A man with red hair in a yellow shirt holds up his hands defensively, looking alarmed. He faces a woman with long reddish-brown hair (seen from behind/side) who holds up a small knife.

Man: "OH MY GOD! ARE YOU KILLING ME BECAUSE I CHEATED ON YOU WITH YOUR STEPMOM?!"

Caption (below panel): "Well then, now the birthday knife has two purposes."
comics.voteyText:
A crudely drawn figure (a head and shoulders in simple outline) is shown facing a sign or wall with hand-lettered text.
Text: "PLEASE STOP CHEATING"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A man with orange hair in a green shirt kneels and hands a small red booklet to a young blonde girl in a pink dress.

Man: SWEETIE, I KNOW GIRLS ARE BECOMING SEXUALLY ACTIVE A LOT YOUNGER THESE DAYS, SO I MADE YOU THIS HANDY FLOW CHART.

Below the panel, a red card with a downward arrow at the top reads: NO.
comics.voteyText:
A black-and-white sketch panel. A person with curly hair leans toward a smaller figure, gesturing.
Person: WANNA NOT HAVE SEX?

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A bald monk in orange/yellow robes points aggressively at another bald monk, shouting.

Pointing monk: "YES! IN YOUR FACE! I'M THE GREATEST! IN YOUR FACE FATASS! IN YOUR FACE!"

Caption (below panel): Chen Hu had just won the World Championships of Zen Buddhism.
comics.voteyText:
The gloating figure grabs the other person's head and gives them a noogie.
Gloating figure: "OH YEAH!"
Gloating figure: "NOO-GIE"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (title banner): SMBC PRESENTS: "PICK-UP LINES THAT DON'T WORK."

Panel 1 (scene): A grinning red-haired man holds out a bouquet of flowers toward a woman (only her hair and shoulder are visible).

Red-haired man: MY WIFE GOT ME THESE!
comics.voteyText:
The same man, drawn in loose black-and-white sketch style, still grinning and holding up the bouquet toward the woman.
Man: MAY SHE REST IN PEACE.

comics.comicText:
Setting: a date at a cafe (a sign reading "CAFE" is visible on the wall). A woman (seen from behind, brown hair) sits across from a smiling man with orange hair in a green shirt.

Woman: BEFORE THIS DATE STARTS, I SHOULD TELL YOU I'M INCREDIBLY INSECURE ABOUT MY HORRIBLE-

Man: WAIT! DON'T TELL ME! I LOVE GUESSING. IS IT THE FACE?! IT'S THE FACE, RIGHT? NO?

Caption (below panel): Thirty guesses later, I found out it was her car.
comics.voteyText:
The same couple at the cafe, drawn in a loose black-and-white sketch style, with a waiter standing nearby.
Man: WAITER, I THINK I'LL HAVE-
Woman: A FACELIFT? IS IT A FACELIFT?!

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (label: TEN HOURS AGO):

Man: So, 13.7 billion years ago, an incredibly dense point of...

Panel 2 (label: EIGHT HOURS AGO):

Man: ...amino acids came together, forming complex polymers...

Panel 3 (label: SIX HOURS AGO):

Man: ...australopithecines developed bipedalism, which...

Panel 4 (label: FOUR HOURS AGO):

Man: ...then Aristotle, born in 384 B.C., was...

Panel 5 (label: TWO HOURS AGO):

Man: ...and in 1905, a man named Ernest Hackett met my mother...

Panel 6 (no time label):

Man: Very eloquent. But, you know what would've been better? If you had STARTED with "you have herpes."
comics.voteyText: No text. The man holds a telephone receiver to his ear and speaks into it; the back of a listener's head fills the right side of the panel.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A dark room. The silhouette of a man (referred to in the caption as Jeff) hangs by his neck from a rope, having apparently hanged himself. On a table beside him rests a handwritten sign that reads: "COULDN'T FIND MY CAR KEYS!"

Caption (below panel): All was desolate silence, save for the soft metallic jangle eminating from Jeff's coat pocket.
comics.voteyText: A simple line drawing of a person sitting on a toilet, holding up a handwritten sign that reads: "OUT OF TOILET PAPER!"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel): Two figures sit close together outdoors at night, seen from behind — an older man with brown hair in a brown jacket on the left, and a younger man (the son) with orange hair in a green shirt on the right.

Older man: "Son, you should love a woman the same way you love a beautiful tree."

Son: "Wow, that's a wonderful metaphor."

Older man: "Metaphor? Oh, yeah. Hey! Look at that!" (gesturing off to the side)

Caption below the panel: "Surreptitiously, I brushed the bark out of my teeth."
comics.voteyText:
A close-up scene. A person leans in toward another figure who is wearing a pink outfit with the word "PRINCESS" written across it.
Speaker (the person leaning in): "You look nice tonight"

comics.comicText:
Title banner: SMBC PRESENTS: BUILDING A STRONG MARRIAGE EPISODE ONE: "HONESTY IS THE BEST POLICY"

Panel 1: A man in a chef's hat and apron stands at a backyard barbecue grill, holding a grilling fork, smiling. A woman with brown hair sits at a table in the foreground with a plate of food.

Woman: HOW'S THE STEAK?

Panel 2 (same scene):

Woman: IT'S DELICIOUS, THOUGH YOU'VE NEVER SATISFIED ME SEXUALLY.
comics.voteyText:
A close-up of the woman, looking annoyed/deadpan.
Woman: FATASS.

comics.comicText:
TRANSCRIPT

Main comic (a single image of a yellow test/worksheet paper with printed instructions and handwritten work):

Printed text at top:

Show your work and box in your answers.

1) x2 + 6x + 9 = x + 3

Solve for x.

Handwritten algebra work below:

x² + 6x + 9 = x + 3

x² + 6x = x - 6

x² = -5x - 6

x = [boxed answer]

The final boxed "answer" reads (in handwriting):

I know you're sleeping with the principal's wife

Marked in large red pen across the bottom of the paper: A++
comics.voteyText:
A bald man (the principal) shouts angrily, leaning forward:
Principal: I KNOW ABOUT YOU AND MY WIFE!
A second figure, seen from behind, raises a hand nervously and replies:
Other man: UHH... A++?

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

Two human brains sit on green pedestals/platforms in a dark room. Each brain has a cardboard speech bubble propped near it.

Brain 1 (left): "HEY, WHAT DID ONE BRAIN SAY TO THE OTHER?"

Brain 2 (right): "I LOBE YOU!"

Caption (below panel): "Adding those cardboard speech bubbles made me feel a whole lot better about the double homicide."
comics.voteyText: A small bird stands on top of a box or block. A cat's face peeks up from the lower left. A speech bubble points to the bird reading: "I [heart] U!" On the front of the box, text reads: "AWW..."

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A man with brown hair is screaming, his body wracked, against a bright green background with jagged red shock-burst shapes around him.

Man: AAAAAAH!

Panel 2:

Label in upper-left corner: EARLIER...

A green genie with pointed ears, a turban-like headpiece, and a wispy tail emerges, arms crossed. A man's head (the brown-haired man from panel 1) is in the foreground looking up at the genie.

Genie: I wish that... just once... YOU could have YOUR wish.
comics.voteyText:
A woman holds up a lockpick / tension wrench in front of a door.
Woman: HEY, I PICKED THE LOCK ON THE DOOR!
A second speech bubble (the door/lock): STOP IT!

comics.comicText:
Main comic (single panel):

A nun stands amid red and purple flames in Hell, looking confused. A horned devil figure faces her.

Nun: "HEY! WHY AM I IN HELL?!"

Devil: "REMEMBER THAT PHRASE YOU WERE ALWAYS USING?"

Devil: "GOD WORKS IN MYSTERIOUS WAYS?"

Devil: "BINGO."
comics.voteyText:
A bald man wearing a clerical collar (a priest) stands in the clouds, mouth open in shock.
Priest: "WHAT THE?!"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

An elderly man named Henry lies in bed, eyes shut, looking frail. An elderly woman with curly gray hair sits beside him, holding his hand.

Henry: THINGS ARE GETTING DARK... BEFORE I DIE, I WANT TO TELL YOU SOMETHING I'VE... KEPT TO MYSELF ALL THESE YEARS...

Woman: OF COURSE. WHAT IS IT HENRY?

Henry: YOU HAVE A *REALLY* IRRITATING LAUGH.
comics.voteyText:
The elderly woman, mouth wide open, laughing.
Woman: HWAH! HWAH! HWAH!

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A woman with brown hair coaches a bald man in an orange prison/inmate-style jumpsuit.

Woman: NOW REMEMBER, YOU DIDN'T KILL HER. IT WAS AN ACCIDENT. AND WHAT DO WE CALL THAT?

Bald man: MANSLAUGHTER.

Woman: VERY GOOD.

Panel 2:

The bald man is now on the witness stand in a courtroom, a judge visible in the background.

Caption box: SUBSEQUENTLY...

Bald man: AND THEN I MANSLAUGHTERED HER! RIGHT IN THE FACE!
comics.voteyText:
A close-up of the bald man's face, mid-shout.
Man: WITH MY WIFE-KILLIN' KNIFE!

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A bald lecturer with glasses, wearing a brown jacket and blue tie, stands at a podium pointing a pointer at a diagram on a screen.

Lecturer: "SO, AS YOU CAN SEE HERE, THIS GENE IS FOUND ONLY ON THE Y CHROMOSOME."

Diagram on screen (FIG 4.9): Titled "THE SEXISM GENE." Shows two chromosomes. The left one (Y-shaped) has a highlighted blue gene marked on it, with the pointer indicating it. The right one is an X chromosome.

Caption below the comic: "You know, the chromosome that matters."
comics.voteyText:
A rougher black-and-white sketch of the same lecturer pointing at another diagram.
Diagram (FIG 4.10): "CHEATING BITCH GENE" next to an X chromosome.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Doctor (a man in a white coat and glasses, speaking to two silhouetted parents): IT'S A BIT UNORTHODOX, BUT IT'S THE ONLY 100% CERTAIN METHOD TO KEEP YOUR CHILDREN FROM TEENAGE PREGNANCY.

Panel 2:

The two parents (a woman and a man), looking distressed: OH GOD.

Panel 3:

The father stands in a doorway addressing his red-haired son: HEY SON... I... I HAVE SOMETHING FOR YOU.

Panel 4:

The father holds out a book toward his son. The book cover reads: DUNGEONS & DRAGONS PLAYER'S HANDBOOK.

Panel 5:

Label: PROM NIGHT...

A blonde girl leans toward the red-haired son: WANNA HAVE SEX?

The son: NO THANKS. MY DAD CRUSHED MY GENITALS IN A DUNGEONS AND DRAGONS MANUAL.
comics.voteyText:
The doctor leans toward the father and asks: DID YOUR SON ENJOY READING THE BOOK?
The father: UH OH.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel): A hospital room. A woman with brown hair, glasses, and a green shirt sits in a chair leaning over a hospital bed, speaking to a woman with reddish hair in a blue gown who is lying in the bed.

Brown-haired woman: OH MY GOD! YOU'RE AWAKE!

Woman in bed: WHA... WHERE AM I?

Brown-haired woman: THE HOSPITAL! YOU WERE IN A COMA FOR TWELVE YEARS. I NEVER LEFT THIS CHAIR FOR A MOMENT!

Woman in bed: I KNOW YOU DIDN'T, HONEY. I KNOW.

Caption (below panel): Looking down, I noticed Sharon poking at my paunch.
comics.voteyText:
A simple line-drawing of a person's face looking down/away with a flat expression.
Speech bubble: I think we should see other people.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A man with reddish-brown hair, wearing an orange shirt and blue shorts, stands writing at a green chalkboard mounted on a brown wall. On the board are mathematical expressions including "y =", "d f(x)", a summation symbol, and "f(x,y)".

Man: MY GOD! IT'S EXACTLY THE SAME!

Caption (below panel):

Much to his amazement, after taking the differential of the coefficient, Professor Werner discovers he is still a virgin.
comics.voteyText:
Handwritten title at top: "Reading this 9 years later..."
A bearded man with a downcast, weary expression.
Man: Caption makes no sense.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (beach scene):

A woman with red hair and sunglasses, an older gray-haired woman, and a muscular man in a blue-and-red superhero costume stand on a beach. The superhero looks troubled, hand to his chin.

Woman (speech balloon): FOR WEEKS NOW! HE JUST SITS THERE STARING AT THAT WALL AND CRYING ALL DAY, AND NOBODY KNOWS WHY!

Panel 2 (flashback inset, labeled "RECENTLY..."):

The superhero, face contorted in anguish, fires a beam from his eyes. A bald villain in a green-and-purple outfit stands in a doorway holding a device and points it back at him.

Villain (speech balloon): SO LONG, X-RAY VISION
comics.voteyText:
A man's face, drawn in simple line art, looks downcast.
Man (speech balloon): Life is pointless.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A woman with red hair, round glasses, and a white lab coat grins widely as she raises a cane and brings it down on an elderly man. The old man, with white spiky hair and glasses knocked askew, recoils in pain, mouth open in a grimace, with a yellow impact-burst behind his head.

Woman: REMARKABLE!

Caption below the panel:

My research on bone density in the elderly is going extremely well.

So, I decided to celebrate by caning that old man.
comics.voteyText:
A close-up of the red-haired woman's face (drawn loosely in black-and-white sketch style), looking content.
Woman: It's nice to do something for yourself now and then.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A red, muscular demon with horns and flame-like fire surrounding its body looms out of a dark, rocky cave wall, holding out a small pink tooth.

Demon: GOOD! ONE MORE AND HER SOUL SHALL BE MINE!

A shadowy figure (the tooth fairy) is silhouetted in the foreground, dropping or handing over the tooth.

Tooth fairy (silhouette): YES, MY MASTER

Caption below the panel:

Ever wonder what the tooth fairy does with all those teeth?

Your parents know.
comics.voteyText:
A dentist wearing a headlamp/mirror leans over a patient, holding a dental instrument near the patient's mouth, laughing maniacally.
Dentist: LOOKS LIKE WE'LL HAVE TO EXTRACT A FEW MOLARS!
Dentist: HHHAH AHAHAH!

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Elderly woman (seated on a couch, being interviewed): EVEN THOUGH I'VE LOST HIM, I CAN TAKE COMFORT IN KNOWING THAT HE DIED DOING WHAT HE LOVED.

Newspaper headline (shown below the panel):

AVIATOR "LOVED" CRASHING PLANE FULL OF TODDLERS
comics.voteyText:
The devil (holding a pitchfork, with horns) speaks to a man wearing an aviator's cap:
Devil: SORRY, YOU WERE GONNA GO TO HEAVEN TILL GOD READ THAT HEADLINE

comics.comicText:
Single panel.

Setting: An outdoor gallows on a grassy hillside under a blue sky. A wooden platform holds a young man with orange/red hair, a purple short-sleeved shirt, and blue pants. A noose hangs from the gallows frame beside him, but there is no trap door. In the foreground, the back of an executioner's head and bare shoulders is visible; the executioner wears a brown cloth hood with two eye holes.

Condemned man (orange hair): "THAT'S IT?"

Executioner: "YOU'LL DIE EVENTUALLY."

Caption (below the panel): "In order to be more humane, we removed the trap door from our gallows."
comics.voteyText:
A rough black-and-white sketch panel. A man holds a telephone receiver to his ear, looking exasperated.
Man (on phone): "THIS IS TAKING FOREVER!"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Dentist (wild-eyed, wearing a head mirror and scrubs, holding a dental tool): WE MUST PERFORM A CAESARIAN IMMEDIATELY!

Caption (below panel): I'm starting to lose confidence in my dentist.
comics.voteyText:
Dentist (grinning): SEE! NOW YOU'RE NOT THINKING ABOUT THAT TOOTHACHE!
(The patient, a woman, looks unconvinced/unamused.)

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A man with orange flame-like hair, wearing a blue suit and yellow shirt, waves and grins at a blonde woman in a black dress holding a glass of champagne. They are at a party, with silhouetted partygoers in the purple background.

Man: HEY BITCH!

The blonde woman scowls, gritting her teeth in irritation.

Caption (below panel): "If there is one thing i hate, it's informality," grumbled Bitchina.
comics.voteyText:
The same scene redrawn in rough black-and-white sketch style. The bald-ish man waves at the scowling blonde woman.
Man: HEY TINA!

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A red-haired woman holds out a large golden trophy toward a brown-haired man, presenting it to him. The trophy's base reads: "OKAY IN BED AWARD".

Caption (below panel):

Steve had been complaining about how he never won anything.

So, I told him he could share this with his brother.
comics.voteyText: A hand-drawn sketch of a smiling woman's face with a speech bubble above her reading: "Ironically, it's huge."

comics.comicText:
Panel 1: A large bearded warrior wearing a horned Viking helmet and blue plaid clothing stands looming above. To the side, a small red sun/star icon glows.

A crowned figure (a king with a crown and goggles): "MY LORD!"

A man in a yellow tunic with a red circle emblem: "THE ICE GIANT ATTACKS!"

Panel 2: The crowned king, shown with a crown, goggles, and beard.

King: "FIRE THE SHRINK RAY!"

Panel 3: A grey ray-gun device fires a beam.

Sound effect: "VZZZHH!"

Panel 4: The green-and-yellow shrinking beam travels across and strikes the giant bearded warrior in the horned helmet and blue plaid clothing.

Panel 5: A view of outer space — a green beam streaks toward a red, fiery exploding star/sun against a starfield, with a sliver of a planet below.

Panel 6: The bearded warrior in the horned helmet, now looking down with an annoyed/angry expression, while far below stands a tiny shrunken figure in a yellow tunic with a red emblem (the now-miniaturized king/people) on an icy landscape.
comics.voteyText: The bearded warrior in the horned helmet, in a speech bubble: "Frost giants love irony"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A blonde woman with her hands pressed to the sides of her head, eyes shut, speaks dramatically to a man with reddish-brown hair and glasses seen from behind.

Woman: "I'm sorry I'm so pathetic! My mom left when I was two, and I've been an indecisive wimp ever since! Oh god! I think I may start crying again! Could you hand me my pink hanky?"

Caption (below panel): "I hate when Cheryl does her impression of me."
comics.voteyText:
A hand-drawn close-up of a wide-eyed face looking shocked/deadpan.
Voice (speech bubble): "You got the voice right, but that's it!"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (title banner): SMBC PRESENTS: HEADLINES FROM THE DAY YOU DIE

Panel 2 (a newspaper): WORLD'S GREATEST LEADER DIES PEACEFULLY IN SLEEP

Caption below the comic: Oh, sorry. Skip to page V-45 for the picture of the four-hundred pound corpse clutching a stack of Playboys and Archie Comics.

Before you committed suicide, you killed him for stealing your girlfriend.
comics.voteyText: Also, you died when there were still newspapers.

comics.comicText:
Single panel:

A priest (Father Steve, seen as a large profile face on the right) leads a Halloween eucharist for three children dressed in costumes. The children stand behind a wooden coffin-like box draped with red cloth. comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

Header text (yellow box): EXPERIMENTAL SMBC. THIS MAY LOOK LIKE A BLANK PANEL, BUT IF YOU PROJECT YOUR IDENTITY INTO THE EMPTY SPACE, YOU'LL DISCOVER THE METAHUMOR IN THE ABSURDITY OF CONVEYING REAL MOMENTS IN TWO-DIMENSIONAL IMAGES:

Below the header: a large empty white panel (intentionally blank).

Editor's Note (below the comic): *Editor's Note: : I find it's also funny if you imagine a butt.
comics.voteyText:
A man sits at a desktop computer, viewed from behind/side.
Man: HYEH HYEH. ALL COMICS FROM NOW ON WILL END WITH "BUTT"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A bearded man with messy brown hair, wearing a green jacket, stands and gestures angrily across a table at another man (seen from behind, short brown hair, glasses). On the table between them sit two children's books.

Bearded man: "LOOK, HALF OF MARRIAGES TODAY END IN DIVORCE! IT'S NOT INAPPROPRIATE MATERIAL FOR KIDS! IT'S INFORMATION THEY NEED TO KNOW!"

Other man: "NO."

Inset / book cover (a children's book on the table):

Title: "MAYBE IT IS YOUR FAULT"

(Cover art shows a smiling green cartoon baby standing between a blue-rattle symbol with a male sign and a pink balloon with a female sign.)
comics.voteyText: A hand-drawn children's book page. Text reads: "IF WE HADN'T LOVED YOU WE'D HAVE HAD TIME TO BE TWO" beside two simple frowning cartoon faces.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Bald scientist in a white lab coat (excited): WE CONNECTED A COMPUTER'S CPU DIRECTLY INTO A RAT'S CEREBRAL CORTEX!

Interviewer (a man in a fedora, taking notes): AMAZING! AND WHAT WERE YOUR FINDINGS?

Scientist: RATS HATE THAT!
comics.voteyText: The bald, bespectacled scientist holds up a book/report titled "RAT HUMAN STUDIES 92-07" and says: THEY ALSO HATE KICKIN'

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Girl with red pigtails: OH MY GOD! IT'S MR. THOMPSON! FROM FIRST PERIOD ENGLISH!

Boy with curly blond hair: MR. THOMPSON? IS HE... IS HE DEAD?

The two children stand over a large body lying on the ground, the boy reaching toward it.

Caption (below panel): There were few things more traumatic in my boyhood than discovering I'd murdered the wrong teacher.
comics.voteyText:
The man on the ground (Mr. Thompson): WAIT! I'M ALI-
[SFX] BANG!
The blond boy points a gun at the wounded man, cutting off his plea with a gunshot.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1: A child in a winter hat looks up at a shooting star crossing a dark purple night sky.

Panel 2: The child, smiling and wearing a blue pom-pom hat and coat, stands in a snowy scene.

Child: I WISH EVERY DAY WAS CHRISTMAS!

Panel 3: Caption box: SUMMER...

The same person, now grown into a man wearing overalls and a straw hat, stands in a snow-covered field beside a dead cornstalk, holding a hoe.

Man: STILL?

Panel 4: A woman in a green dress confronts the man (in a red plaid shirt and straw hat), who holds his head in his hand. A small child stands between them.

Woman: WHY DIDN'T YOU USE OUR SAVINGS TO BUY FOOD?

Man: I... COULDN'T.

Woman: WHY NOT?

Panel 5: Close-up of the man's anguished, lined face.

Panel 6: The man, looking miserable, holds out a stack of wrapped Christmas presents toward the woman, who has her back to us.

Man: MERRY CHRISTMAS.
comics.voteyText:
A man (the child from the start, now grown) yells angrily while another figure in a Santa-like hat grins beside him.
Man: PLEASE STOP THIS! THE ELVES ARE ALL DEAD OF EXHAUSTION!
Grinning figure: NEVER!

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

A bald man standing behind a couch speaks to a red-haired woman seated on the couch holding a small box.

Man: I'M GONNA GO CHEAT ON YOU WITH MY SECRETARY WHILE IMAGINING THE LOVELIFE WE HAD WHEN WE WERE NEWLYWEDS.

Woman: I'M GONNA SIT UP WAITING FOR YOU AND CRYING, DRINK MYSELF INTO A STUPOR, THEN YELL SOMETHING PSYCHOLOGICALLY DAMAGING TO THE KIDS.

Caption (below panel): The foundation of a good marriage is honesty.
comics.voteyText:
The red-haired woman speaks to the bald man, who now has a knife stuck in the side of his head.
Woman: I JUST STABBED YOU IN THE HEAD.
Man: STILL THINKING ABOUT THE SECRETARY.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (main):

An orange truck drives down a suburban street, music notes coming from it. The side of the truck reads "SAD TRUTHS" in purple lettering. The driver leans out the window.

Driver (from the truck): NO ONE WILL EVER LOVE YOU!

Caption (below panel): I liked it better when we had an ice cream man.
comics.voteyText:
Label: EARLIER...
A white truck reading "ICE CREAM" on its side, with a picture of a child on it. The driver leans out the window.
Driver: NO ONE WILL EVER LOVE YOU, BUT I HAVE POPSICLES

comics.comicText:
Title banner: SMBC PRESENTS

UNTRUE TRUISMS: EPISODE 1: "CURIOSITY KILLED THE CAT"

Panel (single image): A large bottle labeled "BLEACH" sits tipped over on its side. Its cap is off, and a small amount of liquid has spilled out onto the surface, trailing toward the foreground. There is no cat or other character visible in the scene.
comics.voteyText: A man with flame-like (orange) hair, seen in profile, thinks to himself in a thought bubble: "OKAY, THIS ONE HAS GOT TO GET ME SOME HATEMAIL."

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A blonde woman holds a garden hose nozzle and blasts a high-pressure jet of water at a small child with flame-red hair, who is pinned against the wall and drenched.

Woman: "LIARS ARE UNCLEAN! UNCLEAN!"

Caption (below panel): I don't believe in spanking.
comics.voteyText:
Close-up of the blonde woman's smiling face, with a speech bubble.
Woman: "That's all the water you get today"

comics.comicText:
Main comic:

Panel 1: A young boy with red, flame-like hair wearing a green shirt points and shouts at a couple (a woman with long brown hair and a man) who face him.

Boy: EWWW!

Caption beneath the panel: Never hire a sex therapist under the age of twelve.
comics.voteyText:
Header bar: MOMENTS EARLIER...
The same couple, smiling, address the red-haired boy (seen from behind).
Woman: We love each other.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Blonde woman (gripping a brown-haired man by the shoulder): WOULD YOU LOVE ME MORE IF I WEREN'T STABBING YOU RIGHT NOW?!

Brown-haired man: Y-YES...

Blonde woman: DON'T TRY TO CHANGE ME!

Caption (below panel): The first date went about as well as I'd expected.
comics.voteyText:
Close-up of the brown-haired man's face, smiling with a small trickle of blood at the corner of his mouth.
Man: kiss goodnight?

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Woman with orange hair (an etiquette teacher): "AND EVERY TIME YOU BREAK ONE OF THE RULES? *BWORGH!* BELCH IN THE FACE!"

(She is leaning across a table toward two seated children, having just belched in one child's face.)

Caption below the panel: I hate etiquette class.
comics.voteyText: A close-up of an unhappy, frowning face. Handwritten speech above: "Use the salad fork, you shit."

comics.comicText:
Panel 1: A masked, armored villain (green hooded cloak, metal face mask) stands looking out into a starry sky.

Panel 2: A wide shot of a desolate, cratered, brown planetary surface under a black starry sky. A small caped figure stands alone on the surface.

Caped figure: AH CRAP.

Panel 3 (captioned "EARLIER..."): The caped hero (blue suit, red cape, red chest emblem with a stylized "S") watches a video screen. On the screen, the masked villain in green appears.

Villain (on screen): PLUTO IS MINE, SUPERJERK! HAHAHAHAHAHA!

Caped hero: OH... OKAY!
comics.voteyText: Text scrawled in the black sky above a white mountainous surface: IT'S NOT EVEN A PLANET!

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel, surrounded by a very thick black border):

A small green field with a few scattered rocks and tufts of grass. A boy with orange hair, wearing a blue shirt and brown shorts, lies sprawled face-down on the ground, arms outstretched. At the lower right edge of the field stands the top of a metal playground slide (just the ladder/chute structure is visible).

Caption (below the panel): Before slides.
comics.voteyText: A hand-drawn gold starburst/explosion shape with text inside reading: "SMBC: NOW 70% PANEL BORDER"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A green-clad criminal (green fedora, yellow bandana mask, green coat) confronts a blond superhero whose chest bears a "WP" emblem.

Criminal: "PILLOW MAN? HOW ARE YOU GONNA STOP ME WITH A - AAAH!!!"

Caption (below panel): "Criminals beware! Pillow Man also has a gun."
comics.voteyText:
A close-up of a stern man's face (the superhero, Pillow Man).
Text (handwritten, beside him): "It's not murder if I think you're guilty"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

A blonde woman behind a counter is talking to a balding man in a brown jacket who is seated across from her. The man is holding a small device pointed at the woman.

Woman: AND SO THEN WE MOVED BACK TO... DID YOU JUST TRY TO TRANQUILIZE ME?

Man: UH... YEAH, I SUPPOSE I DID.

Woman: I'M ACTUALLY NATURALLY IMMUNE. WEIRD, HUH?

Man: Y-YEAH.

Caption (below panel): Man, she was really making this awkward.
comics.voteyText:
A close-up of the blonde woman smiling.
Woman: It just makes me more chatty!

comics.comicText:
Panel 1: A bald scientist in a lab coat speaks excitedly to an older professor.

Bald scientist: PROFESSOR, LOOK! WE'VE CREATED AN ANTIBODY THAT COULD CURE YOUR WIFE!

Professor: OH! AND JUST IN THE NICK OF TIME!

The professor leans in to look through a microscope. The view through the microscope shows a slide reading: SUCKER!

Caption (below the comic): It took three years' research to make the particles do that.
comics.voteyText:
Top banner text: THAT NIGHT...
A bald man (the professor) speaks happily.
Professor: HEY HONEY THEY FOUND A CURE!

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

A man in a brown coat (left): "NO, DON'T! THAT'S POACHING!"

The same man: "BUT-"

A hunter in a pith helmet aiming a shotgun (right): "NOPE. I CHECKED. IT'S NOT ENDANGERED."

Sound effect from the gun: "BANG!"

Caption below the panel: "Specifically, Dodo Birds are extinct."
comics.voteyText:
A man (left): "ENJOYING YOUR DODO?!"
The hunter, now seated and eating (right): "*SIGH* I MISS THE DINOSAUR MEAT OF MY BOYHOOD..."

comics.comicText:
Main comic (single panel):

A man with curly orange hair, wearing a doctor's head mirror, sits behind a desk grinning at a patient (seen from behind, with brown hair) who is seated across from him. On the wall behind the doctor are two mounted axes, each under a labeled plaque.

Wall plaques: "HUNTIN'" (above the left axe), "DOCTORIN'" (above the right axe).

Doctor (speech balloon): "SO YOU NEED AN APPENDECTOMY?!"

Patient (thought bubble): "OH GOD..."

Caption below the panel: "I hope he remembers to use the doctorin' axe."
comics.voteyText:
The orange-haired doctor leans toward the patient, holding the axe.
Doctor: "HOLD STILL! TRY TO STICK OUT YOUR APPENDIX."

comics.comicText:
Title banner: SMBC PRESENTS: NEW TAKES ON MISOGYNY

Panel 1:

An unshaven man in a green tank top gestures with an open hand as he speaks.

Man: "Women who work the same job as men make 75 cents on the dollar! Why should they be treated equally if they only make 3/4ths of what a man makes?"
comics.voteyText:
A woman with glasses, leaning her cheek on her hand, addresses the man (seen from behind).
Woman: "This job interview is over."

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A brown-haired girl in overalls, pointing: "LOOK! IT'S LAFFY, THE LAUGHING DUCK!"

A blonde child: "HE CAN ONLY TALK IN LAUGHS!"

The duck (yellow, perched on a gray rock): "HI HI HI HI HI HI HI HI HI HI HI HI HI HI! *"

Caption below the panel:

"* Translation:

I wish you could judge me by something

other than this horrible psychological condition."
comics.voteyText:
Handwritten text beside the duck's head: "All is darkness for Laughing Duck."
(The duck is drawn alone, in a simple line-art style.)

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

An older woman (Janet) stands beside a younger red-haired woman (Allison) at a cemetery, looking toward a small gravestone.

Janet: "Allison, I was always sorry you never had more than a piece of granite for a father."

Panel 2:

A wider view reveals the "gravestone" is actually a man whose head and torso are a slab of granite, wearing a collared shirt. The two women stand to the left, the older woman holding what looks like a piece of stone.

Granite man: "That's racist, Janet."
comics.voteyText:
A man speaks to a figure whose head and arm are made of stone.
Man: "Sorry, Rocky."
Stone figure: "You take that back!"

comics.comicText:
Title banner: SMBC PRESENTS: ETHICAL CONUNDRUMS!

QUESTION: HOW CAN ATHEISTS BE ETHICAL? THEY DON'T BELIEVE IN A HIGHER POWER.

ANSWER: YES THEY DO.

A crowd of people raise their arms toward a towering purple-robed deity figure with a glowing emblem, chanting.

Crowd: "ALL HAIL ATHE! ALL HAIL ATHE!"
comics.voteyText:
A close-up of the white deity figure (Athe) with eyes closed.
Athe: "I DON'T EXIST!"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Batman (off to the left, only his cowl and cape visible): QUICK! LEX LUTHOR HAS TAKEN OVER AUSTRALIA!

Superman (center, smirking): OH NO! IF ONLY ONE OF US WERE AN ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE CLERK!

A man at a desk with a computer (background right, dryly): OH, HA HA.

Caption (below panel): The Green Lantern's life took a significant downturn after he lost his magic ring.
comics.voteyText: No dialogue. A man in a lab coat (loose-line sketch style) reaches over and wears a glowing green ring on his finger while pulling open the waistband/underwear of another figure, peering down inside.

comics.comicText:
Main comic:

A child (a boy with brown hair, seen from behind) stands talking to a man with red-orange hair and a mustache, wearing a green polo shirt, in a kitchen.

Child: "Daddy, what's heaven?"

Man: "Son, do you remember when your dog died?"

Caption below the panel: "I hadn't actually heard what Billy said. I just find this really funny."
comics.voteyText:
A rough black-and-white sketch of the same scene. A child (curly-haired, seen from behind) talks to a man.
Child: "Is my dog in heaven?"
Man: "Remember when your cat died?"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

An older woman with orange hair and glasses (a marriage counselor or older relative) addresses a younger couple.

Woman with orange hair: "One of our marriage strategies is that whenever you feel the urge to say something hurtful, just say 'I love you.'"

Panel 2:

Caption: SOON...

The younger couple is in bed at night. The woman, looking angry/strained, leans over the sleeping man.

Woman: "I love you! You know why? Because I love you!"
comics.voteyText:
A close-up of an angry, gritted-teeth face.
Handwritten text: "So much."

comics.comicText:
Single panel:

An older man in a dark suit and yellow shirt (gray hair and beard) sits at a desk across from a younger person with orange/blonde hair in a blue top, seen from behind. The setting looks like a therapy or counseling session.

Man: "I feel that a lot of your self esteem issues stem from being so f**king stupid."

Man: "Fatass."

Other person: "Well, I-"
comics.voteyText:
A rough sketch close-up of a person's face looking sad/dejected, with a speech bubble above.
Voice (the man): "Do you feel you deserve good self esteem?"

comics.comicText:
Title banner: FIRST DATE TIPS!

Subtitle: MAKE SURE TO PUT HER AT EASE

A man with reddish hair, walking arm-in-arm with a blonde woman along a wooded path, gestures reassuringly.

Man: "There. Now you don't have to wonder if I have a bonesaw."

The woman looks uneasy.
comics.voteyText:
A close-up profile of a person's face, mouth open.
Person: "Now you know this is what mace tastes like!"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Father (seen from behind, balding, gray hair): SON, WE JUST DON'T BELIEVE TWO MEN CAN REALLY LOVE EACH OTHER.

Caption (below panel):

Father: Well, technically only I believe that, but your mother can go f*** herself.
comics.voteyText:
Close-up of the father's face.
Father: I'm not anti-gay, I'm anti-love.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A red-haired man in a dark red shirt points accusingly toward a blonde figure seen from behind in the foreground.

Man: "DON'T STARE AT ME LIKE THAT! STOP IT! THIS WAS NEVER MORE THAN A PHYSICAL THING AND YOU KNEW THAT FROM THE START! STOP IT!"

Caption (below panel): Reluctantly, I deflated Cynthia.
comics.voteyText:
A close-up of the red-haired man's face, now looking unsettled/disturbed, with a speech bubble coming from off-panel (the blonde figure).
Off-panel speaker: "Did you just say 'Psh'?!"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A woman with dark hair: "Remember, above all, women like a man with confidence."

A man with red/orange hair (pointing): "Confidence. Gotcha."

Panel 2 (label: "LATER..."):

A woman with brown hair: "Guess my favorite color!"

The red-haired man: "Pink."

The woman: "No, it's-"

The man (interrupting): "I said PINK!"
comics.voteyText:
The red-haired man (pointing at the woman): "Her!"
A waiter holding a check: "And who will be paying this evening?"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1: A boy with reddish-orange hair sits at a desk in a classroom, taking a test. The test paper reads: "(1) How many valence electrons in a hydrogen atom?" His answer "Two." is crossed out and corrected in red to "one."

Panel 2: Caption at top: "LATER..." The boy walks alone through a desert landscape with palm trees, mountains, and a body of water.

Panel 3: The boy crouches in the desert and picks up a golden oil lamp from the sand.

Panel 4: A genie erupts from the lamp.

Genie: "YOU MAY HAVE ANYTHING YOU WISH!"

Panel 5: The boy responds.

Boy: "I WISH I'D GOT THAT QUESTION RIGHT."

A giant explosion fills the panel: "BOOM!"
comics.voteyText:
Caption at top: "HEAVEN..." A bearded man's face in profile speaks.
Man: "YOU KNOW WHAT? NEXT UNIVERSE, NO GENIES."

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A bleeding man (gray hair, blue shirt) to a man in a doctor's coat and green scrubs who is holding a head mirror and a reflex hammer:

Bleeding man: HELP! I'M DYING OF BLOOD LOSS!

Doctor: OH GOD! EVERY DAY IT'S THE SAME PROBLEM!

Below the panel, a handwritten death certificate reads:

CAUSE OF DEATH: Am not actually a doctor.
comics.voteyText:
A bald man holding a sheet of paper speaks to the man in the doctor's coat:
Bald man: YOU FILLED OUT THIS CERTIFICATE WRONG.

comics.comicText:
Two men sit across a table playing chess in a dim room. The orange-haired man on the left holds a pistol, firing it across the chessboard with muzzle-flash bursts. The man on the right (brown hair, glasses) sits opposite him.

Caption (narrator, the orange-haired man): "I could immediately sense he was intimidated by my variation of the Ponziani Opening."
comics.voteyText:
A close-up sketch of the brown-haired, glasses-wearing man's face, looking shocked/blank.
Speech bubble (the orange-haired shooter, off-panel): "Pawn moves to lung interior."

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Young man with orange flame-like hair: MA'AM, MAY I HELP YOU ACROSS THE STREET?

Panel 2:

Elderly woman: OH, THAT'D BE VERY NICE, YOUNG MAN.

Panel 3:

Young man (handing her a piece of paper): HERE YA GO!

Panel 4:

The young man holds up the paper, which is a hand-drawn map. The map reads: MAP. "You" with an arrow pointing to "other side."
comics.voteyText:
Close-up of the young man's face, looking flatly at the viewer.
Young man: FIFTY BUCKS.
(The corner of the map he is holding is visible at the bottom, labeled MAP.)

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

A woman with brown hair, wearing a headset, stands in a room with a crowd of people behind her. She gestures emphatically toward a red-haired man (Todd), who is seen from behind.

Woman: "THIS IS AN INTERVENTION, TODD! WE WANT YOU OFF HEROIN!"

Todd: "BUT HEROIN MAKES ME HAPPY!"

Woman: "WOW, REALLY? THAT SOUNDS AMAZING!"

Caption (below panel): "We now hold interventions every Friday and Saturday night."
comics.voteyText:
The headset-wearing woman, drawn in a simple black-and-white style, smiling.
Woman: "NEXT WEEK WE SHOULD INTERVENE AGAINST GETTING DRUNK, EATING PEYOTE, AND THEN WATCHING CARTOONS!"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1: A woman sits at a desk reading a paper. Woman: "According to this study, young children are less anxious in the presence of a clown."

Panel 2: A man rests his chin on his hand, thinking. Man: "That could help Billy's panic attacks. But we don't have a clown suit. Unless..."

Panel 3: Caption: "Later..." The man, dressed normally (no visible clown suit), stands with one finger raised, addressing a small red-haired child (Billy) in a dark bedroom. Man: "Billy! Somewhere in here... is a CLOWN!"

Panel 4: The man smiles and points as he leaves the room. Man: "Goodnight!"

Panel 5: An exterior nighttime shot of the house, dark, with lit windows. A shadowy hunched figure is visible at the lower right.
comics.voteyText: A black panel showing a creepy clown face emerging from the darkness, with triangular eyes and a wide grin. Text: "Hi, Billy."

comics.comicText:
Main comic:

Panel 1 (single panel): A bedraggled, middle-aged man with long graying hair and a shaggy beard sits slumped against the base of a tree in a dark forest. He wears a small hat, a sleeveless shirt reading "MAMA'S BOY," shorts, and sneakers. He looks worn-out and disheveled, as though he has been waiting a very long time.

Caption (below panel): "I'm seriously starting to wonder if anyone is still playing hide and seek."
comics.voteyText:
Close-up of the same aged, weary man's face.
Thought balloon (the man): "But I'm winning!"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (yellow caption box):

PARENTING QUIZ!

Your kid got into your hallucinogenic drugs! What is the proper response?

Panel 2:

A man with flame-like orange hair in a purple shirt sits looking puzzled.

Man: I have a kid?
comics.voteyText:
A disheveled adult figure points off-panel. A small child holds a small bag/container.
Adult: Ooh, hey. You sharin'?

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A father stands holding a tray of knives, speaking to his children who are gathered in front of him.

Father: KIDS, WE CAN'T AFFORD TO PUT ALL OF YOU THROUGH COLLEGE, SO... WELL... REMEMBER HOW YOU USED TO PLAY TAG WITHOUT KNIVES?

A child (seen from behind): UH... Y-YEAH?

Caption (below panel): Dad then shot two of us.
comics.voteyText:
A man's face in close-up, looking pleased/sly.
Man: The ol' switcharoo!

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (a handwritten letter):

DEAR GOVERNMENT,

I AM A VICTIM OF SEXISM! I INTERVIEWED FOR A JOB TRADITIONALLY HELD BY WOMEN, AND WAS CLEARLY NEVER IN THE RUNNING DESPITE MY POSITIVE, CAN-DO ATTITUDE [text cut off at panel edge]

Panel 2 (labeled "EARLIER..." — a flashback of the job interview):

Interviewer (a woman with blonde hair, partly off-panel): WE JUST DON'T FEEL—

Applicant (a man with red/flame-like hair, pointing at a small child seated between them): I COULD NANNY THE S**T OUT OF THIS F***ER!
comics.voteyText: The red-haired man, gesturing toward a coffin/casket with a mourner standing nearby, says: THIS S**T WOULD BE F**KING AWESOME FOR YOUR DEPARTED F**KING LOVED ONES

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Father (a man with glasses and a beard): SON, YOU COULD BE ANYTHING WHEN YOU GROW UP. LIKE AN INSURANCE SALESMAN OR AN INSURANCE LAWYER OR EVEN AN INSURANCE CONTRACT PROOFREADER.

Panel 2:

Son (a boy in a red cap): OR AN ASTRONAUT!

Father: YOU?! BAHAHAHAHA!

Panel 3:

(Caption banner): 20 YEARS LATER

The son, now grown, in a spacesuit and helmet, floating in space: TAKE THAT, DAD!

Panel 4:

The grown son and another astronaut (the father, also in a helmet) sit side by side in a spacecraft cockpit.

Father: COULD YOU COME DOWN ON THE PREMIUM?
comics.voteyText:
A large smiling face (the son) takes up most of the panel, with a small speech bubble pointing off to the side.
Speech bubble: Not for you!

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A blonde woman in a green top stands in a doorway, alarmed, looking at a red-haired woman who is holding a knife over a man slumped at a desk.

Blonde woman: OH MY GOD, MINNIE! YOU KILLED HIM!

Red-haired woman (Minnie): NOT TO WORRY! I HAVE THE PERFECT ALIBI!

Panel 2:

A courtroom. Minnie (red hair) is in the witness box / dock with a lawyer; a judge sits in the background.

Lawyer: WHERE WERE YOU ON THE NIGHT OF THE 27th?!

Panel 3:

Minnie, smiling and gesturing, replies.

Minnie: SOMEWHERE ELSE!
comics.voteyText:
A man stands behind a red-haired woman (Minnie), pointing accusingly at her; she winces.
Man: WAS NOT!
Minnie: CRAP!

comics.comicText:
Title banner (top of panel): BAN THE F-WORD! (ARGUING WOULD BE MUCH FUNNIER)

Panel: A man with light hair sits at a small dining table, head lowered, eyes shut, a sweat-bead on his face, looking miserable. A blonde woman in a pink shirt stands behind/beside the table, hands raised in agitation, shouting at him.

Woman: "YOU'RE CANOODLING HER! YOU'RE CANOODLING YOUR SECRETARY, AREN'T YOU?! YOU MOTHER CANOODLER!"

Caption beneath the panel (the man's reply): "Would you canoodlin' shut up, you canoodlin' bitch!"
comics.voteyText: A loose, sketchy close-up of the same man's downcast, weary face. Hand-lettered text above him reads: "Canoodle my life"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

A blond man in a blue polo shirt stands gesturing toward another man (seen from behind, with brown hair, in a purple shirt).

Blond man: I BELIEVE THE EARTH WAS CREATED WHEN TWO ANGRY TURTLES DID BATTLE WITH SPACE-GOD.

Brown-haired man: THAT'S STUPID.

Blond man: IT'S MY RELIGION. AND I RESPECT IT.
comics.voteyText:
A hand-drawn sketch of the brown-haired man's face seen from the front, looking thoughtful/impressed.
Thought text above his head: It's so profound

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A bald, mustached teacher stands at the front of a classroom, leaning forward angrily and holding up a worksheet marked with a big red "F". Two young students (a blond child and a child with dark hair) are seen from behind, facing him.

Teacher: YOU ALL FAIL! DID IT EVER OCCUR TO YOU THAT THERE MIGHT BE MORE TO LIFE THAN BUNNIES AND DUCKIES?!

A mob of angry people storms forward against a backdrop of a city on fire. A blonde woman shouts in the foreground, a Black man in a green tank top holds up a phone or device, and a bald man wields a long pole or spear. Flames rise over burning buildings behind them.

Caption (below panel): The vegetarians had had enough.
comics.voteyText:
A close-up of an angry, snarling face shouting, with a speech bubble overhead.
Shouting face: Die vegans, die!

comics.comicText:
Main comic (single panel):

Three shirtless men wearing red boxing gloves stand close together against a yellow background. A man with red/orange hair (left) and a lighter-haired man (right) flank a third man in the center who is hunched over, being pressed between them.

Man with red hair: "WAIT - WHAT IF WE PUNCH IT AGAIN?"

Lighter-haired man (right): "YEAH."

Center man (hunched over): "OOH..."

Caption below the panel: "Ultimately, we failed to make the soufflé rise."
comics.voteyText:
(Single panel, black-and-white sketch style.) A bald man holds up a wrench and looks back over his shoulder toward a second man standing behind him.
Bald man: "DOES MY TRANSMISSION WORK YET?"
Second man: "ALMOST."

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A blond man in a suit and a balding gray-haired man in a tuxedo present a small medal to a smiling bald man wearing glasses and a blue sweater, who holds it up to admire it.

Presenter (blond man): FOR YOUR WORK ON THE ANATOMICAL BASIS OF TRUE LOVE, WE AWARD YOU THIS NOBEL PRIZE.

Recipient (bald man with glasses): YOU HAVE NO IDEA HOW MUCH THIS MEANS TO ME PERSONALLY.

Caption below panel: Man, that Nobel scored me a lot of threesomes.
comics.voteyText:
The bald man with curly hair (the Nobel recipient) leans in toward a smiling woman.
Man: WHOOPS! DROPPED MY NOBEL. COULD YOU BEND OVER AND PICK IT UP?

comics.comicText:
Title (above the graph): INSERT THIS GRAPH INTO ANY REPORT ON ANY TOPIC

The panel shows a bar graph.

Y-axis label: bars in this bar graph (numbered 5, 10, 15)

X-axis label: cm of x-axis (numbered 5, 10, 15)

The bars form a self-referential staircase: the height of each bar equals its own position number in the graph, so the bars rise in a straight diagonal line from 1 up to 16. Bars alternate between red and tan coloring.
comics.voteyText:
A hand-drawn pie chart. About one quarter of the circle (the upper-right wedge) is filled with diagonal stripes (hatching).
Caption to the right (with a small striped-box legend marker): [striped box] indicates portion of pie chart with stripes.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A muscular superhero in a blue suit with a red cape and a large "S" emblem on his chest stands at a podium, giving a speech.

Superhero: "Oh, and also, I hear Clark Kent is an amazing lover. Daily Planet. Clark Kent. Check it out."

Caption (below panel): Superman's speeches all end the same way.
comics.voteyText:
A roughly drawn figure stands at a podium, pointing, with an angry expression.
Figure: "Bruce Wayne - totally gay"

comics.comicText:
Title banner: WHO SAYS SCIENCE ISN'T ROMANTIC?

Man: Darling, I will never stop loving you.

Woman: But how can you be sure?!

Man: Tumor of the caudate nucleus.
comics.voteyText: A passerby (off to the side): Why is he talking to that pole?

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

Setting: outdoors at night by a river/stream, pine trees and a full moon in the background. A bearded man (seen from behind/side) speaks to a red-haired woman in a pink-and-purple dress who holds a red rose.

Man: You, m'lady are alike that spring rose.

Woman: How so?

Man: Unf**kable. (the middle of the word is obscured/censored)

Caption (below the comic): Shakespeare hates explaining his metaphors.
comics.voteyText:
A rough black-and-white sketch of the bearded man pointing, continuing his line.
Man: And a bitch.

comics.comicText:
Title banner: SMBC PRESENTS: THE DOWNSIDE TO CRAPPING YOUR PANTS (the word "DOWNSIDE" is underlined)

Panel 1:

A man with orange/red hair, eyes closed, standing with a glum, slumped posture against a dark blue background.

Man: THIS SUCKS!
comics.voteyText:
Close-up of an older, balding man's smiling face, looking down with amusement and a tear in his eye from laughing.
Older man: Comedy gold!

comics.comicText:
Title caption (top banner): CONVERSATION STRATEGY: DODGE QUESTIONS BY RESPONDING WITH UNRELATED TRUISMS

Man: You threw my cat out the window!

Man: Why the hell would you do that?!

Woman: To-may-to to-mah-to.
comics.voteyText:
Woman: Po-tay-to po-tah-
Man: My cat is dead!

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A masked man strikes a dramatic, swashbuckling pose. He wears a wide-brimmed hat, a cape, a domino mask and mustache, a red sash, and a light-blue shirt emblazoned with a large female/Venus symbol on the chest. Lightning bolts flank him.

Masked man: THEY CALL ME... FALLOPIO.

A woman with brown hair is seen from behind, watching him.

Caption (below panel): This is why I prefer female gynecologists.
comics.voteyText:
A man (Steve) holds out a form toward another man wearing the same wide-brimmed hat as the masked figure.
Steve: HEY STEVE COULD YOU FILL OUT THIS-
Hatted man (interrupting): IT'S FALLOPIO! FALLOPIO!

comics.comicText:
This comic has no written dialogue or captions in the main six panels; the story is told visually.

Panel 1: A young man with brown hair in a green shirt sits alone at a small table with a drink, looking lonely and downcast. Behind him, silhouetted figures dance at a party.

Panel 2: An exterior night scene. Tall blue buildings under a dark sky with a crescent moon. The same small figure walks alone down an empty street.

Panel 3: The man lies on a bed in a dim room, resting his face in his hands, daydreaming. A thought bubble above him contains a large red heart.

Panel 4: Close on the man, now smiling broadly with hands raised, a speech/thought bubble with a red heart and an exclamation mark beside him. A large yellow shape (a person) looms in the foreground.

Panel 5: A red-haired woman in a pink shirt smiles nervously, raising one hand in greeting/protest. The man's brown hair and raised hand are visible at the left edge as he approaches her.

Panel 6: Back at the party in a purple room. The man in the green shirt is now out on the floor among the dancing silhouetted figures, the woman beside him, with his drink left abandoned on the table in the foreground.
comics.voteyText: A woman with curly hair leans in, shouting in a large speech bubble, "EVERY DAMN TIME!" A smaller speech bubble replies, "SORRY..."

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Two bespectacled people who look nearly identical (same glasses, same hairstyle, both in green shirts) embrace and kiss passionately. One wraps an arm around the other and a hand cradles the back of their head. Beside them stands a tall cylindrical device with an antenna sparking at the top, labeled: "TIME MACHINE". Both characters wear matching wristwatches with "SMBC" on the face.

(No dialogue.)
comics.voteyText: A rough sketch of the same scene: the two near-identical people lean together, and a third grinning person leans in from the right, watching them with delight.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (main comic):

A man and woman sit close together at a table on what appears to be a date. The woman, leaning in with a hand raised, suddenly shouts.

Woman: "VULVA!"

Caption (below panel):

"I like to make sure my dates are comfortable with female sexuality."
comics.voteyText:
The same man, now alone and sketched in a rough black-and-white style, shouts.
Man: "PAYING THE CHECK!"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Alien (floating egg-shaped creature with a single eye, on rocket jets): WE ARE AN ALIEN RACE FROM THE DISTANT FUTURE. HAVING DISCOVERED ALL INFORMATION AVAILABLE IN THIS UNIVERSE, WE NOW SPEND OUR TIME ANSWERING HUMAN QUESTIONS AND MAKING CRUDE MASTURBATION JOKES.

Panel 2:

Man (in an orange polo shirt): YOU CAN ANSWER ANY QUESTIONS?! IS THERE SUCH THING AS A SOULMATE?

Panel 3:

Alien: YES.

Panel 4:

Man: DO I HAVE ONE?

Panel 5:

Alien: HER NAME IS LEFTY! BAM!
comics.voteyText: Alien (smaller, simpler version of the egg creature): SERIOUSLY THOUGH, NO, THERE'S NO ONE FOR YOU

comics.comicText:
Title banner (with chess knight icons on either side): CHESS STRATEGY

WIN THE PSYCHOLOGICAL BATTLE BY ATTEMPTING IMPOSSIBLE MOVES

Two men sit across a chessboard from each other. The man on the left (blond hair, brown jacket) leans in, confident.

Left man: QUEEN TO C-12 NOW, YAHTZEE MY BATTLESHIP!

Right man (gray hair, blue jacket, looking distressed): NO!

Left man: BINGO!
comics.voteyText:
A man on the left smiles and reaches out toward another man on the right.
Left man (speech bubble): FREE SLAP!

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Two boxers, each in boxing gloves and shorts, are pressed face-to-face in the center of a ring as two large doors slide open from the left and right (each door marked with a yellow arrow pointing inward toward the fighters). They glare at each other.

Left boxer: "YOU'RE GONNA SMOOSH FIRST!"

Right boxer: "NO, YOU'RE GONNA SMOOSH FIRST."

Caption (below panel): The people of the future don't have time for the old-fashioned kind of boxing.
comics.voteyText:
A close-up profile of a man speaking thoughtfully.
Man: "Smooshbox is, of course, the purest of sports."

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A woman (her arm and leg visible) pins a man with orange hair to the ground, pressing the sole of her boot against his face. His tongue is sticking out against the boot.

Woman: LICK THE BOOT, SCUMBAG! LICK THE GODDAMN BOOT!

Caption (below the panel): Yeah, other than that one thing, the date went pretty well.
comics.voteyText:
The same man, now looking happy/sheepish, leans toward the woman, who is embracing him.
Man: I LOVE YOU, SHMOOPY SHMOO!

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A woman (a cosmetic-surgery receptionist or staffer) stands in a green-walled office, gesturing toward a balding man who has just entered.

Woman: "Wait, don't tell me, I'm good at this. You're here for a lipo. No? Nose job? Tummy tuck? Facelift? Probably a couple facelifts. No?"

Caption (below panel): Sometimes I forget we share a building with the depression clinic.
comics.voteyText:
A simple line drawing of the woman's face looking concerned/sheepish.
Woman: "But am I right?"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

A balding man with red hair and round glasses, wearing a purple shirt, sits speaking expressively to an interviewer (a person with reddish-blond hair, seen from behind, holding a pen and yellow notepad).

Balding man: "IN ALL MY YEARS IN FILM, I FIND THE THING THAT SCARES PEOPLE MOST... IS SILENCE."

Interviewer: "THAT'S VERY POETIC. DO YOU—"

Balding man (interrupting): "AND ZOMBIES!"

Caption below panel: "With, like, machine guns."
comics.voteyText:
A crudely drawn wide-eyed face with an open mouth and a speech bubble.
Face: "Also skulls"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A courtroom. A bearded judge in black robes sits at the bench with a gavel. Beside him, a blonde woman in a pink shirt gestures emphatically as she speaks.

Blonde woman: "THAT IS NOT ATTEMPTED MURDER! I JUST THOUGHT HE'D LIKE TO KNOW WHAT A SYRINGE FULL OF WINDEX FEELS LIKE."

Caption (below panel): Ultimately, I was compelled to apologize to the foreman.
comics.voteyText:
A crudely-drawn figure hunches over, holding a knife, with a strained expression.
Figure: "SORRY!"

comics.comicText:
Title caption: DEBATE STRATEGY: SURPRISE YOUR OPPONENTS WITH AN UNEXPECTED STANCE

A blonde woman with glasses and a red collared shirt sits at a debate table, gesturing. Across from her sits a dark-haired man in a yellow shirt with his hand thoughtfully at his chin. In the foreground, seen from behind, is a third person with brown hair in a blue shirt.

Blonde woman: ABORTION.

Man in yellow shirt: INEFFICIENT?
comics.voteyText:
A simply-drawn face with a flat, unamused expression speaks.
Speaker: Racism.
Speaker: Hard to spell?

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A man with short hair sits on an orange couch, hunched forward, chewing or biting at his hand/fingers in a tense, gnawing posture. A blonde woman sits across from him in the foreground, watching. Framed pictures hang on the wall behind him.

Man: "Don't think of me as a hero."
comics.voteyText:
Close-up on the same man's face, looking grim and resolute with furrowed brows.
Man: "Just a man with a mission."

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Voice from inside a mausoleum/crypt labeled "WAKEFIELD": HEY! HELP! I'M NOT DEAD!

A young man in a suit standing outside, walking away: UH HUH. NICE TRY, DAD.

Caption (below panel): If we didn't care during the funeral, why would we care now?
comics.voteyText:
Close-up of the same young man's face, looking unbothered.
Voice (from off-panel, presumably the father): Be a team player, Dad!

comics.comicText:
Title banner: DATING TIPS

YOUR HOPES AND DREAMS ARE ONLY ENDEARING IF THEY'RE NICE

Panel 1:

A man with red hair (leaning forward, hands raised earnestly), speaking to a woman with brown hair seen from behind across a table: "JUST ONCE, I'D LIKE TO SEE A PLANE CRASH."
comics.voteyText: Inside an airplane cabin, a passenger in a window seat looks out cheerfully and shouts: "WOOHOO!" Outside the window the sun shines over the sea, while a dark plume of smoke/flames rises ominously beside the plane, implying it is going down.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A police officer with red hair, dark sunglasses, and a badge holds a notepad while speaking to a man with brown hair (seen from behind). Behind them is a crime scene with yellow police tape, a parked car, suburban houses, and a figure walking in the background.

Officer: I've got good news and bad news - the bad news is that I have a cruel sense of irony. The good news is that your family were all kidnapped and tortured to death.
comics.voteyText:
A close-up of the smiling officer (sunglasses, badge on collar) leaning in.
Officer: Also, I shot your cat.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Woman (blonde, ponytail): GET OUT!

Man (with ponytail, blue jacket): ARE YOU CRAZY!? FIVE MINUTES AGO, YOU AGREED TO MARRY ME!

Woman: AND NOW I'M SAYING GET OUT!

Man: WHATEVER!

Caption (below panel): Hurt and confused, Todd exited the ladies room.
comics.voteyText:
Two women sit together in a restroom; one shouts toward the doorway where a man's face peers in.
Woman: YOU'RE ALL PHONIES!

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A woman with brown hair and a green shirt stands behind a counter or bar, frantically aiming two pistols, one in each hand, at two identical-looking blond men seen from behind in the foreground.

Woman: OH GOD! YOU LOOK EXACTLY ALIKE! I DON'T KNOW WHO TO SHOOT!

Caption (below panel): Silently, we both wondered who the hell she was.
comics.voteyText: A crude sketch shows two small robot-like figures standing on opposite peaks of a hill or cliff, facing each other. The left robot emits the sound "FIZZLE" with squiggly lines above it. The right robot emits the sound "CRACK" with jagged lines, appearing damaged or breaking apart.

comics.comicText:
Title banner (decorative header): SECRETARY TIPS

BOSS ANNOYING YOU? FIGHT BACK BY TAKING LOW QUALITY PHONE MESSAGES

Panel (single): A secretary (a woman with long hair pulled back, in a green top) sits holding a notepad and pen. An older balding man (the boss) sits across from her, his back partly to the viewer.

Secretary: "Oh, and the morgue called. Something about \"blazing inferno\" and \"all your loved ones.\""
comics.voteyText:
A close-up of the secretary's notepad, showing the sloppy, fragmentary message she actually wrote down.
Note text: TERMINAL SOMETHING SOMETHING PANCREAS
\"HORRIBLE DEATH\" -> \"ANY MOMENT NOW\"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Man with orange/red hair (holding a deck of cards): So here's the idea- instead of just "cards," we have "f**kin'" cards.

Man with brown hair: What's the difference?

Man with orange/red hair: Well, you know how decks of "cards" have a three of clubs?

Below the panel, a single playing card is shown with handwritten text and club symbols in the corners:

The card reads: "F**kin' THREE OF CLUBS!"
comics.voteyText:
A playing card covered in handwritten text and little hearts:
"It's a goddamn six of fuckin' hearts, you shithead"

comics.comicText:
Title banner: LIFE STRATEGY

PRESERVE YOUR SELF IMAGE WITH CIRCULAR LOGIC

Panel 1:

An older balding man in a suit, with one hand on his chest, speaks to a younger man seen from behind: "She's very mature for an 18-year-old. She must be to date someone my age."
comics.voteyText: The same balding man grins and holds up a large swirled lollipop, saying: "WHO LIKES CANDY?!"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A man with flame-like red hair holds a phone to his ear, looking distressed.

Man (on phone): I WANT TEN BILLION DOLLARS BY TOMORROW NIGHT, OR YOU MAY NEVER SEE YOUR SON AGAIN!

Man (replying, smaller speech bubble): ...MY SON IS RIGHT HERE...

Man (on phone): I SAID "MAY!"
comics.voteyText: A hand-drawn check. Written on it: "Ten billion dollars". Below that: "This check MAY be void". A signature is scrawled in the corner.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A flamboyant carnival barker / ringmaster figure in a red top hat and red coat, holding a cane, gestures toward a door with a stained-glass window. Behind the window an old person's face peers out. He is leading a small crowd of onlookers.

Ringmaster: "AND THROUGH *THIS* DOOR... GERIATRA! 1,000 YEARS OLD IF SHE'S A DAY!"

Caption (below panel): "The nursing home managed to turn a profit this year."
comics.voteyText:
A crude hand-drawn carnival/sideshow banner with a zig-zag border showing a wide-mouthed screaming face.
Banner text: "THE STATUE MAN DOESN'T MOVE! DOESN'T BREATHE!"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Man (with red-brown hair, green shirt): CAN I JOIN YOUR CLUB?

Blonde woman (in purple shirt, standing with others by a sign reading "WOMEN FOR PEACE"): WELL, I MEAN... IT'S WOMEN FOR PEACE, SO... NO.

Panel 2:

Man (frowning, hand on chin in thought): I SEE...

Panel 3:

Caption box: SOON...

[The man, arms raised in triumph, drives a green military tank that plows into the blonde woman and the other "Women for Peace" members.]
comics.voteyText: Man (standing beside the tank): TRADE YOU THIS TANK IF I CAN JOIN

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A man with brown hair (speaking to a blonde woman): Your hair looks lovely today.

Blonde woman: Really? Thanks!

Man: Also, I'm not cheating on you!

Panel 2:

Caption box: THE DAY PRIOR...

An older man wearing sunglasses and an orange shirt (to the younger brown-haired man): Son, if you can get a woman to fall for one lie, she'll definitely fall for two.
comics.voteyText:
A man: I'm thirsty.
Another voice: Okay...
The man: You find me attractive!

comics.comicText:
Two women face each other, competing in a one-upmanship argument about their children's precocious accomplishments. Their speech bubbles stack downward.

Woman on the left (brown hair, green top): "My Bobby knew Spanish by age three."

Woman on the right (blonde hair, pink top): "My Susie knew Mandarin by age two."

Woman on the left: "My Bobby knew calculus by age two."

Woman on the right (gesturing): "My Susie knew quantum physics by [text cut off, reads] physics by..."

Caption below the panel: "The argument went on so long, we both forgot that children need feeding every three days or so."

Second caption line: "In point of fact, my bobby survived WAY longer."
comics.voteyText:
A black-and-white sketch of two people, one of whom (left) speaks.
Speaker (left): "Yes, but whose dead kid was DEADEST."

comics.comicText:
Main comic (single panel):

A man with orange hair faces a blonde woman across a green-walled room.

Man: IN ABOUT 30 SECONDS, I'M GOING TO TELL YOU YOUR MOTHER DIED. BUT DON'T WORRY, I'VE BANAL PLEASANTRIES TO EASE YOU INTO THE MOMENT.

Man: NICE WEATHER WE'RE HAVING TODAY.

Woman: WAIT, MY MOTHER-

Woman: SERIOUSLY THOUGH, MY-

Man (insistently): NICE WEATHER WE'RE HAVING TODAY.
comics.voteyText:
A man in a shirt and tie speaks to someone off-panel.
Man: YOU LOOK NICE TONIGHT.
Other person (off-panel): OKAY, BUT-
Man (loudly): NEW SHAMPOO?!

comics.comicText:
A single split panel. On the left (red background), a man with curly brown hair holds a phone to his ear and a slice of pizza in his other hand.

Caller: I'm having a sandwich right now.

Caller: HA! It's actually PIZZA, sucker!

On the right (blue background), a man with brown hair holds a pink phone, looking unimpressed.

Recipient: Uh... okay.

A yellow lightning-bolt burst between them reads: CLICK

Caption below the panel:

Think this is a lousy prank call?

You won't after the 48th time.
comics.voteyText:
A rough black-and-white panel. The curly-haired man is again on the phone on the left; the other man on the right.
Caller: Is your refrigerator running?
Recipient: Y-yes?
Caller: That'll keep your food cold!
A burst between them reads: CLICK!

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

(No dialogue. A man with brown hair and a woman with red hair stand in a graveyard, looking at the headstones. One gravestone shows a photo-etched portrait of a face and reads "1932-2007".)

Panel 2:

Woman: Ugh. Those graves with photo-etchings always use really old photos. When I go, I want my grave to show how I looked at the time I died.

Man: Yeah... Hey, are those cows stampeding?

(The two are now shown sitting inside a yellow car.)

Panel 3:

(No dialogue. The red-haired woman stands looking at two gravestones. The nearer small one reads "1932-2007" with a face portrait. The larger gravestone reads "1972-2007" and depicts an etched portrait of a screaming face being trampled/crushed.)
comics.voteyText:
(Close-up of the gravestone's etched portrait: a screaming, distorted face.)
Face on gravestone: CRAP!

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Woman (brown hair, pink shirt): I AM NOT ALLOWING OUR SON TO BE EXPOSED TO CARTOON VIOLENCE!

Man (blond hair, green shirt): OH YEAH?!

(A young boy stands in the background near a computer monitor.)

Panel 2:

The woman and man are now fighting violently. The woman punches the man in the face; her fist connects and a cartoonish red splatter/burst flies out from the side of his head. The boy still stands in the background by the computer monitor, watching.
comics.voteyText: A red cartoon explosion/star-burst with the word "BOOM!" written across it in yellow.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A teacher (referred to in the caption as Mr. Silber) stands at the front of a classroom, smiling, holding a pointer aimed at a chalkboard. On the board is a drawing of a skull with headphones, labeled "HEAT", with arrows pointing to a list:

HEAT → Hydrogen

→ Oxygen

→ Nitrogen

On the desk in front of the board sits a small pile of dark material with a burning candle/flame stuck in it. Two students (visible from behind) watch in the foreground.

Caption (below panel): I don't think Mr. Silber understood the point of Take Your Pet to School Day.
comics.voteyText:
Close-up of the teacher's face — balding, glasses, with an irritated/intense expression.
Teacher: "Life" is just uppity chemistry.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (header banner, red): CONCERN

Panel 1: An older man at a podium points a pointer at a presentation board.

Board text: VIDEO GAMES: VIOLENCE (arrow down) NO CONSEQUENCE

Panel 2 (header banner, green): RESPONSE

Panel 2: A man behind a podium gestures with his open hand toward a board.

Board text: VIDEO GAMES: VIOLENCE (arrow down) LIKE, 50 POINTS!
comics.voteyText:
A wild-eyed man holds up a knife/dagger triumphantly.
Man: SEE?!

comics.comicText:
Title banner: PARENTING TIP: CHILDREN ARE STUPID!

Parent (silhouetted figure, sitting at the bedside): Sweetie, the craziest thing happened! Your dachshund metamorphosed into this beagle!

Child (in bed): W-when?

Parent: Right after I ran over a... pile of ketchup... and bones... and dachshund fur.
comics.voteyText: Parent (silhouette): And your old dog's dog collar.

comics.comicText:
Main comic (single panel):

A bright yellow sun with radiating triangle rays hangs in a purple sky over a green hill. The silhouettes of four people stand on the hill, looking up. A large speech bubble comes from the direction of the sun.

Voice (from the sun): "Okay so here's the rules- if you confess right before you die, you get to go to Heaven. But, if you don't make it to confession before then, you go to Hell!"

Caption below the panel: God also enjoys Freeze Tag and Hopscotch.
comics.voteyText:
A loose, sketchy black-and-white drawing of a figure with flame-like hair against a background of flames, partly framing the earlier sun.
Caption: "YOU'RE IT"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

Bald father: SON, ARE YOU ON DRUGS?

Son (a boy with brown hair): N-NO, DADDY.

Bald father: BECAUSE I WOULD *REALLY* LIKE TO CONFISCATE THEM TONIGHT. EVEN JUST SOME WEED.
comics.voteyText: Bald father (rummaging through a drawer): I DON'T SUPPOSE YOU HAVE ANY HOOKERS IN HERE...

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Title banner: COMEDY SECRETS! OBSERVATIONAL HUMOR ONLY WORKS IF PEOPLE CAN RELATE

A smiling man with orange/red hair wearing a green polo shirt gestures with open hands as he speaks.

Man: "Don't you hate it when you're chewing on a sleeping child's face and you get a hair in your teeth?"
comics.voteyText:
A close-up of the same grinning man's face.
Man: "And you're just trying to enjoy your weekend!"

comics.comicText:
Caption (yellow banner at top): MARKETING SECRETS! GET PRODUCTS TO YOUR FUTURE AUDIENCE EARLY

Panel 1: A building with a sign reading "ORPHANAGE" sits in a grassy field under a blue sky. From inside or near the building, a voice calls out in a speech bubble: "WHO WANTS XANAX?!"
comics.voteyText: A man (shown in profile, head and shoulders) stands in front of a store shelf. On the shelf is a box labeled "ZOLOFT." He says: "AHH, THAT TAKES ME BACK."

comics.comicText:
Main comic (single panel):

A blonde woman with green clothing stands at a window, looking into a room beyond. Inside the room there is a desk with a hand-lettered sign propped on it reading: "NO GIRLS ALLOWED". Behind the desk, a small red-haired figure (a man) peeks up over the edge, hiding.

Caption (below the comic): My obstetrician isn't taking divorce very well.
comics.voteyText:
Woman: I'M ENTERING LABOR!!
Man (the obstetrician): DID YOU READ THE SIGN?!

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

A blond man in sunglasses and a dark suit stands at left, hand to his chin, considering. At right is a large glass tank. Inside the tank is a shark and a man in a tuxedo standing next to it.

Man in the tank: I dunno... it smells pretty bad, so, you know, that's unpleasant.

Blond man (left): Hmm...

Caption (below panel): Note for next shark tank: Use more water.
comics.voteyText:
A close-up of the blond man's face in profile, looking down with a slightly pained, disgusted expression.
Text (to the left): Eww! Slimy!

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A man with brown hair in a green shirt kneels, holding an open red ring box in one hand. With his other hand he is putting a handgun into his mouth. Across from him kneels a blonde woman in a blue outfit.

Woman (speech bubble): OKAY! OKAY! I'LL MARRY YOU!

Caption beneath the panel: "Just stop eating my guns."
comics.voteyText:
A close-up line drawing of the man's face with the handgun barrel in his mouth, looking pleased.
Man (speech bubble): They're so good!

comics.comicText:
Panel 1: A man with light hair drives a purple car, grinning, with a woman in the passenger seat looking unhappy.

Man: "WOOH! SMASHED ANOTHER SKUNK!"
