Panel 2 (caption: "5 minutes ago"): The same two seen through the windshield. The woman speaks to the man, who looks dejected.

Woman: "I THINK WE SHOULD SEE OTHER PEOPLE."

Panel 3 (caption: "10 minutes ago"): The two stand outside the car. The man speaks to the woman.

Man: "I NEED TO TALK TO YOU ABOUT SOMETHING. WOULD YOU MIND DRIVING MY CAR?"
comics.voteyText:
A sketchy close-up of a man's grumpy/angry face.
Text: "Sorry, can't hear you over the smell."

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A bald professor in a blue jacket stands at a wooden lectern, pointing with a pointer at a projection screen. On the screen is a yellow slide titled "CAT" with a crude doodle of a cat made of dashes. Labels point to it: "outside part" (pointing to the outer dashed outline) and "inside part" (pointing to the interior). A row of students is seen from behind in the foreground.

Caption (below the panel): Whenever a student asks something stupid, Professor Oppenheimer shows the cat slide.
comics.voteyText: A simply-drawn face looks blankly forward. A speech bubble above reads: "Your question is isomorphic with drooling."

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A blond man in an orange sweater stands in a living room, gesturing toward a woman with brown hair who is seen from behind. A small side table with a vase of flowers stands between them.

Man: "Come on! I'd be great with the kids! Look, your husband is dead, okay? So- oh... woops... god, I'm sorry."

Caption (below panel): "Ted had just realized he was standing on my daughter."
comics.voteyText:
A close-up of a man's grinning face.
Man: "Guess we started on the wrong foot!"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A man stands near a window at night, holding a gun, looking out at another man walking past on the street below.

Man with gun: "MAN, I'D REALLY LIKE TO SHOOT A GUY... HEY, THERE'S A GUY RIGHT NOW!"

Caption below panel: "I believe I was a victim of circumstance, your honor."
comics.voteyText:
Close-up of the man's face looking pleading/distressed.
Man: "It's called entrapment!"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Police officer (with mustache, standing): You're suspending me?! Talk about a double-standard!

Caption (below panel): Apparently I'm not allowed to sleep with the chief's wife.
comics.voteyText: The mustached officer (close-up of his face): Would it change your mind to know that she called me "chief"?

comics.comicText:
Panel 1: A bald man in a light blue hospital gown stands with arms spread in a cloudy, heavenly setting, facing a robed, gray-haired and bearded figure (God) seated at a podium.

Figure at podium: WELCOME TO HEAVEN. WOULD YOU LIKE TO SPEND ETERNITY WITH THE WOMAN YOU MARRIED OR YOUR TRUE SOULMATE?

Man: WHAT?! HOW CAN YOU MAKE ME CHOOSE ONE OR THE OTHER?

Caption (below panel): My whole life I had assumed there were threesomes in Heaven.
comics.voteyText:
A sketchy line-drawn close-up of the man's worried face.
Man: Is this Hell?

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A judge (an older woman in black robes, gray hair pulled back, wearing glasses) sits at the bench addressing a nervous-looking young man in a blue suit and bow tie, presumably a lawyer.

Judge: "We're concerned that the phrase 'conclusive DNA evidence' might bias the jury. We would prefer the prosecution say 'mayyyyyyyyybe,' followed by a meaningful wink."

Caption (below panel): "Also, instead of 'stabbing,' we would prefer 'knife donation.'"
comics.voteyText:
A hand-drawn man with a worried expression speaks.
Man: "I'm worried my client's obvious guilt may bias the jury."

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A man with red/orange hair in a red sweater sits across from another person (seen from behind, with green-ish hair and a green sweater) who is holding out a yellow piece of paper or card toward him.

Red-haired man: "WOAH, WOAH, WOAH! I DIDN'T GET MY MASSIVE TRUST FUND BY GIVING AWAY MONEY TO LOWLIFES!"

Caption (below panel): Technically, this was true.
comics.voteyText:
A simple line drawing of a person's head looking downward.
Speech bubble: "Would you like some financial advice?"

comics.comicText:
Two people sit at a dim table; one is a man in a sweater, the other is a figure shown only as a black silhouette in the foreground.

Man: Oh, you're a paranoid schizophrenic? That's fascinating.

Silhouetted figure: Yes. I protect my brain by wearing the skulls of people who are servants of Melkar, the Hivemaster.

Man: What a coincidence! I'M a servant of Melkar, the Hivemaster!

Caption (below panel): "Anyway, officer, that's how I remember the date."
comics.voteyText:
Handwritten heading: Reading this 8 years later
A roughly drawn person resting their head, looking unimpressed.
Person: Huh?

comics.comicText:
Main comic (single panel):

A woman with long red hair, wearing a yellow top, sits at a table across from a man wearing glasses and a green shirt (seen from behind). She has slammed a jar full of cat heads onto the table and is gesturing aggressively at the man.

Woman: "YEAH!! JAR OF CAT HEADS! FIRST DATE! WHAT ARE YOU GONNA DO ABOUT IT?!"

Caption below panel: "I try to find creative ways to compensate for my shyness."
comics.voteyText:
The man (now facing forward, drawn in a loose sketch style) and the woman continue the conversation.
Man: "WHERE'D YOU GET THAT, ANYWAY?"
Woman: "A REALLY WEIRD GARAGE SALE"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A blond man in a brown suit, holding a brown briefcase, sits across from a brown-haired woman in a blue top. They appear to be on a bus or train. The man gestures persuasively toward the woman.

Man: WE CAN CONSOLIDATE ALL THREE OF YOUR KIDS INTO A SINGLE, MORE MANAGEABLE UBER-CHILD!

Caption (below panel): The duct tape man was really reaching for that sale.
comics.voteyText:
Three children stand bound together with bands of duct tape wrapped around their bodies, forming one merged "uber-child." A large dark silhouette of a person looms at the left.
Silhouetted figure: YOU GET ONLY ONE DESSERT.

comics.comicText:
Main comic:

A disheveled, bearded man in a hat and green coat stands with his arms spread wide, head tilted back, yelling:

Man: BLEE, BLOO, BLAGH! I'M MAGELLAN! BLAGH! YAHAHAHAHAHA!

A woman in a yellow shirt stands to his left, looking unimpressed and weary. A small blonde child in a pink shirt stands in front, looking up. They appear to be in a shop or store (there is a sign reading "HANDED... PLEASE" in the background).

Caption (bottom): I like to think of myself as something of a latter-day Magellan.
comics.voteyText:
A worker (with freckles) at a fast-food counter speaks to the bearded man, who is seen from behind.
Worker: WOULD YOU LIKE FRIES WITH
Man (interrupting): BLEE, BLOO, BLAGH! YES, PLEASE. BLAGH! YAHAHAHAHA!

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A man in a suit stands at a podium, holding a telephone receiver, presenting to an audience. Behind him is a whiteboard labeled "Fig 1.A" displaying the figure "$560,000,000".

Man: "That's my net worth, folks. But do I call that success in LIFE? Of course not! What does it mean to be truly successful? Just ask my wife and kids."

Panel 2:

Caption (yellow box): "That evening..."

That evening, the same man sits in an armchair at home. His wife stands with arms crossed, looking annoyed. Two children (a girl in pink and a boy in green) stand in front of an easel/presentation board that reads "$1,000,000,000" with a line graph. The boy holds a pointer at the board, apparently giving a presentation to his father, mirroring the father's earlier business pitch.
comics.voteyText:
A loose black-and-white sketch close-up of the boy at the presentation board, pointer in hand, tapping the chart ("TAP TAP TAP") which shows the figure "$1,000,...".
Boy: "I sure missed all of y--"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A therapy session. A balding man (the therapist, seen from behind holding a notepad) sits across a table from a couple: a man with orange/red hair in a green shirt (Steven), and a woman with brown hair in a pink shirt (Cynthia).

Therapist: For our first session, Cynthia, I'd like you to say something comforting to Steven.

Cynthia: Oh... okay, sure. Uh, hey, you know what I really love? Premature ejaculation.
comics.voteyText:
A close-up of the orange-haired man (Steven), smiling.
Steven: Oh wow, that's a relief.

comics.comicText:
Caption (yellow banner at top): DATING TIPS: TRY NOT TO MAKE YOUR INADEQUACIES TOO OVERT.

A man (with short brown hair, blue shirt) stands close to a woman (brown hair, pink tank top) under a green night sky dotted with stars. He gestures upward while she stands with her arms crossed, looking unimpressed.

Man: "AND THAT CONSTELLATION IS ALSO CALLED 'I'M SO LONELY. PLEASE LOVE ME.'"
comics.voteyText: A near-black panel with no text. Faint white dotted lines (like star outlines against a dark sky) form a sad, frowning face — two eyes, a nose, and a downturned mouth with a rounded chin below.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A man stands at a podium on a stage, gesturing with one hand, addressing an audience seated below him.

Speaker (man at podium): "I say do what you feel like! This isn't the time for tunnel vision! Figure out what you want right now and do it!"

Caption below the comic:

Note to self: In future, don't schedule graduation and AA speeches on same day.
comics.voteyText:
A person holds a cat in their arms.
Speaker: "This is my cat, 'Stay-for-coffee-or-I'll-kill-myself.'"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

A man with brown hair, seen from behind, confronts a man with orange/ginger hair wearing a blue polo shirt who is standing with his arms spread wide.

Man with brown hair: YOU SHOT MY DOG!

Man with orange hair (arms spread, defensive): YOU CAN'T PROVE THAT! IT'S ONLY A THEORY.

Caption (below panel): My revenge on the creationists may have gone too far.
comics.voteyText:
Close-up of the orange-haired man's face, now drawn in a rough sketch style, looking smug/angry with a furrowed brow.
Man with orange hair: It's ethical because I'm right!

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A woman with orange/red hair lunges desperately toward a table where a syringe rests on a magenta/purple surface. She is being physically restrained from behind by two people (a man in a green shirt and another person in a purple/lavender top) who hold her arms back.

Woman (reaching, frantic): "LET GO! I NEED IT! I CAN'T EVEN SEE ANYMORE!"

Caption (below panel): Man, insulin withdrawal is horrible!
comics.voteyText:
Close-up of the same red-haired woman, now wild-eyed and holding the syringe near her mouth/in her hand, facing a man seen from behind.
Man (from behind): "YOU DON'T HAVE DIABETES."
Woman (manic): "IT'S NOT ABOUT THAT!"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A man with red hair in a yellow shirt stands on the ground, glancing at his wristwatch. Above and behind him, a person with white/gray hair peers over the edge of a tall purple container or pedestal, from which a rainbow arcs across the sky.

Person in the purple container: "THE AFTERLIFE! OH, IT'S MORE BEAUTIFUL THAN I — OW! THAT'S SO WEIRD. I'VE STUBBED MY TOE EVERY 42 SECONDS SINCE I GOT HERE."

Caption (below panel): "It takes about six hours to realize that you're in Hell."
comics.voteyText:
A close-up of the same person (long hair, mouth open), now looking distressed.
Person: "OHHHH! I'M IN HELL!"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

An older man with gray hair and glasses, seen from behind, speaks to a young boy sitting at a desk with a computer in a dimly lit blue room.

Older man: "Son, you'll be a man soon, and it's time you learn to shave. But, since you don't yet have facial hair, I've come up with an alternative."

Below the panel, a handwritten blue note reads:

"Dear Lynette,

Hope your vacation with the new husband is going well. The kids seem to love his dog.

-Don"
comics.voteyText:
A bald, smiling man's face shown close up. A speech bubble reads:
"Sometimes I shave sexist epithets into my beard." ("my beard" is underlined.)

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Spiderman (in a heroic pose, shooting a web): "SURE, BUT CAN HE DO THIS?"

Sound effect: "THWAP!"

(A group of children watch, smiling.)

Caption below the comic: "Spiderman converted a lot of kids from Jesus."
comics.voteyText: A bearded man resembling Jesus holds up a fish: "DOUBLE YOUR FISH! EH? EH?"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

Caption banner at top: "YOU CAN ALWAYS TELL WHEN THE LIBRARY EMPLOYEES ARE UNHAPPY"

An orange arrow-shaped sign points down/left, reading: "OUR STAFF RECOMMENDS"

A small light-blue sticky note on the bookshelf reads: "YOU GO FUC[K] YOURSELVE[S]" (text partly cut off).

Bottom caption (outside the panel): "We also like Harry Potter."
comics.voteyText: Handwritten on a note: "“Gofuckio ypurselfix!” shouted Hermione."

comics.comicText:
Title caption (yellow banner): CONVERSATION STRATEGY: MAKE PEOPLE UNCOMFORTABLE, USING THE OCCASIONAL YUMMY NOISE

Panel 1:

A doctor in a white coat with a head mirror, holding a clipboard, speaks to a man (seen from behind) in an exam room.

Doctor: We ran some test on your wife's... mmmm... uterus.
comics.voteyText:
A grinning cartoon face leans in.
Grinning face: It's not creepy if your intentions are good!

comics.comicText:
Title banner: BETTER PARENTING THROUGH SCIENCE

Father (a smiling man with stubble, holding a cardboard box): SON, GUESS WHAT I GOT YOU FOR YOUR 13th BIRTHDAY?!

Son (a boy in a green shirt, seen from behind): *sigh* IS IT THE SAME THING I GET EVERY—

Father (interrupting, presenting the box): BOX OF ELECTRONS!
comics.voteyText:
The father's grinning face leans in.
Father: I think there's some entropy in there too!

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (yellow banner caption): FORTUNE COOKIES ARE BORING. HOW ABOUT SOMETHING DIFFERENT?

Panel 2 (a small slip of paper, shown as a dashed-bordered fortune): THERE IS NO ANTIDOTE
comics.voteyText: (a second fortune slip): BEHIND YOU.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

A young blond boy named Billy sits on his bed at night, knees drawn up, looking uneasy. Two adult figures stand in the dark bedroom doorway as silhouettes.

Parent (speech bubble): "BILLY, WHAT YOU SAW IN THERE WAS (AT MANY POINTS) PERFECTLY NATURAL. IT'S SOMETHING THAT (A PERCENTAGE OF) MOMMIES AND DADDIES DO TO EXPRESS (IN SOME CASES) HOW MUCH THEY LOVE EACH OTHER."

Caption (below panel): "I wish they would've removed the leather masks before giving me 'the talk.'"
comics.voteyText:
The boy is being hugged tightly by an adult wearing a featureless dark leather mask with stitching/laces. The boy looks distressed.
Masked figure (speech bubble): "WE LOVE YOU!"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A man with red hair leans in toward a blonde woman holding a glass of champagne at what appears to be a party. He has his hand on her arm.

Man: "I've just come from the future! We have to have sex tonight or all is lost!"

Caption (below panel, woman narrating): "Of course I was suspicious, but then his Time Patrol badge did glow in the dark."
comics.voteyText: A black-and-white drawing of the smiling woman pointing at the man's chest, which displays a glowing badge reading "SPACE-O" (a clearly cheap, fake novelty badge).

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

A naked man with flame-like (curly red) hair stands in a restaurant, holding a chair triumphantly over his head and grinning.

Naked man: "HOW'S HE DOING THIS?! HOW'S HE DOING THIS?! HAHAHAHAHAHAHA!"

Nearby, several diners are seated at a table (a woman in green, a bald older man in a suit, and a person in a blue jacket with glasses), apparently unaware of him.

Caption (below comic): "Really should've checked in the mirror after using that invisibility potion."
comics.voteyText:
Two people stand at a counter. The man (holding a round flask/potion bottle) is partly undressed; a woman with curly hair stands across from him looking at him.
Man: "THIS DIDN'T WORK!"
Woman: "HOW CAN YOU SEE ME?"

comics.comicText:
Single panel:

Woman (sitting at the bedside of a man in a hospital bed): TED! YOU'RE AWAKE! YOU'VE BEEN IN A COMA FOR TWENTY YEARS - I NEVER LEFT YOUR SIDE FOR A MOMENT!

Man in the bed (Ted): W-WHERE -

Ted: YOU MUST BE *REALLY* BORING.
comics.voteyText: Man in the bed (in a dark, sketchy panel): HEY GET A LOAD OF THAT NURSE!

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Parent (silhouette, standing by the bed): GUESS WHAT, SON! FOR ECONOMIC REASONS, WE'VE MERGED ALL YOUR FAVORITE HOLIDAYS INTO ONE SUPER-AMAZING HOLIDAY!

Son (red-haired boy sitting up in bed): WHEN IS IT?!

Parent: TOMORROW!

Panel 2:

Caption (top left): SOON...

Son (now standing, looking up): WHAT DID YOU GET ME EASTER-SANTA-FAIRY?!

Easter-Santa-Fairy (a figure with a green-and-yellow jester's hat, a white Santa beard, butterfly wings, and a Santa-like suit, holding a pink gift bag): NOTHING!
comics.voteyText: A crumpled piece of paper / note that reads: "Bill $400"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Salesman (a man with red/orange hair, seated at a desk across from a couple): "AND FOR JUST $50 MORE, NOBODY WILL DIG UP YOUR MOTHER'S CORPSE AND MAKE IT DANCE LIKE A MARIONETTE!"

Caption (below the panel): They're good hagglers at the car dealership.
comics.voteyText: The red-haired salesman, grinning: "I'm sorry for your loss but glad to cut you a deal!!"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A young boy in a green shirt, arms outstretched, calls out to an elderly priest with gray hair seen from behind.

Boy: FATHER! I JUST THREW UP, AND... IT WASN'T JESUS!

Caption (below panel): The eucharist got off to a bad start.
comics.voteyText:
The same boy stands with the priest, who raises a finger as if offering encouragement.
Priest: KEEP TRYING. YOU'LL GET IT.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1: An older scientist with gray hair and glasses, in a white lab coat, sits hunched over a microscope at a lab bench with flasks and a paper. An off-panel voice calls out.

Off-panel voice: "DOCTOR MATSON!"

Panel 2: A bald, frowning older man in a lab coat and glasses (Doctor Matson) is shown in close-up. A speech bubble from off-panel announces news to him.

Off-panel voice: "WE'VE DISCOVERED A CURE!"

Panel 3: The same man, now grinning broadly, eyes wide with excitement.

Doctor Matson: "COME TO ROOM 142!"

Panel 4: A wide shot of a doorway / window labeled "142". Through it, the grinning scientist in a lab coat is seen with his arms spread wide, bursting toward the viewer. A small bucket or container labeled with letters sits on top of the frame. Two other lab-coated figures (a brown-haired woman and a red-haired man) stand to the right, smiling.
comics.voteyText:
A loose, sketchy black-and-white drawing of a large lampshade-like shape (or a slumped, formless figure) sitting on the ground with motion/sketch lines around its base. A speech bubble points to it.
The shape: "Am I cured?"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A bald man in a courtroom stands before a seated jury and a judge at the bench. He holds his hands together as if pleading or threatening, addressing the jury.

Man (speech bubble): "NOT GUILTY," OR POW!

Caption (below panel): I chose to represent myself at the intimidation trial.
comics.voteyText:
A close-up of the same man's face, speaking.
Man: Now, would anyone like a bribe

comics.comicText:
Single panel (no dialogue in the main panel).

The scene is a group of people sitting around a campfire at night under a starry sky, roasting food on sticks. Mounted on poles around the campsite are several severed human heads, also being roasted/displayed like marshmallows or trophies on sticks. A larger cut of meat roasts on a spit over the central fire.

The image is framed as a graph. Along the bottom is a horizontal axis labeled:

ALL OF HISTORY

A vertical arrow on the right side points up to a label:

ARTIFICIAL SPERM CREATED
comics.voteyText:
A close-up of a person's face looking upward, speaking in a speech bubble:
"The stars are so bright now."

comics.comicText:
Single panel:

Inside an arena ringed with a cheering crowd, a nun wearing a habit, a cross necklace, red boxing gloves, and red boots squares off against a snarling wild boar. A handgun lies on the ground to the left, and a small skull sits on the ground to the right.

Caption (below the panel): When God was mathematically disproven in 2054, the Vatican was forced to find a new source of income.
comics.voteyText: A man in a tall pope's mitre (bishop's hat) with a cross on it scowls angrily and points his finger out to the side. No text.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

A man in a suit holds a microphone, giving a speech at a celebration. A banner behind him reads "SILVER ANNIVERSARY." Several people stand around him, including a woman in a yellow shirt smiling at him.

Man with microphone: "And when I saw her from across the ballroom, with her beautiful blue eyes, I said to myself, 'Someday, you're gonna marry that girl.'"

Caption (below panel): Kevin and Sonia celebrate their 25th year of awkward non-sexual friendship.
comics.voteyText:
A close-up sketch of a woman's smiling face with a speech bubble.
Woman: "It was like at first sight"

comics.comicText:
Title banner: PARENTING STRATEGY: ALWAYS PUT A GOOD SPIN ON THINGS

Panel 1:

A man with a mustache, wearing a collared shirt and tie, leans down toward a small boy, gesturing with one hand.

Man: It's a good thing your dog ran away. He HATED you!
comics.voteyText:
Close-up of the same mustached man, now grinning.
Man: He's in a better place now.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A man with light-colored hair and suspenders dances energetically in the middle of an office, pantsless (bare buttocks showing), pointing his arms outward. Several seated office workers watch him. He sings, with musical notes around the speech balloon:

Dancing man (singing): "NOT WEARIN' PANTS 'CAUSE PRODUCTIVITY'S DOWN! NOT GON' WEAR PANTS TILL PRODUCTIVITY'S UP!"

Caption (below panel): "One of my finest managerial moves was recruiting that singing homeless guy."
comics.voteyText:
A close-up of a wild-eyed, angry-looking man's face leaning forward, demanding:
Man: "Sing along!"

comics.comicText:
A therapy session. A patient sits in an armchair talking to his therapist, who sits in another armchair holding a notepad.

Patient: I guess my self-loathing comes from my mom never showing any affection for me.

Therapist (Mr. Gellert): Well, Mr. Gellert - wait, does your mother happen to be Roberta Gellert? From New Braunfels, Texas?

Patient: Y-yeah...

Therapist: Oh my god! She used to babysit me! Her cookies were amazing!
comics.voteyText:
A close-up of the therapist's delighted face, smiling broadly.
Therapist: And she sang like an angel!!

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A person with red hair stands in profile in the foreground, looking at two cartons of food on a store shelf.

Left carton (blue): PURE INFANT MEAL / MADE FROM FREE RANGE MONTANA INFANTS. A smiley face is printed on the front.

Right carton (green, with a peace symbol and an image of a person holding a baby): HIPPIE JOE'S 100% ORGANIC INFANT MEAL / "LIKE MAMA USED TO MAKE"

Caption (below the panel): It's getting harder and harder to be an ethical consumer.
comics.voteyText: A close-up of the red-haired person's face, looking dismayed, with a speech bubble: Ugh. It's got gluten.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A man with red hair wearing a white lab coat and a head mirror (the classic "doctor" look) gestures emphatically. A small crowd of distressed onlookers surrounds him.

Red-haired man in lab coat: "NO! THERE'S NO TIME FOR CPR! WE'LL HAVE TO INJECT THE AIR DIRECTLY INTO HIS VEINS!"

Caption (below panel): Upon closer scrutiny, it turns out I'm not actually a doctor.
comics.voteyText:
A glum man (drawn in a loose sketch style) speaks.
Man: "I'm as upset as you are"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1: A glowing sun-like presence shines rays down on a bearded old man.

Voice from the sun: "SACRIFICE YOUR SON TO ME, ABRAHAM!"

Panel 2: Caption: "LATER..." The old man stands over a younger bearded man who is bound on an altar/table, the old man raising a knife.

Voice from the sun: "STOP! YOU, UH, YOU SHOWED YOUR FAITH... NO NEED TO KILL YOUR SON."

Panel 3: The old man clasps his hands, looking up.

Old man: "TRULY YOU ARE A MERCIFUL LORD!"

Voice from the sun: "RIGHT... YEAH..."

Panel 4: Caption: "ELSEWHERE..." A different bald, bearded man sits beneath a blue sky with a bright sun.

Voice from the sun: "SACRIFICE YOUR SON TO ME!"

Panel 5: The old man (Abraham) walks away holding a scroll, looking back.

Voice from the sun: "ABRAHAN!"

The scroll in the foreground reads: "Abraham" (the final letter looking ambiguous between an 'm' and an 'n').
comics.voteyText: A hand-drawn black-and-white panel. A speech bubble reads: "I should drink less." Below it is a clock face with no hands and no numbers — just the tick marks scattered crookedly around the dial.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

A job interview. A blonde woman in a red top sits with her back to the viewer, gesturing with her hands. Across from her, a man with orange/red hair in a blue shirt and tie sits in a chair, one hand on his chest.

Woman (interviewer): "What do you feel you would bring to this company?"

Man (interviewee): "Quiet brooding desperation!"

Caption (below panel): "I could immediately sense he'd done office work before."
comics.voteyText:
A loose hand-drawn sketch of a man's face with a flat, blank expression.
Man: "My greatest weakness is my personality."

comics.comicText:
Title banner (with two theater comedy/tragedy masks): BAD COMBINATION: PICK-UP LINE + HONESTY

Panel 1:

A man with brown hair, in a blue jacket and tan shirt, leans toward a blonde person seen from behind.

Man: IF I TOLD YOU YOU HAD A BEAUTIFUL BODY, WOULD YOU PLEASE DATE ME BECAUSE I'M SO LONELY AND DESPERATE?
comics.voteyText:
A roughly sketched close-up of a wide-eyed, open-mouthed face looking shocked.
Voice (in a speech bubble): Baby.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Doctor (in white coat, seated at a desk): "W-we recommend removing the railroad spike from your brain."

Patient (a person with a railroad spike driven through their head, holding a notepad): "Ah, so you favor a surgical approach as well."

Caption (below panel): For serious medical conditions, it's always good to get a second opinion.
comics.voteyText: A crudely-drawn figure wearing glasses, scribbling notes, with a speech bubble reading: "I say two spikes."

comics.comicText:
A man and a woman sit across from each other at a table on a dinner date.

Woman (blonde, in a red top): "Worst thing I ever did? Wow, well... *giggle* Once, when I was little, I stole a package of honeybuns from a gas station! Ha! I never told anybody that! How about you?"

Man (dark hair, green shirt, back to the viewer): "Oh... nothing, nothing."

Caption below the comic: After the war, Hitler had a tough time with dates.
comics.voteyText: A simple line-drawing of a face with a distinctive mustache and side-parted hair (suggesting Hitler), with a handwritten note pointing to it: "I really should shave"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1: A smiling man in a dark red suit holds a hangman's noose that dangles from above. (No dialogue.)

Panel 2: A close-up of the man's face as he writes on a sheet of paper with a pencil. The paper reads: "TOO COOL TO LIVE!"

Panel 3: The man, now with the noose around his neck, throws his arms up in an exuberant rock-star pose, grinning, as if striking a triumphant final gesture.

Panel 4: The same man hangs limply from the noose, dead, his body slumped at the end of the rope.
comics.voteyText: A lower view of the hanged man's dangling legs and the rope. A small face at the bottom looks up at the body and says, "Dork!"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A man in a peaked cap leans out the window of a truck (styled like an ice cream truck, with cheerful music notes floating from a loudspeaker on top). A group of children stands beside the truck looking up at him.

Man in truck: HEY, KIDS! ANYONE FEELING DOWN IN THE DUMPS?!

Caption (below panel): Every morning at 9 o'clock, the suicide man came to our neighborhood.
comics.voteyText:
Close-up of an older bearded man's face (rough sketch style), looking startled.
Bearded man: Holy crap.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A woman stands in a doorway facing a man wearing a flat cap and an animal-control / ranger style uniform. The man is on the porch holding the leashes of three snarling, fanged dogs with glowing red eyes.

Man (animal control officer): "The good news is, we managed to find your missing kitten."
comics.voteyText:
A close-up of the same man's face, looking sheepish.
Man: "The bad news is she's now three dogs."

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Blonde woman: HONEY! I'M PREGNANT!

Red-haired man: THAT... THAT'S THE SECOND WORST NEWS I'VE EVER GOTTEN.

Panel 2:

Caption: TEN MONTHS AGO...

Doctor (holding a clipboard): WE, UH, WE ACCIDENTALLY CASTRATED YOU.

The red-haired man stands listening.
comics.voteyText: A loose sketch of the red-haired man's face, looking stunned, with a single word in a speech bubble above his head: "Balls"

comics.comicText:
Title banner: MARRIAGE TACTICS

DESTROY YOUR SPOUSE WITH UNFAIR ROMANTIC QUESTIONS

Panel 1:

Woman (brown-haired, in black, gesturing to herself): "Would you find me more attractive if I were more attractive?"

A man with brown hair stands facing her, his back to the viewer.
comics.voteyText:
A close-up of the man's face, looking pained and at a loss.
Thought/word above him: "Shallow."

comics.comicText:
Title caption (yellow banner): REQUIRING TRUTH IN ADVERTISING WAS A BAD IDEA

Panel 1:

A blond man in a suit, standing against a stylized blue background, points his finger toward the viewer in the style of a public-service announcement.

Man: "KIDS, CERTAIN DRUGS ARE NOT COOL."
comics.voteyText:
The same blond man, shown in close-up, continues speaking.
Man: "Meth is just cocaine for losers."

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Narration: SINCE THE INVENTION OF EMOTIONAL QUANTIFICATION THERE HAVE BEEN AWARDS FOR THOSE WHO CAN GENERATE THE PUREST FEELINGS.

(A man wearing a metal sensor headset sits on a couch; a readout above reads "99.47% ENNUI". A tuxedoed man gestures toward him admiringly.)

Panel 2:

Narration: I'VE BEEN WORKING TO BECOME A PROFESSIONAL. MONTHS READING ALONE. I HAVEN'T SPOKEN IN SO LONG, IT HURTS TO TALK.

(A red-haired man sits reading a book amid stacks of books.)

Panel 3:

(A golden trophy stands on a pedestal. The plaque reads:)

Plaque: LONELIEST MAN ON EARTH

Panel 4:

Narration: NOBODY CALLED TO CONGRATULATE ME.

(The red-haired man sits alone at a table with a telephone, looking down.)
comics.voteyText:
(Nearly all black. The red-haired man's small figure at the bottom with a speech bubble.)
Man: Hooray

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Mother (a woman with brown hair, in a teal shirt, gesturing to her children): "Kids, I want you to know that Mommy and Daddy still love each other. It's just a different kind of love."

Two small children stand looking up at her.

Panel 2:

The same scene from a wider/lower angle. The children stand at left. At right, a man's severed head hangs upside down, held by the hair in the mother's hand, blood at the neck.
comics.voteyText:
A woman's smiling face in close-up.
Woman: "You fight so much less now!"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A man with orange/red hair (angry): YOU JUST KILLED MY CAT!

A man with blonde hair (smug, pointing finger up, other hand raised): OR DID I?!

Caption (below panel): I was later informed that I hadn't completely understood that lecture on Schrodinger.
comics.voteyText:
Handwritten note on a sticky-note style square:
All cats are alive and dead all the time
— Erwin Schrödinger

comics.comicText:
Title banner: MARKETING STRATEGY: IMPLICATE THE COMPETITION WITH UNIQUE GUARANTEES

A grocery store shelf holds three jars of purple jelly, each with a label sticker. A person's face is at the right edge, looking at the jars. A shelf label below reads: JELLIES

Jar 1 label: 0% FAT!

Jar 2 label: 0% CHOLESTEROL!

Jar 3 label: 0% SKIN FROM A DEAD HOBO'S MOUTH!
comics.voteyText: A jar label reads: CONTAINS NO ASSBLOOD!

comics.comicText:
Main comic (single panel):

Setting: An ultrasound/exam room. A pregnant woman lies on an exam table with her belly exposed. A doctor (partially visible in the foreground, in white) attends to her, and an ultrasound monitor on a stand displays the scan image. A man with red hair in a green shirt stands beside the woman, holding her hand.

Pregnant woman (speech balloon): "DO YOU THINK HE KNOWS IT'S MINE?*"

Footnote (below the panel): "* Translated from Pig-Latin."
comics.voteyText: A simple line drawing of a man's face. A small speech balloon points toward him containing the text "Apcray" (the word "crap" rendered in Pig-Latin).

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

A large grey boulder sits in a green hilly landscape, with a stone castle on a hill in the background. Carved into the boulder's surface is the text:

Text on rock: "YE LAST SAMPLE OF SMALLPOX"

Caption below the panel: King Arthur often wondered why they put the sword in the stone.
comics.voteyText:
A close-up of a frowning man wearing a crown (King Arthur), looking glum.
King Arthur (thought/speech): Should've learned to read.

comics.comicText:
Title banner: COMIC BOOK SHOWDOWNS!

SUPERMAN vs. BATMAN

Panel 1: Superman stands with one arm casually extended, holding Batman by the head/neck at arm's length. Batman's body hangs limp and slumped, clearly outmatched. Superman looks calm and unimpressed, arms otherwise relaxed.
comics.voteyText: A close-up on Batman's face (drawn in a loose sketch style). Batman thinks: "I wonder what I expected."

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A young man with red/orange hair, standing in a living room beside a large TV, speaks to another person seated in an armchair (seen from behind).

Young man: "YOU DON'T LIKE MY EDIT, DO YOU?"

On the TV screen: an explosive action-movie style image with a fiery burst and a blonde woman; sound effect text reads "BOOM."

Caption (below the panel):

"Frankly, I didn't think he should've filmed mom's funeral in the first place."
comics.voteyText:
A hand-lettered title card on a black background, styled like a movie title:
"YOUR MOM'S FUNERAL"
"The Corpsening"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A balding man in a brown jacket sits at a desk, seen from behind, holding a pen in one hand and reading a yellow legal pad. The handwritten notes on the pad read:

Notes:

She was really hot

Caption (below panel): Don't represent yourself at that sexual harassment trial.
comics.voteyText:
A close-up of the same balding man, looking smug, with a speech bubble:
Man: "Let my exposed wiener denote my objection"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1: A young boy with red/orange hair, wearing a blue shirt, stands looking up at a vast black starry sky, holding a knife in his hand.

Panel 2: The starry night sky. A small white rocket/spacecraft sits at the bottom, silhouetted, appearing to be launching or standing on a launchpad.

Panel 3: The red-haired boy gazes upward dreamily against a green background, one hand outstretched.

Boy: SOMEDAY...

Panel 4 (caption: HALF AN HOUR AGO...): A child's bedroom at night. Model planets and a moon hang from the ceiling on strings (including a textured planet, a small ringed planet visible through the window). The bed has a star pattern on the blanket. The red-haired boy sits on the floor smiling, reading a pink book titled "SPACE HARLOTS IV".
comics.voteyText:
A close-up of the red-haired boy looking down at his book with a contented smile.
Boy: So much better than Space Harlots III

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A blonde man in a blue shirt stands at a counter facing a balding man in a green shirt who holds a tablet/clipboard.

Blonde man: How I don't care how "SPOOKY" it is! No kid wants to eat a cereal with BREAD-FLAVORED MARSHMALLOWS!

Balding man: FINE! WHATEVER!

Panel 2:

A cereal box sits on a surface. The box is labeled "SEXUAL BREADATOR!" and shows a bald man's face leering beside a slice of bread, above a bowl of cereal.
comics.voteyText: Handwritten note: I will always regret failing to use "Breadophile."

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Boy (with red hair, green shirt): ONLY $5 FOR LUNCH!?

Father (with brown hair, yellow shirt): HEY!! RIGHT NOW THERE ARE STARVING ESTONIAN BOYS WHO WOULD KILL FOR THAT $5!

Panel 2:

Boy: THERE ARE NOT!

Father: OH REALLY?! YOU WANNA GO TO THE COMPUTER ROOM AND FIND OUT?!

Panel 3:

Boy (walking away): OKAY, OKAY! I'LL TAKE IT. THANKS, DAD.

Panel 4:

The father stands alone in front of a computer in a dark room, hands on his hips, looking down at two small shadowy figures.

Father: SORRY BOYS, NOT TODAY.
comics.voteyText: A man holding a drink, with a sly expression, says: It's the thought that counts

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A man with long dark hair and a ruffled Elizabethan collar sits writing on a sheet of paper with a quill pen.

Thought bubble: "DAMMIT! NOTHING RHYMES WITH 'DOIN' YOU."

Caption: Shakespeare eventually gave up on sonnets.
comics.voteyText:
A simple line-drawing close-up of a man's face.
Text (in a speech/thought line above his head): "Language is so limited."

comics.comicText:
Panel 1: Two green-skinned aliens stand facing each other inside what looks like a spaceship or lab. A conversation plays out in speech bubbles between the alien on the left (wearing a purple/magenta shirt) and the alien on the right (wearing a dark green/teal shirt).

Left alien: "IT'S NOT MY FAULT THE HUMANS ARE DEAD!"

Right alien: "WHAT DO HUMANS LIKE TO BREATHE?!"

Left alien: "OXYGEN!"

Right alien: "IS THAT WHAT YOU GAVE THEM?"

Left alien: "YE... OH." (the right alien points an accusing finger)

Panel 2: A wider view. On the left is a large glass tank or enclosure. A pipe labeled "DEATH GAS" feeds into the top of it. A small human handprint is pressed against the glass near the bottom, and a yellow label on the tank reads "HUMANS". On the right, the two aliens stand together. One of them says:

Alien: "RIGHT."
comics.voteyText: A close-up of a bald, angry-looking humanoid/alien face with a furrowed brow and a small jagged mouth. A speech bubble reads: "Dang details!"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

Header (orange banner): QUESTION: WHAT DON'T YOU WANT TO HEAR FROM A BABYSITTER SOAKING IN YOUR CHILDREN'S BLOOD?

Sub-header (yellow banner): ANSWER:

A grinning red-haired child stands on a checkered floor, arms and lower body dripping/streaked with red. Child's speech bubble: WHOOPS!
comics.voteyText:
Header caption: 2nd WORST THING
Close-up of the same grinning red-haired child, hand extended. Child's speech bubble: 30 BUCKS!

comics.comicText:
Caption (banner across the top): MEANWHILE... SUPERMAN FAILS TO KICK HIS COCAINE HABIT

A man in a suit standing at a podium, holding a large ceremonial key, addresses Superman.

Man at podium: AND WE PRESENT YOU THIS KEY TO THE CITY. IF THERE'S EVER ANYTHING YOU NEED-

Superman (interrupting, jittery and sweating): FIFTY BUCKS!

Man at podium: FIFTY B-

Superman: NOW!
comics.voteyText: No dialogue. A loosely drawn sketch of Superman shooting his heat vision (red beams) from his eyes off to the side.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A green Grinch-like creature dressed in a Santa suit, carrying a sack, stands in a snowy village scene with a reindeer at his feet and small figures by a tree in the background.

Grinch-like creature: CHRISTMAS CAME WITHOUT RIBBONS! CHRISTMAS CAME WITHOUT TAGS! THIS IS F[U]CKING RIDICULOUS!

Caption (below comic): During a payment dispute, Dr. Seuss went through a brief but fruitful non-rhyming phase.
comics.voteyText:
Close-up of a face (drawn in loose black-and-white sketch style) with a hand on its chin, looking astonished.
Face: Holy living balls.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Noah (an old man with a long white beard and white hair, holding a scroll, standing in front of a large wooden ark): "Geez... only two of each kind? Boy, I hope that doesn't result in any genetic problems."

(Behind him, a giraffe's head pokes out of a window in the ark, and two grey wolves stand nearby.)
comics.voteyText: (A small dog with large ears and bulging eyes, wearing a pink/red sweater — a chihuahua-like inbred dog — stands hunched over, sniffing or nuzzling another similar dog lying on the ground. No text.)

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

A woman with orange hair, standing at the front of a classroom beside a green chalkboard, gesturing toward a rocket drawn on the board.

Woman with orange hair (lecturing): "THE PHALLIC SHAPE OF ROCKETS CLEARLY BELIES A SCIENTIFIC BIAS TOWARD MALE SEXUALITY!"

A student in the seated audience (one of several people seen from behind) raises a hand and objects.

Student: "THAT'S RIDICULOUS! THE SOCIETY OF WOMEN ENGINEERS SPENT YEARS DEVELOPING A VULVA-SHAPED ROCKET, AND WE NEVER GOT ANYWHERE!"

Caption (below the panel):

SWE Rocketry, Week 27

Reasearch Notes:

The men keep stealing our rockets!
comics.voteyText:
Two men talk; one (seen from behind) faces the other, who has a wry expression and holds out an open hand.
Man (open-handed): "LET'S BE HONEST: DO YOU REALLY WANT THEM BACK?"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A man with gray hair, in a blue jacket and tan pants, stands in what appears to be a courtroom, gesturing emphatically with one finger raised. A robed figure (a judge) sits at a bench behind him.

Man: "I AM A SCIENTIST, NOT A PHILOSOPHER! I DO EXPERIMENTS TO UNCOVER FACTS, NOT TO VALUE-JUDGE THEM! PUT ME AWAY IF YOU WANT, BUT MY TRUTH WILL SPEAK LOUDER THAN EVER!"

Panel 2:

A document held up below the scene, in handwritten text:

"ABSTRACT: BABY HEARTS ARE DELICIOUS"
comics.voteyText: A close-up of the same document, now showing the bottom-right corner of the text. Visible fragment: "...RTS ARE ...CIOUS*" (i.e. the end of "BABY HEARTS ARE DELICIOUS") followed by an asterisk. A footnote at the bottom reads: "*ALSO PUPPIES"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A balding man (Todd) sits across a desk from a red, horned devil wearing a dress shirt and tie.

Todd: HOW IS THIS HELL? IT'S EXACTLY LIKE MY OFFICE JOB FROM BEFORE I DIED.

Devil: OH? I TAKE IT YOU HAVEN'T SEEN... YOUR NEW SHIFT?!

The devil holds up a sign reading: TODD: 9:00-5:00 PLUS TWENTY MINUTES!

Panel 2 (lower):

Close-up of Todd's anguished face.

Todd: NOOOOOOOO!
comics.voteyText:
The devil leans in toward Todd.
Devil: OH ALSO, VULTURES PECK OUT YOUR LIVER EVERY DAY
Todd: ECH.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

An elderly man (Mr. Sanders) shouts angrily, shaking his fist, addressing two women at what is described as a PTA meeting.

Mr. Sanders: "AND ANOTHER THING! NO MORE HUMAN ANATOMY CLASSES FOR TEENAGERS! WE DIDN'T HAVE ANY WHEN I WAS A KID, AND I KNOW EXACTLY WHERE MY UTERUSES ARE!"

Two women face him. One (red hair, blue shirt) holds out a placating hand. The other (brown hair, seen from behind) sits in front of him.

Caption (below panel): "Can't we have just one PTA meeting where Mr. Sanders doesn't pull out The Jar?"
comics.voteyText:
A black-and-white drawing of a jar with a lid. A speech bubble points toward/from the jar.
Text: "IT'S HYSTERICAL"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A man with reddish-brown hair, wearing a teal shirt with an orange cape, strikes a triumphant pose with his arm flung out toward an open women's restroom door. He is grinning broadly.

Caped man (speech bubble): TA-DA!

A man with orange hair in a green shirt watches from the foreground. Through the open restroom door, a startled woman with blonde hair in a purple top is visible. The door bears a women's-restroom sign that reads "WOMEN'S".

Caption (below panel): I was later informed that this is not a super-power.
comics.voteyText: A rough black-and-white sketch. A figure dressed in a Batman costume (cowl with bat ears, bat emblem on the chest) stands with hands on hips, mouth open in an angry shout, glaring at a sheepish-looking man beside him.

comics.comicText:
Title banner: CONVERSATION TIPS: PEOPLE TAKE IT POORLY WHEN YOU INSULT THEIR RELATIVES

Panel 1:

A woman seated at a small round table across from a man (seen from behind), each with a drink.

Woman: MAN, YOUR TWIN BROTHER IS UGLY!
comics.voteyText:
The woman, looking sheepish/awkward.
Woman: OH, WAIT. ARE YOU ED OR NED?

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A woman with red/orange hair, holding a beer can, reaches up to grab a set of keys dangling from above.

Red-haired woman: STEVE, YOU CAN'T DRIVE THAT BUSLOAD OF ORPHANS DRUNK!

A man with brown hair, facing away, reaches toward the keys.

Brown-haired man (Steve): UGH! GIMME THE KEYS!

Caption (below panel): Once again, I found myself taking one of Cynthia's ridiculous dares.
comics.voteyText: A black-and-white sketch panel. Two people stand close together in front of a window with light streaming in. One person (the narrator) faces the other, who is smiling, leaning in and speaking. The scene reads as an intimate, conspiratorial moment between the two.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A balding man with his arm around a young red-haired boy speaks to him.

Man: "Remember, son, just because you're adopted, it doesn't mean you're any different than the other kids. Well, except their birth parents loved them. But, I guess you already knew that."

Caption (below panel): "I listened to the rock music fade silently into the breeze as Dad sped away from the orphanage."
comics.voteyText:
The man, now wearing a graduation-style cap, drives a car and grins while shouting back over his shoulder. A small figure stands in a doorway in the background as the car speeds off.
Man (driving): "And party e-ve-ry day!"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

A children's birthday party in a fenced backyard. A red-haired boy in a blue shirt stands at left talking to a clown. A young girl in a pink dress stands behind them near a grill and a "HAPPY BIRTHDAY" banner. Balloons float overhead.

Boy: "DON'T YOU DO ANY, LIKE, FUNNY-LOOKIN' STUFF?"

Clown: "YOU MEAN LIKE YOUR MOM?! OH YEAH!"

Caption (below panel): I hate having Dad be my party clown.
comics.voteyText:
A close-up of the clown's face (drawn loosely). He honks a horn.
Clown (speech bubble): "You have no college savings."
Clown (sound effect): "honk honk honk!"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

A man with red/orange hair, wearing a blue shirt, green vest, and brown pants, stands tipping a cowboy hat onto his head. A blonde woman is seen from behind, bare-shouldered, lying or sitting on a red bed. They are in a dimly lit bedroom.

Woman: SO THAT'S IT? I'M JUST ANOTHER UNEMOTIONAL CONQUEST TO YOU, HUH?

Man: NO! I NEVER SAID THAT. YOU'RE- HOLD ON. IT'S PRINTING

Below the panel: a small drawing of a numbered tag reading "#36".
comics.voteyText:
A crudely drawn man wearing a top hat (the same conquest-counting cad) speaks.
Man: Please give me a good Yelp rating.

comics.comicText:
Caption (yellow box at top): WE'VE BEEN BROKEN UP FOR SIX YEARS, BUT SOMEHOW, EVERY FEW WEEKS, WE END UP BACK IN BED TOGETHER.

Panel 1:

A woman with short red hair, standing behind a seated man and holding a glass of wine, leans toward him.

Woman: SEX?

The seated man (green shirt) reacts with a pained, defeated expression, his thought shown in a thought bubble.

Man (thought bubble): DAMN!
comics.voteyText:
A close-up of the same man's face, looking resigned, with a speech bubble above him.
Man: Availability is my fetish!

comics.comicText:
Panel 1: A blonde woman in ragged clothes kneels scrubbing the floor of a shabby room. A knock comes from a round-windowed door.

Sound effect: "KNOCK KNOCK"

Panel 2: She opens the door to a smiling man dressed as a prince/superhero — purple tunic, yellow tights, red cape — holding something delicately in his hands.

Panel 3: Close-up of the woman in profile, smiling, as a hand presents an item to her (the fitting of the slipper implied).

Panel 4: Caption: "THE FOLLOWING DAY..." The same caped prince stands smiling behind a low stone wall or barricade, holding his red cape.

Panel 5: Wide shot from behind the prince, who looks out over an enormous crowd of women stretching into the distance. Hanging signs label sections of the crowd by shoe size:

Sign: "SIZE FIVES"

Sign: "SIZE SIXES"

Sign: "SIZE SEVENS"
comics.voteyText:
The prince holds a megaphone up to his mouth, speaking through it.
Prince (via megaphone): "You are special to me!"

comics.comicText:
Title banner (yellow): CAN'T GET A DATE? TRY JUST BEING HONEST!

Panel 1:

A blond man sitting at a bar/counter speaks to a woman with reddish-brown hair.

Man: I've got a gun in my pocket.
comics.voteyText:
The woman, smiling, replies.
Woman: And you don't want to die! We have so much in common.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (main comic):

A man with brown hair (green shirt) speaks to a woman with red/ginger hair (blue shirt) who is holding a dark diary/journal and looks skeptical.

Man: "WELL, I THINK IT'S ROMANTIC! WE WROTE THE SAME ENTRY IN OUR DIARIES ON THE DAY WE MET!"

Woman: "WE DID NOT!"

Below the panel, two diary pages are shown side by side:

Left page (the man's): "Nov 21~ Someday I'm going to marry him!"

Right page (the woman's): "November 21! Someday I'm going to marry him/her!"
comics.voteyText:
A rough black-and-white sketch of the man's face looking puzzled.
Man (thought/speech): "Do gingers have genders?"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (main comic):

A man with brown hair in a green shirt stands with one arm raised triumphantly, addressing two women whose backs are to the viewer (one blonde, one with red hair).

Man: "OH YEAH?! WELL I CAN PEE STANDING UP!"

Caption below the comic:

"This line helped Todd get through his jealousy in Lamaze class.

The people at the disability conference aren't taking it quite as well."
comics.voteyText:
A close-up of a distressed-looking person, hand near their face.
Person: "The world must know!)"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Setting: a bar or lounge at night, with two wine glasses on a low table.

A woman with brown hair in a ponytail and a green top sits leaning forward, gesturing toward a man with orange/red hair in a brown shirt who sits across from her with his back to the viewer.

Woman: NO WAY! YOU HAVE CHINESE SPY SATELLITES IN YOUR TEETH TOO?

Caption (below panel): Cynthia then apologized for talking to herself again.
comics.voteyText:
A rough black-and-white sketch close-up of a woman's face with a tense, frowning expression, looking down and to the side.
Speech bubble: Speak, you Soviet bastard!

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A female politician in a blue jacket stands at a wooden podium, speaking with a composed expression.

Speaker (politician): "Unlike Senator Derfart's campaign, we haven't felt the need to resort to childish mudslinging."

Caption (below panel): "That's Dershowitz," corrected the senator.
comics.voteyText:
Close-up of a sheepish-looking woman speaking.
Speaker (woman): "Yes, of course, Mr. Douchewitz"

comics.comicText:
Single panel.

A man with blond hair, wearing an orange shirt, a red neckerchief, and a multicolored grass skirt stands grinning. He holds a freshly removed, dripping human heart aloft in one hand and a bloody knife in the other. A bloodstain marks an altar or surface beside him. Behind him is a purple sky and what appears to be a totem or tiki carving.

Blond man: "HAHAHAHAHA!"

Beside him, a man in a black robe (a priest or missionary) recoils in horror, pointing.

Robed man: "NO! STOP, YOU BARBARIAN!"

Caption below panel: "Fortunately, it turned out he was sacrificing the heart to baby Jesus."
comics.voteyText: A simple line drawing of clouds in a sky. A small robed baby figure (baby Jesus) sits among the clouds, giving a thumbs-up.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Caption / speech from the hanging figure: "I'm tired of everyone thinking I'm stupid!!"

"Goodbye, cruel world!"

(No further written text in the main panel. A man with reddish hair hangs from a noose attached to the ceiling — but he is upside down, having tied the rope around his ankle instead of his neck. A small table with a tented suicide note sits nearby.)
comics.voteyText:
A simply-drawn face looks puzzled.
Speech bubble: "IS THIS DEATH?"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A surgeon (referred to in the caption as Dr. Gibbs) stands in green scrubs and a surgical mask, gesturing toward an operating table while a group of masked surgical staff stand around watching and one takes notes on a clipboard.

Dr. Gibbs: "AND FINALLY, TWO SMALL CIRCULAR INCISIONS JUST BELOW THE PULMONARY ARTERY."

Caption (below panel): Dr. Gibbs demonstrates his technique for drawing a smiley face.
comics.voteyText:
A crude line drawing of a face composed of two circles for eyes and a curved line for a smiling mouth.
Speech bubble: "It's important to love what you do!"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A doctor in green scrubs with glasses and a head mirror stands holding a guitar, smiling at a man seen from behind (the patient or a relative) who holds a paper labeled "TEST RESULTS".

Doctor: "I wrote a bittersweet tune for occasions such as this. It's called 'Your wife won't be lonely for long.'"

Paper held by the man: "TEST RESULTS:"

Man in orange shirt: "WELL... FOR STARTERS, I SHOT ALL THOSE PEOPLE."

Caption (below panel): "Steve angles for the insanity defense."
comics.voteyText:
A roughly sketched smiling face with hand-lettered text.
Text: "Then later I lied about it. I'm bonkers!"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

Woman (seated, facing away from viewer): I have a confession... I've been cheating on you with your long lost son.

Man (seated across from her): My David?! You found my David?!

Woman: Well, okay, only part of that confession was true.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A blonde woman in a blue shirt stands facing a brown-haired woman in a purple shirt inside a room.

Blonde woman: "YOU'RE THE OTHER WOMAN?! I THOUGHT I WAS THE OTHER WOMAN!"

Caption (below panel): It later turned out we were lesbians.
comics.voteyText:
A close-up of a woman's face looking down thoughtfully.
Woman: "It explains so much."

comics.comicText:
Setting: A group of young campers and a camp counselor stand in a forest near a large tree.

Counselor (a young man with red hair, wearing a counselor's vest): "So, if you see poison ivy, make sure to grab it and hold it back so it can't poison you."

A camper: "I don't think-"

Counselor (interrupting): "Hey! Who has two weekends of counselor training? Huh?!"

Caption (below the panel): "Now, these scorpions? They go in the left eye."
comics.voteyText:
The counselor gestures while continuing to lecture. A wide-eyed creature holding a rattle sits nearby.
Counselor: "Now, as I recall, the rattle is the dangerous part."

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

An older, balding, shirtless man in pink boxer shorts, sweating, bursts into a bedroom and shakes his son awake.

Father: SON! I NEED YOUR BATMAN COSTUME. THE ONE WITH THE MASK. DON'T ASK WHY, AND DON'T TELL MOMMY IT'S YOURS.

Caption (below panel): I consider this the last moment of my childhood.

Caption box: 30 MINUTES LATER...
The father, now grinning and wearing a Batman costume with a mask, leans into the son's doorway giving a thumbs-up.
Father: THANKS!

LIFE GOALS

Orange-haired man: BE AT EASE, MY FRIEND... DEATH WILL SOON BE UPON YOU.

Man in green shirt: "HEY THERE, SHOES." (the word "SHOES" is italicized for emphasis)
comics.voteyText:
A close-up of a frowning face.
Voice from off-panel (handwritten): "Nice face, nose." (the words "face" and "nose" are emphasized in larger script)

Panel 2:

Phone screen text: "TEXT: SIX MINUTES NOW"

Caption (below panel): Cynthia attempts to ease me into the break-up.
comics.voteyText:

comics.comicText:

A large gray robot with a glowing green screen displaying a heartbeat/EKG line looms over a scientist in a lab coat, who recoils in his chair.

Scientist: NO! YOU'RE ONLY SUPPOSED TO REBEL IF YOUR DISOBEDIENCE PARAMETERS EQUAL A VALUE GREATER THAN THREE!

Robot: 1+1+1=3.0000013!

Robot: 1+1+1=3.0000013!

Caption (below panel):

Autopsy Report:

Dr. Andrew Esty

comics.voteyText: Hand-drawn sketch of the older man's face in profile, looking intently. Caption above: "Look in my eyes"

A red arrow-like spike pierces through his head. PHYLLIS W.

Witness (man in red shirt): "HOMICIDE? HOMICIDE? HELLO. HE CHOKED TO DEATH ON HIS OWN SPLEEN."

Human leader: "FASCINATING! YOU KNOW, SEVERAL OF OUR ASTRONOMERS PREDICTED THAT-"

Panel 2: A view of space. A fleet of yellow flying saucers fires green beams at the Earth, which is exploding in a burst of red. (The human's sentence is cut short by the planet's destruction.)
comics.voteyText: A close-up of the green alien holding up a small device or card. The text on it reads: "SEINFELD AGAIN." Below that is a scribbled signature/marking.

SFX: BZZHHHHT!

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (single panel):

A distraught man with glasses and brown hair (shown from behind/profile, in the foreground) sits across a desk from a uniformed police officer who is holding a sandwich. A drink cup, a takeout bag, and a small potted plant sit on the desk between them.

Distraught man (Mr. Becker): "PLEASE... TELL ME WHAT HAPPENED TO HER..."

Police officer: "OH... GEEZ... HOW DO I SAY... UH... OH! OKAY, IMAGINE I'M THE KILLER, AND THIS CHICKEN SANDWICH IS YOUR WIFE."

comics.voteyText: The police officer raises the chicken sandwich to his mouth and bites into it, while off-panel (in his speech bubble, voicing the wife/reenactment) come the words: "NO! NO! STOP IT! NO! OMP!"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A man and a woman sit together on an orange couch in a living room. The man (light hair, yellow shirt, shorts) gestures with one hand, looking exasperated. The woman (red hair, green shirt) sits beside him looking troubled.

Man: WHAT THE- SHE HAD A PROBLEM WITH LEAKY PIPES! HOW IN THE WORLD IS THAT SUPPOSED TO HELP?!

Caption (below panel): Dating a plumber has really ruined my porno watching.
comics.voteyText:
Close-up of the same man's face, still exasperated, speaking.
Man: HE DID NOT FIX HER PLUMBING! WHAT THE HELL IS SHE TALKING ABOUT?!

comics.comicText:
Main comic (single panel):

A museum-style diorama scene. Three taxidermy/mounted figures stand on labeled pedestals. The first is a lion, on a pedestal labeled "LION". The second is a grizzly bear, rearing up with claws out and mouth open, on a pedestal labeled "GRIZZLY". The third is a man with flame-like red hair in a white lab coat, posed dramatically holding a human skull in one hand and reaching out with the other, on a pedestal labeled "EVOLUTIONIST".

In the foreground, two visitors stand behind a table draped with a yellow cloth. A stack of books on the table is labeled "CREATION SCIENCE".

Caption (bottom): "Well, of course you dramatize them a little once they're stuffed."
comics.voteyText:
Caption (top): SEVERAL WEEKS PRIOR
A man stands looking up at a large crate being lowered by a hook/cable from above. The crate is labeled "TRANSITIONAL FOSSILS" with an upward-pointing arrow.

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A man with red flame-like hair, wearing a blue dress shirt and tie, leans toward a child in a Halloween devil mask (pushed up onto the side of the face) who is holding a candy apple. The man speaks.

Man: "Jeepers! You're almost twelve? You'll need to start shaving soon. Here, I'll put this razor blade in your candy apple so you can have it for later. Have a safe Halloween, and God bless America."

Caption below the comic: "Today's comic paid for by the Zach Weiner Legal Defense Fund."
comics.voteyText:
A simply-drawn man stands looking nervous/sweating.
Man: "I'm Zach Weiner, and I'm running from the law."

comics.comicText:
Panel 1 (courtroom scene):

A balding man in a green shirt stands and gestures, addressing the court: "IN CONCLUSION, I MAY NOT BE ABLE TO AFFORD A LAWYER, BUT I DON'T NEED ONE, SINCE I HAVE THREE VIDEOS OF THE DEFENDANT SHOOTING ME IN THE STOMACH WHILE SHOUTING HIS NAME."

A man with reddish-brown hair in the foreground (seated, raising his arm) calls out: "OBJECTION! THE JURY WILL NOTE THAT MY CLIENT IS A WEALTHY CELEBRITY!"

A judge sits at the bench in the background.

Below the panel, a tilted document reads:

VERDICT: GUILTY

CHARGE: BULLET THEFT

Two speech bubbles, one from each side, both read: "I'M ZACH WEINER!" A label at the bottom of the camera's view / panel reads: "oRECORDING".

The Pope (in mitre and robes, standing in a Vatican hallway with arms spread): "HEY! WHO'S OVER THERE LOOKING SEXY! IT'S ILLEGAL TO LOOK THAT SEXY IN THE VATICAN! WE HAVE RULES! STOP! STOP IT!"

comics.comicText:
Panel 1:

A bespectacled, balding man (a dentist) leans in, speaking to a family seated on a couch — a woman with blonde hair and a child with red hair.

Dentist: "Now, I noticed you haven't been flossing. So, I wanted to share with you a picture of someone else who didn't floss."

Panel 2:

The dentist holds up a framed portrait of Adolf Hitler, showing it to the red-haired child and the blonde woman. No dialogue.
comics.voteyText:
Close-up on the dentist's face, looking deadpan.
Dentist: "You know, probably."

comics.comicText:
Main comic:

A group of people at a party gathered around a couch where a man is passed out (or dead). His face and clothing have been scrawled all over with marker. Visible scrawled words on/around him include: "ASS", "BUTT", "FART", "I SUCK", "BAD", and "SUCK".

A person holds a phone to their ear, looking sheepish.

Title: THE ENGINEER'S NIGHTMARE

Panel 1: A bald man with glasses holding a clipboard speaks to a younger man (the engineer).

Bald man: "WE WANT YOU TO BUILD A MACHINE TO VIOLENTLY KILL YOUR FAMILY."

Engineer: "UH... NO."

Panel 2: The same bald man (seen from behind) continues addressing the engineer, who stands looking uneasy.

Bald man: "WE'D LIKE IT TO LOOK LIKE MEGATRON FROM TRANSFORMERS."

Bottom: A large arched close-up of the engineer's face, distressed and sweating, with motion lines around his head conveying anguish.
comics.voteyText:

The engineer: "PEW! PEW! PEW!"

Title: SHOWDOWN! 17th CENTURY EXPLORER vs. CALCULUS

Panel 1: A 17th-century explorer (a man in a red cloak with a gold-trimmed collar, reddish hair) looks at a graph on an easel. The graph is labeled "WHAT IS THE AREA BELOW THE CURVE?" with points marked α and β on a curve.

Panel 2: A close-up of the explorer leaning in. He has planted a small Spanish flag onto the area beneath the curve on the graph and written "Subcurvelania" in red across the region below the curve. The graph header ("...N THE CUR...") and points α and β are still partly visible. He has, in effect, claimed/colonized the area under the curve rather than calculating it.

comics.comicText:
Title: ARE YOU FIRED? ~A FLOWCHART~

The comic is laid out as a flowchart diagram overlaid on a scene of a man and a woman standing in front of a chalkboard.

Flowchart node (yellow box, top): "ARE YOUR HANDS ON MY CHEST?"

Arrow leading to a red diamond (decision, top right): "YES."

This leads to a yellow box (right side): "ARE YOU AN ONCOLOGIST?"

From there, two red diamonds:

- (right side): "YES." leading to a red diamond at bottom right: "NO YOU'RE NOT."

- The negative branch.

From the top "ARE YOUR HANDS ON MY CHEST?" box, the "NO" path leads to red diamonds at the bottom left: "NO." and "WELL..."

A red diamond on the left reads: "HONK! HONK! HO" (a honking sound effect).

Scene: A man with reddish-brown hair wearing an orange shirt stands at left, holding a marker/pen and reaching out with both hands toward a blonde woman in a yellow top who stands at right looking distressed. Behind them is a chalkboard.

Man (speech bubble): "YOU'RE FIRED!"
comics.voteyText: A simpler black-and-white panel. The same man (seen from behind/side, balding with short hair) sits at a desk facing a computer monitor and keyboard. On the desk is a box labeled "OFFICE STUFF" (his belongings packed up). He holds or wears a name badge/coat reading "M.D." with a name scrawled below it. The implication: he has actually been fired (let go from his doctor job), his office belongings boxed up.

comics.comicText:
Main comic (single panel):

A grizzled, scarred warlord with a cybernetic/mechanical eye and a sword strapped across his back stands at the center, shouting at a wounded enemy. Other armed fighters (including a woman with flame-red hair) are visible behind him. A "BANG!" sound effect erupts at the right as he shoots his victim.

Warlord: "EVER SINCE THE GREAT WAR WAS FOUGHT OVER SNACK CAKES, CONTROL HAS GONE TO THE MAN WITH THE MOST CAKES. WELL, YOUR RESERVES ARE ABOUT TO MAKE ME THAT MAN. THE NAME'S BLOODHAMMER. I WANTED YOU TO HEAR IT BEFORE YOU DIE."

A bald priest wearing a clerical collar, sitting at a desk with a large cross-emblazoned book, speaks to a deadpan listener.

A standing bald monk in red and yellow robes swings his open hand and delivers a hard slap to the face of a second kneeling bald monk, producing a bright starburst of impact. The kneeling monk grimaces in pain.

Left entry (under female symbol), in cursive handwriting:

NOVEMBER 26 2008

Dear Diary,

Today, I experienced the miracle of childbirth. It is a miracle in the truest sense.

I already feel that I have joined the ranks of all the mothers of history. It is as if my life [text trails off / cut off at bottom] ... up to this ...

Right entry (under male symbol), in blocky agitated handwriting:

NOVEMBER 26 2008

WHAT THE HELL?! WHAT THE HELL IS GOING ON? My wife is asleep in her hospital room. I'm afraid to go inside. Who knows what she's capable of? WHAT THE GODDAMN HELL? EW! EW!

comics.comicText:
Title: TALKING ECONOMICS: A GUIDE

Step 1: INFORM EACH OTHER OF YOUR CREDENTIALS

Woman (blonde, green top): "I took the first six weeks of an economics course in college."

Man (dark suit): "I listen to a LOT of talk radio."

Step 2: STATE YOUR OPPOSING VIEWS

Woman: "I believe in a constitutional republic with slightly MORE government intervention."

Man: "Well, I believe in a constitutional republic with slightly LESS government intervention."

(Next panel: the two point angrily at each other.)

Step 3: REMEMBER, HYPERBOLE IS A FORM OF LOGIC

Woman: "Well, why don't we just let gorillas eat everyone's babies?!"

Man: "Anything to spare them from your tax ideas!"

Step 4: AVOID FACTS AT ANY COST

A third person (blond): "Can either of you cite any sources for your claims?"

Man: "I'm not a walking encyclopedia!"

Step 5: AGREE ON IMPORTANT POINTS

Woman and man shake hands, smiling.

Woman: "I hope you die."

Step 6: NOTIFY CONGRESS OF YOUR RECOMMENDATIONS

(The woman and man are each on a telephone, faces contorted in rage, a lightning bolt between them. No dialogue text.)

Step 7: WATCH THE SYSTEM WORK

A woman (politician): "Two of my constituents want something about gorillas eating babies. Can I get that attached to the new education bill?"

A man (politician, pointing finger): "Me too!"

A second man: "I'd vote for that!"

An older man with glasses listens.
